## PHẦN 2: Toàn văn Prompt của 159 mẫu Free chưa dùng (Nguyên văn từ MotionSites API)

### [FREE-001] Design Collage (`design-collage`)
- **Danh mục:** Interactive | **Loại:** hero | **Độ dài:** 21,605 ký tự
- **Video Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/kinetic-art-gallery.mp4
- **Poster 1280px:** https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261108_013431_f9552abf-607a-49c8-b81f-3d1c526640c4.png&w=1280&q=85

```markdown
# Orrin — Kinetic Art: recreation prompt

Build a single-page hero called **"Orrin — Kinetic Art"** as one self-contained `index.html` (HTML, CSS and one JavaScript ES module, no build step). It is a dark, scroll-scrubbed WebGL gallery of live website-preview videos.

**Opening sequence (about 5 s):**
1. The serif wordmark **Orrin** starts at the exact centre of the screen and rises to the top.
2. The title **Kinetic Art** fades in at the centre, and its two words slide apart.
3. Between them, 150 small video cards fly out of one point into a **sine-wave ribbon**.
4. The words fade, and the cards **burst out into a staggered 3-column, 2-layer grid**. The grid keeps a clear hole around the heading. Its back layer turns into faint blank plates, and its front layer plays the videos.
5. The resting heading scales in: a small sans eyebrow, a large three-line serif headline and a glass **Scroll down** button.

**Interaction (from 4.5 s):**
- Scrolling unlocks and the camera follows the mouse on a spring.
- At 6.5 s a glass hint pill appears bottom right.
- Hovering a front card grows it 1.1×.
- Clicking a card swaps the hint for a credit card: a live thumbnail, name, category, an "Open the prompt" link and a close button.

**Scrolling** zooms the camera in, lifts and fades the heading, scrolls the gallery upward through the grid, dims its centre column and moves the wordmark to the top-left corner. Below 900px wide everything switches to a portrait layout with a vertical ribbon.

Follow every value below exactly. They come from the final source.

---

## 1. Media (all public, CORS `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`)

There are 16 looping preview videos on one public R2 bucket. Base URL: `https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/`. Each is an H.264 MP4 at 16:10, 1440×900, with no audio.

Create one `<video>` per clip in JavaScript, not in the DOM:
- set `crossOrigin = "anonymous"`, `muted`, `loop`, `playsInline` (plus the `playsinline` and `muted` attributes) and `preload = "auto"`;
- call `play()` for clip i after a delay of i × 60 ms, catching and ignoring any rejection;
- wrap each in a Three.js `VideoTexture` with sRGB colour space, linear min and mag filters, and no mipmaps.

Use the direct links as they are; do not re-host them.

## 2. Fonts

| Family | Use | Google Fonts CSS | Direct latin WOFF2 |

| Newsreader (variable, `opsz` 6–72, weight 400, always with `font-variation-settings: "opsz" 72`) | wordmark, intro title, headline | https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Newsreader:opsz,wght@6..72,400&display=swap | https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/newsreader/v26/cY9VfjOCX1hbuyalUrK49dLafXjalZCsZBsgBgbNJYQ.woff2 |
| Inter (variable, weights 400 and 500) | eyebrow, button, hint and credit card | https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500&display=swap | https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/inter/v20/UcC73FwrK3iLTeHuS_nVMrMxCp50SjIa1ZL7.woff2 |

Self-host or base64-embed the WOFF2 files:
- `@font-face "Newsreader"`: weight range 200–800, `font-display: swap`.
- `@font-face "Inter"`: weight range 100–900, `font-display: swap`.

## 3. Tokens, rem scale, page shell

**Colours:**

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| --bg | #0a0a0b | page background |
| --ink | #ece8e1 | text, menu button fill |
| --mute | rgba(236,232,225,.55) | hint text, credit description |

**The rem scale drives every size.** Set it on `html`:

| Viewport width | `font-size` |
|---|---|
| default (below 450px) | 2.6666666667vw |
| 450px and up | 12px |
| 901px and up | .625vw |
| 1920px and up | 12px |

So 1rem is 9px at 1440 and 2.4px less per 384px below that, down to 901px.

Also on `html`: `-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased` and `font-synthesis: none`.

**The 900px switch:**
- CSS: 900px and below is the "mobile" layout.
- JavaScript: `innerWidth < 900` counts as mobile. Rebuild the collage when this flips on resize.

**Page structure:**
- `body`: font-size 1.5rem, `touch-action: pan-y`, `overscroll-behavior: none`.
- A `.track` div 300lvh tall makes the page scrollable.
- The visible hero is `.stage`: `position: fixed`, inset 0, 100lvh tall, `overflow: hidden`, background `radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 50%, #111113 0%, #0a0a0b 55%, #050506 100%)`.
- A head script adds `locked` to `<html>` (`overflow: hidden` on `html` and `body`) so the page can't scroll during the intro. It also adds `touch` when `(hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)` matches.

**Type classes:**
- `.textH1`: Newsreader 400, letter-spacing −.03em, line-height 1.
- `.textH2`: Newsreader 400, 6rem, letter-spacing −.02em, line-height 1.2 (4rem at 900px and below).
- `.textLabelS`: Inter 400, 1.4rem, letter-spacing −.01em.

**Glass** (`.blurredBg`): `backdrop-filter: blur(2rem)`, background rgba(28,28,31,.62), radius 1.2rem.

---

## 4. DOM, in order, with measurements

1. **`<canvas class="gl">`** fills `.stage`.

2. **Intro title** `<h1 class="introTitle textH1">` with two spans side by side and no space between them: `.line1` "Kinetic" and `.line2` "Art".
   - Placement: absolutely centred (left 50%, top 50%, translate −50% −50%), flex row, centred, no wrap.
   - Size: font-size **8rem** (on mobile **4rem**, and the flex direction becomes a column).
   - Starts at opacity 0 with `pointer-events: none`.

3. **Breakout wrap** `.breakoutWrap`: absolute, full width, 100lvh tall, flex column, centred both ways, `pointer-events: none`. It holds:
   - **`.breakout`**:
     - Layout: relative, top −5%, width **90rem**, flex column centred, gap **3rem**, centred text, `text-wrap: pretty`, starts at opacity 0.
     - Eyebrow `<p class="breakout__sub textLabelS">`: "Hundreds of Designs, Rendered in Living Motion", weight 500, width **44rem**.
     - Headline `<h2 class="breakout__text textH2">`: "Here's how the Orrin Motion Library is reshaping how web pages move, one frame at a time." Text shadow `0 0 3rem rgba(10,10,11,.85)`. At 1440 wide it wraps to three lines.
   - **Button** `.breakoutBtn` (a sibling of `.breakout` inside the wrap):
     - Layout: relative, z-index 10, `visibility: hidden` until 3.5 s, `pointer-events: auto`, flex row with a 1rem gap, padding 1.5rem × 2rem, margin-top **3rem**.
     - Text: Inter 500 at 1.4rem, letter-spacing −.02em. Label "Scroll down", preceded by a 1.5rem down-arrow SVG (viewBox 0 0 15 15, stroke 1.3, path `M7.5 1.5v12 M2.5 8.5l5 5 5-5`).
     - Background: an absolute `.breakoutBtn__bg` glass layer that scales to **1.16** on hover over .8s with cubic-bezier(.215,.61,.355,1).
     - Clicking scrolls the window smoothly down by one viewport height.
   - **Mobile:** breakout width **30rem**, gap 2rem; headline **2.8rem** with line-height 1 (four lines); eyebrow width **16rem**, wrapping to three lines; button margin 0, font 1.1rem, gap .8rem, padding 1.2rem × 1.5rem, arrow 1.2rem.

4. **Wordmarks** (inside `.logos`, both `position: fixed`, z-index 999): Newsreader "Orrin", letter-spacing −.02em. The inner `.logo__mark` is a flex-centred box **10rem × 4rem** with font-size **4.4rem** (mobile: 5rem × 2rem at 2.2rem).
   - **`.logoCenter`:** at left 50%, top 50lvh; its mark is translated −50% −50%. It fades with a .8s opacity transition.
   - **`.logoLeft`:** at left 2rem, top 2rem, opacity 0. On desktop its mark is 7.4rem × 3rem at 3.3rem, left-aligned.
   - Once `scrollY > 50`, `.logos` gets `showLeftLogo`: the centre mark fades out in .2s and the left mark fades in over .8s.
   - Clicking either mark scrolls smoothly to the top.

5. **Nav** (fixed, inset 0, z 100, `pointer-events: none`):
   - **Menu button:** 4rem square at top 2rem, right 2rem, `pointer-events: auto`.
     - Its `:before` layer is the --ink fill with radius 1.2rem; it scales to 1.1 on hover over .8s with the same bezier, and turns #c9c5be when pressed.
     - Inside are two `<hr>` bars: 36% wide, 1.5px tall, --bg coloured, .6rem apart.
   - **Section dots:**
     - Box: a glass pill at right 2rem, vertically centred, 4rem × 9rem, radius 1rem, flex column with a .4rem gap.
     - Dots: three, each .5rem × .5rem with radius .25rem.
     - Each dot has a 10%-opacity track. The first dot is "active": it is 3rem tall with an .8s ease-in-out height transition, and its fill height is `var(--progress)` × 100%, driven by scroll progress.
   - **Mobile:** button at right 1rem; dots at right 1rem, top 45%, 2rem × 7rem.

6. **Credits popup** `.creditsPopup.blurredBg`, `aria-live="polite"`:
   - **Box:** fixed at right 2rem, bottom 2rem, z 100, flex with a 2rem gap, width **35.4rem**, padding 1.5rem 3.5rem 1.5rem 1.5rem. Starts at opacity 0 with `pointer-events: none`; `.active` turns pointer events on.
   - **Tutorial variant** `.creditsPopup--tutorial`: width auto, padding 2rem 5rem 2rem 2rem. It holds one `textLabelS` paragraph in --mute: "Click on any design to learn more." (touch or mobile: "Tap on any design to learn more.").
   - **Credit variant**, in order:
     - a close button: .8rem square at top 2rem, right 2rem, an X drawn with a 1.2 stroke;
     - a 4.6rem square thumbnail: the clip's own MP4 as a muted, looping, autoplaying `<video>` with `object-fit: contain` and `object-position: center top`, linked to the prompt;
     - a text column at 1.3rem with line-height 1.3, containing:
       - the title (Inter 500);
       - the line "<Category> · Orrin Motion Library";
       - a description in --mute with a 1rem top margin: an underlined "Open the prompt" link, then ", a live motion design, free to remix";
     - an 11px external-link icon at bottom 2rem, right 2rem, which fades in over .2s only while the link is hovered (desktop only).
   - **901–1600px:** gap 15px, padding 20px 35px 20px 20px, width 354px. Tutorial padding 2.4rem 6rem 2.4rem 1.8rem. Close button and icon at 20px.
   - **Mobile:** left and right 1.5rem, bottom 4.3rem, width auto. The tutorial is centred with padding 1.6rem × 2rem. No icon.

7. **Landscape warning:** a fixed full-screen --bg overlay at z 1000 showing "Rotate your device to portrait for the best view." in 10px text at 50% opacity, no wrap. It shows only on touch devices when `min-aspect-ratio: 13/9`.

---

## 5. The 3D scene

**Renderer and camera**
- WebGLRenderer with antialias and alpha (transparent, so the gradient shows through), pixel ratio min(dpr, 2), sRGB output, sized to the viewport.
- PerspectiveCamera: **fov 45**, near .1, far 100, at **(0, 0, 5)** with no rotation.
- Camera x and y follow a damped spring toward a target: acceleration = −100·(pos − target) − 30·velocity, integrated each frame with dt capped at .05 s.
- From 4.5 s, `cameraMotion` = **.25**. On pointer move (not on touch devices), the target is x = lerp(−.25, .25, clientX/W) and y = lerp(.25, −.25, clientY/H). Before that, and on touch devices, the target is (0, 0).
- Camera z is set directly by the scroll zoom (§7).

**Collage configuration** (desktop / mobile):

| Setting | Desktop | Mobile |
|---|---|---|
| columns × rows × layers | 3 × 25 × 2 (150 images) | 3 × 30 × 2 (180 images) |
| xSpacing / ySpacing / zSpacing | 2.8 / 1.3 / 1 | 1.7 / 1.5 / 1 |
| random size per image | 0.7 – 1.0 | 0.5 – 0.8 |
| repel radius | 1 | .46 |
| ribbon scale | .5 | .4 |
| start point | (.5, 0, 0) | (0, 0, 0) |
| centre-dim threshold \|x\| | 1 | .5 |

Derived values: grid width = (cols−1)·xSpacing; grid height = (rows−1)·ySpacing; depth = (layers−1)·zSpacing = 1.

**Seeded randomness.** Use a mulberry32 PRNG seeded at 20261108 at every build, so layout and timing are identical on every load. Clip order is a seeded shuffle of 0–15; image j shows clip `order[j mod 16]`.

**Each image j** (0 … count−1) is a nest of groups:
- **outer:** position plus intro scale;
- **holder:** a seeded random scale between min and max size;
- **inner:** the hover scale;
- **mesh:** a 1×1 plane scaled to (1, 10/16) so the 16:10 video sits inside a unit square.

**Grid slot** (a brick offset):
- `G = −width/2 − xSpacing/2`; on mobile also add `ae = .7` to y.
- col = j mod cols; row = ⌊(j mod (cols·rows)) / cols⌋; layer = ⌊j / (cols·rows)⌋.
- x = col·xSpacing + (row odd ? xSpacing/2 : 0) + (layer odd ? xSpacing/2 : 0) + G
- y = −row·ySpacing + (col odd ? ySpacing·.3 : 0) + (layer odd ? ySpacing/2 : 0) (+ .7 on mobile)
- z = −layer·zSpacing, so the front layer is at 0 and the back layer at −1.
- Only front-layer images (z ≠ −depth) are interactive.

**Ribbon slot:**
- mid = ⌊count/2⌋; At = mid − |j − mid|; z = zGrid·.01 − At·.005, so the middle of the ribbon sits deeper; xe = j/count.
- Desktop: x = lerp(−1.5, 1.5, xe) + .5, y = sin(2π·xe)·.7.
- Mobile: x = sin(2π·xe)·.35, y = lerp(−1, 1, xe) + .05 (a vertical S).

**Intro schedule.** Seeded-shuffle the images; for the image at shuffled position k:
- `d1 = −.1 + At·.008 + .2`: the ends of the ribbon arrive first and the middle about .6 s later;
- `d2 = 2.1 + k·.003`: the burst starts over a .45 s spread.

**Per frame**, with intro time t:
- k1 = power2.inOut over [d1, d1+1.5]; k2 = power2.inOut over [d2, d2+2].
- Intro scale = lerp(lerp(0, ribbonScale, k1), 1, k2). Hide the image while its scale is ≈ 0.
- **Rest position:**
  1. Take the grid slot and add the collage scroll offset to y (§7).
  2. Push it out of the **repel hole** at (0, .93 + scroll, 0): f = slot − repel; if |f.x| < .1, set f.x = .1; set f.z = 0; normalise f, scale it by the repel radius, and add it to the slot.
- Position = start, lerp to the ribbon slot by k1, then lerp to the rest position by k2.

**Material** (ShaderMaterial; transparent; `depthWrite: false`). Uniforms: `uTexture` (the clip's VideoTexture), `uDepth` = 1, `uDimmed`, `uRolloverPr`.
- **Vertex shader:** `vDepthFactor = smoothstep(−uDepth, −0.5, worldPosition.z)`; pass the uv.
- **Fragment shader**, with tex = texture2D(uTexture, vUv):
  1. `cDimmed = mix(vec3(0.003), tex.rgb, .5)`
  2. `cBack = mix(vec3(0.011), tex.rgb, .004)`. The back layer becomes near-blank plates just lighter than the page.
  3. `color = tex`
  4. `color.rgb = mix(color.rgb, cDimmed, uDimmed)`
  5. `color.rgb = mix(cBack, color.rgb, vDepthFactor)`
  6. `color.rgb = mix(color.rgb, tex.rgb, uRolloverPr)`
  7. `color.rgb = mix(cBack, color.rgb, tex.a)`
  8. `color.a = mix(1., tex.a, clamp(vDepthFactor + uRolloverPr, 0., 1.))`
  9. End with the `tonemapping_fragment` and `colorspace_fragment` includes.

  Cards in flight between layers fade smoothly between full video and blank plate.

---

## 6. Intro timeline (t in seconds; GSAP-equivalent easings)

Easings:
- power1.out = 1−(1−x)²
- power2.out = 1−(1−x)³
- power3.out = 1−(1−x)⁴
- power2.in = x³
- power2.inOut = x < .5 ? 4x³ : 1 − (−2x+2)³/2
- power3.inOut = x < .5 ? 8x⁴ : 1 − (−2x+2)⁴/2
- sine.inOut = −(cos πx − 1)/2

| t start | Duration | Element | Animation |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1.5 (power2.inOut) | Centre wordmark | translateY 0 → −45vh (from the screen centre to the top) |
| 0.1 | 1.5 (power3.inOut) | Intro title | opacity 0 → 1, scale .8 → 1 |
| 0 | 1.5 (power2.inOut) | "Kinetic" / "Art" | translateX 0 → −41vh / +50vh (mobile: translateY −30vh / +28vh) |
| ~0.1 – 0.9 | 1.5 each (power2.inOut) | 150 images | from the start point onto the ribbon, scale 0 → .5 (per d1) |
| 2.1 – 2.55 | 2 each (power2.inOut) | 150 images | from the ribbon into the grid, scale .5 → 1 (per d2) |
| 2.2 | 0.5 (power2.inOut) | "Kinetic" / "Art" | opacity 1 → 0 |
| 3.5 | 1.5 (power2.out) | Breakout | opacity 0 → 1, scale .8 → 1; the button turns visible at once |
| 4.0 | — | Hover | enabled |
| 4.5 | — | Scroll | `locked` removed, scrolling allowed, camera motion .25 |
| 6.5 | — | Hint pill | the tutorial shows, unless a design was already opened |

**Popup motion:**
- Show: after a .1 s delay, opacity 0 → 1 over .5 s (power1.out), scale .9 → 1 over 1.5 s (power3.out).
- Hide: opacity → 0 and scale → .9 over .3 s (power2.in); clear the contents once it's gone.
- Transform origin: bottom right (mobile: bottom centre).

**QA freeze:** the URL parameter `?t=<seconds>` pins the intro clock at that second, for checking frames and rendering recordings.

**Reduced motion** (`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`): start in the resting state (t treated as 99, the intro words hidden, no hover). Videos load, seek to 1.2 s and stay paused.

---

## 7. Scroll timeline (scrubbed)

**Progress:**
- Raw progress p = scrollY / (scrollHeight − innerHeight), clamped 0–1, and 0 while locked.
- Smooth it each frame: s += (p − s)·.1.
- Scroll time is ST = s·4.5.

| ST range | Effect |
|---|---|
| 0 – 1.5 (power2.out) | Camera z 5 → 4 (zoom in) |
| 0 – 1 (linear) | Breakout opacity 1 → 0 (the lower of this and its intro opacity applies). The breakout wrap moves translateY 0 → −75vh. |
| 1 – 2 (sine.inOut) | `uDimmed` 0 → 1 on images whose grid x is within ±1 (mobile ±.5) |
| all | Collage scroll: section progress = ST / 18.8; target = clamp(progress/.7)·gridHeight; scroll += (target − scroll)·.3 per frame. It is added to every grid y and to the repel point. |
| scrollY > 50 | Wordmark swaps to the top-left corner |
| all | First nav dot fill = s |

**Scrolling** means a scroll event in the last 150 ms, or s still catching up by more than .002. While scrolling:
- hover is off;
- an open credit card closes (the tutorial stays).

---

## 8. Hover and click

- **Hover** is live when t ≥ 4, not reduced motion, not scrolling, and the pointer's last move targeted the canvas.
  - Each frame, raycast from the pointer against the **front-layer** meshes only.
  - On the hit card: inner scale eases to **1.1** over .5 s (power1.out) and `uRolloverPr` to 1 over .2 s. Its `renderOrder` becomes 1 and `depthTest` turns off, so it draws over its neighbours. The stage gets `.hot` (`cursor: pointer` on the canvas).
  - On un-hover, both values ease back over the same durations.
- **Click** on the canvas (t ≥ 4): raycast the front layer the same way. A hit opens the credit card for that clip (§4.6). The tutorial never comes back after the first card opens. The close button hides the popup.

---

## 9. Acceptance checklist

- [ ] At 1440×900, `?t=0.4` shows "Orrin" centred with "Kinetic Art" faintly scaling in behind it.
- [ ] At `?t=1.5`, "Kinetic" and "Art" sit far apart with a dense sine ribbon of video cards between them, right of centre; "Orrin" is at the top.
- [ ] At `?t=3.2`, the cards are mid-burst toward the grid and the words are gone.
- [ ] At `?t=8`, the heading is three lines and the button sits under it. Live cards and faint blank plates are scattered around a clear centre, and the hint pill reads "Click on any design to learn more."
- [ ] Hovering a front card grows it; clicking opens its credit card, whose link and thumbnail work and whose close button works.
- [ ] Moving the mouse sways the camera on a spring, nearer cards more than farther ones.
- [ ] Scrolling zooms in, lifts the heading away, scrolls the gallery up, dims the centre column, moves the wordmark to the top-left and fills the first dot; scrolling back restores it all.
- [ ] At 390×844 the ribbon is vertical between the stacked "Kinetic" and "Art". At rest the eyebrow is three lines and the headline four, and a full-width "Tap on any design…" pill sits at the bottom.
- [ ] No console errors. All 16 MP4s, both fonts and three.module.js return 200.
```

Same nav links as buttons `flex items-center justify-between w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-lg text-sm`. Bottom CTA row: `flex gap-2 mt-2 pt-3 border-t border-white/10` with two `flex-1` buttons ("Log in", "Begin Now") matching desktop styles.

```markdown
**Hero content (bottom-left)** `absolute bottom-0 left-0 z-20 px-6 sm:px-12 pb-10 sm:pb-16 max-w-2xl`:
- `<h1>`: `text-white text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-medium leading-tight tracking-tight mb-4` — text: `Live Better, Feel Whole Every Day`.
- `<p>`: `text-white/60 text-sm leading-relaxed mb-7 max-w-md` — text: `Take charge of how you feel with a companion built for your journey—build routines, follow your growth, and unlock tailored insights for a steadier, more vibrant life each day.`
- Buttons row `flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3`:
  - "Start Today": `bg-white text-black text-sm sm:text-base font-medium px-6 sm:px-7 py-3 rounded-full hover:bg-white/90 transition-colors`
  - "Discover How": `liquid-glass text-white text-sm sm:text-base font-medium px-6 sm:px-7 py-3 rounded-full hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors`

**Animations/interactions:** all buttons use Tailwind `transition-colors`; liquid-glass effect uses `backdrop-filter: blur(4px)` plus the animated-looking gradient border pseudo. No additional keyframe animations. The background video itself provides motion.

**Dependencies:** `react`, `react-dom`, `lucide-react`, `tailwindcss`, `vite`, `@vitejs/plugin-react`, TypeScript. Tailwind configured with default content globs for `./index.html` and `./src/**/*.{ts,tsx}`.
```

```markdown
          </svg>

<script>
(function() {
  // Word reveal
  const headline = document.getElementById('headline');
  const text = "I build compelling visual stories & motion that make ideas shine.";
  const words = text.split(' ');
  words.forEach(function(word, i) {
    const span = document.createElement('span');
    span.className = 'word-reveal';
    span.textContent = word;
    span.style.animationDelay = (1 + i * 0.05) + 's';
    headline.appendChild(span);
  });

  // Burger menu toggle
  const burgerBtn = document.getElementById('burger-btn');
  const menuPanel = document.getElementById('menu-panel');
  let menuOpen = false;
  burgerBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
    menuOpen = !menuOpen;
    if (menuOpen) {
      burgerBtn.classList.add('open');
      menuPanel.classList.add('open');
      burgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Close menu');
    } else {
      burgerBtn.classList.remove('open');
      menuPanel.classList.remove('open');
      burgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Open menu');
    }
  });
  // Close menu on nav link click
  menuPanel.querySelectorAll('nav a').forEach(function(a) {
    a.addEventListener('click', function() {
      menuOpen = false;
      burgerBtn.classList.remove('open');
      menuPanel.classList.remove('open');
    });
  });

  // Spotlight reveal
  const SPOTLIGHT_R = 260;
  const canvas = document.getElementById('reveal-canvas');
  const imgLayer = document.getElementById('reveal-img');
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

  function resizeCanvas() {
    canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
    canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
  }
  resizeCanvas();
  window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas);

  const mouse = { x: -999, y: -999 };
  const smooth = { x: -999, y: -999 };

  window.addEventListener('mousemove', function(e) {
    mouse.x = e.clientX;
    mouse.y = e.clientY;
  });

  function loop() {
    smooth.x += (mouse.x - smooth.x) * 0.1;
    smooth.y += (mouse.y - smooth.y) * 0.1;

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

    var grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(smooth.x, smooth.y, 0, smooth.x, smooth.y, SPOTLIGHT_R);
    grad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,1)');
    grad.addColorStop(0.4, 'rgba(255,255,255,1)');
    grad.addColorStop(0.6, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)');
    grad.addColorStop(0.75, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)');
    grad.addColorStop(0.88, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.12)');
    grad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');

    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(smooth.x, smooth.y, SPOTLIGHT_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = grad;
    ctx.fill();

    var dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL();
    imgLayer.style.webkitMaskImage = 'url(' + dataUrl + ')';
    imgLayer.style.maskImage = 'url(' + dataUrl + ')';
    imgLayer.style.webkitMaskSize = '100% 100%';
    imgLayer.style.maskSize = '100% 100%';

    requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
```

### [FREE-005] Pixel Grid Hover (`pixel-grid-hover`)
- **Danh mục:** Case Studies | **Loại:** blog | **Độ dài:** 8,672 ký tự
- **Video Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/animated%20(15).webp
- **Poster 1280px:** —

```markdown
Build a "Projects / Case Studies" section as a React + TypeScript component using Tailwind CSS 3 and Framer Motion. Font is `'DM Sans', sans-serif` (Google Fonts: `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css?family=DM+Sans:500,400`). White background, black text. Here is the exact specification:

---

**Section Container:**
- `<section>` with `relative bg-white text-black`, inline style `fontFamily: "'DM Sans', sans-serif"`
- All animations use easing `[0.22, 1, 0.36, 1]`
- Inject a `<style>` block for the marquee keyframe:
  ~~~css
  @keyframes marqueeProjects {
    from { transform: translateX(0); }
    to   { transform: translateX(-50%); }
  }
  .marquee-projects {
    animation: marqueeProjects 28s linear infinite;
  }
  .marquee-projects:hover {
    animation-play-state: paused;
  }
  ~~~

---

**Top Area (Header with floating squares):**
- Container: `relative px-6 pb-10 pt-32 sm:px-10 lg:px-16 lg:pt-40`
- Contains a `pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden` layer with 8 parallax floating black squares. Each square uses `useScroll` (target: the section ref, offset `["start end", "end start"]`) and `useTransform` + `useSpring` for vertical parallax, plus a gentle infinite bob animation (`y: [0, -10, 0]`, duration `3s + index * 0.4s`, ease `easeInOut`, staggered delay `index * 0.3s`).
- Square positions (x%, y%, size px):
  ~~~
  (6, 20, 12), (12, 32, 8), (8, 44, 6), (88, 18, 10),
  (92, 30, 14), (85, 42, 7), (90, 52, 5), (14, 56, 5)
  ~~~
- Parallax formula: `useTransform(scrollYProgress, [0, 1], [0, -(80 + index * 30)])`, smoothed with `useSpring({ stiffness: 40, damping: 20 })`

**Header text** (centered, inside `relative mx-auto max-w-7xl text-center`):
- Animates from `opacity: 0, y: 24` to visible, duration `0.7s`, triggered by `useInView` with `{ once: true, margin: "-60px" }`
- Badge: "Projects" in `mb-5 inline-block bg-black px-4 py-1.5 text-[13px] font-medium tracking-wide text-white`
- Heading: `text-[clamp(1.8rem,3.2vw,2.8rem)] font-light leading-[1.25] tracking-tight`
  - "Insights from " in `text-black`, then "Our" in `text-black/40`
  - New line: "Case Studies" in `text-black/40`

---

**Case Study Cards (2x2 grid):**
- Container: `mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 pb-16 sm:px-10 lg:px-16`, inner `grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2`
- Each card animates from `opacity: 0, y: 30` to visible, staggered `delay: index * 0.1`, duration `0.7s`

**4 case studies data:**
~~~
1. id: "heartx", title: "HeartX", category: "Brand Strategy & Product Design", year: "2026"
   image: https://images.pexels.com/photos/7691249/pexels-photo-7691249.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800

2. id: "swave", title: "Swave\u00AE", category: "Web Design & Identity", year: "2025"
   image: https://images.pexels.com/photos/2559941/pexels-photo-2559941.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800

3. id: "eduspark", title: "EduSpark", category: "Brand Strategy & Web Design", year: "2023"
   image: https://images.pexels.com/photos/5428003/pexels-photo-5428003.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800

4. id: "greenergy", title: "Greenergy", category: "Brand Strategy & Web Design", year: "2022"
   image: https://images.pexels.com/photos/2800832/pexels-photo-2800832.jpeg?auto=compress&cs=tinysrgb&w=800
~~~

**Each card structure** (aspect ratio `4/3`, `group relative overflow-hidden`):

1. **Background image**: absolutely positioned, `h-full w-full object-cover`

2. **Pixel-block hover overlay**: A 12-column x 8-row grid of absolutely positioned `bg-black/80` blocks. Each block covers `100/12 %` width and `100/8 %` height. On hover they animate `scale: 0 -> 1, opacity: 0 -> 1` with a diagonal stagger: `delayIn = (row + col) * 0.018s`, `delayOut = ((8 - row) + (12 - col)) * 0.012s`. Duration `0.25s`. This creates a pixel-dissolve reveal effect on hover.

3. **Magnetic squares**: 5-6 small black squares per card, absolutely positioned. They react to the cursor via `useMotionValue` + `useTransform` + `useSpring`: when the card is hovered, each square shifts toward the pointer proportionally (`dist * 40`). Spring config: `{ stiffness: 80, damping: 18, mass: 0.6 }`. When pointer leaves, they spring back to center (pointer resets to `0.5, 0.5`).

   Square positions per card (x%, y%, size px):
   ~~~
   HeartX:    (5,30,16), (10,42,10), (3,52,7), (80,70,14), (85,82,9), (78,60,6)
   Swave:     (82,55,16), (88,68,10), (78,72,7), (85,42,6), (90,80,8)
   EduSpark:  (4,24,16), (10,36,10), (2,44,7), (78,78,14), (84,88,8)
   Greenergy: (82,26,14), (88,38,10), (78,44,7), (84,54,5), (90,60,8)
   ~~~

4. **Plus button** (top right): `absolute right-4 top-4`, `h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center border border-white/30 text-xs text-white`, "+" text, `zIndex: 10`

5. **Info plate** (bottom left): `absolute bottom-0 left-0 bg-white px-4 pb-3 pt-2.5`, `zIndex: 20`, `maxWidth: "70%"`
   - Title: `text-[clamp(1.4rem,2.2vw,2rem)] font-normal leading-tight text-black`
   - Below: flex row with category (`text-[12px] text-black/60`) and year (`text-[12px] font-medium text-black`), `mt-1.5 gap-4`

---

**Footer Area:**
- Container: `mx-auto max-w-7xl px-6 pb-6 sm:px-10 lg:px-16`
- Flex row on desktop (`md:flex-row md:items-end md:justify-between`), column on mobile

**Left side** (`max-w-md`):

- Paragraph: "We partner with ambitious brands that are ready to move beyond fragmented visuals and shallow quick fixes -- turning their identity, website, and messaging into one focused engine for growth." in `text-[14px] leading-[1.7] text-black/60`
```

```markdown
Build a 404 "Page Not Found" hero page as a single full-viewport (100vh, no scroll) React + Vite + Tailwind CSS application using the DM Sans font and Google Material Symbols Rounded icons. The page must match the following specification exactly:

---

## Fonts & External Resources

- **Google Material Symbols Rounded:** `opsz,wght,FILL,GRAD@24,400,1,0`

The entire page is exactly `100vh` with `overflow: hidden` on html, body, and `#root`. No scrolling. The body uses `display: flex; flex-direction: column`. The `#root` div also uses `height: 100vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden`.

---

## Background

Body has a layered background:
1. The spaceship PNG centered at `center 40%`, sized with `background-size: contain`
2. A `linear-gradient(to top left, #F5F5F5, #F7F7F7)` covering the full page

Both are `background-attachment: fixed` and `no-repeat`.

---

## Color Variables (CSS custom properties)

~~~
--text-main: #1a1a1a
--text-secondary: #888888
--bg-page: #F5F5F5
--card-bg: #ffffff
~~~

---

## Navbar

- Max-width `1100px`, centered, padding `28px 40px`
- Has a dashed bottom border made with `background-image: linear-gradient(to right, rgba(0,0,0,0.08) 2px, transparent 2px); background-size: 6px 1px` on a `::after` pseudo-element
- **Left:** Logo (the SVG image + the text "nexto." in 20px bold, -0.3px letter-spacing, color #111, flex with 9px gap)
- **Center:** Nav links ("Our Team", "Solutions" with a dropdown arrow character, "Showcase", "News") - 14px, weight 400, opacity 0.65, hover to opacity 1, gap 36px
- **Right:** CTA button "Let's Connect" - dark gradient button (`linear-gradient(180deg, #2c2c2c 0%, #111111 100%)`), white text 13px weight 500, border-radius 40px, padding `5px 16px 5px 5px`. Has a white circular arrow icon (24px circle) on the LEFT side with a chevron SVG inside. Box-shadow `0 4px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.15)`. On hover: translateY(-1px), stronger shadow, brightness(1.1).
- **Hamburger (mobile only):** 3 spans, 24px wide, 2px height, animates to X when active. Hidden on desktop, shown on mobile (`display: flex` at max-width 768px).

---

## Mobile Navigation

- Fixed full-screen overlay, slides in from right with `transform: translateX(100%)` -> `translateX(0)`, cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1) transition
- On mobile: left-aligned, large links (38px, weight 800, letter-spacing -1.5px), each with bottom border, padding 24px 0
- Last link is the CTA button styled same as navbar but with 32px arrow circle

---

## Main Content Area

- `flex: 1`, centered both ways (`align-items: center; justify-content: center`), max-width 700px, padding `20px 20px 30px`
- **Lost text:** "Seems you've wandered off..." - 15px, color `--text-secondary`, weight 400, margin-bottom 12px
- **Title wrapper:** `position: relative; display: inline-block; margin-bottom: 14px`
  - **Cloud decoration:** Material Symbols "cloud" icon, positioned `top: -18px; left: -24px`, font-size 42px, with gradient text fill (`linear-gradient(to bottom, #F7B2FB 50%, #786EF1 80%, #5588FB 100%)` using `-webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent`), white drop-shadow outline, `floatSlow` animation (5s, 0.3s delay)
  - **Heart decoration:** Material Symbols "favorite" icon, positioned `bottom: -15px; right: 20px`, font-size 32px, same gradient fill, white drop-shadow outline, `floatSlow` animation (4.5s, 1s delay)
  - **Title:** "Whoops! Nothing here yet" - `font-size: clamp(34px, 5vw, 52px)`, weight 500, letter-spacing -1.5px, line-height 1.08, color #0f0f0f
- **Subtext:** "Grab a 30-minute `chat` to explore your ideas, scope, and vision. We'll find common ground, sync and `define` a clear roadmap." - 14px, color `--text-secondary`, line-height 1.7, max-width 470px, margin-bottom 28px. The words "chat" and "define" are in highlighted tags (inline-flex, background #E0E2E7, 12.5px, weight 600, padding 2px 12px, border-radius 6px)

---

## Navigation Cards

- **Card 1 "Main Page":** House SVG icon (path: `M3 9.5L12 3l9 6.5V20a1 1 0 01-1 1H5a1 1 0 01-1-1V9.5z` with door `M9 21V12h6v9` in white). Subtitle: "Back where it all begins..."

- Icon container: 48px circle, background #eaecf0, scales 1.05 on card hover

- Card title: 15px weight 600, subtitle: 12px color `--text-secondary`

## Animations

~~~css
@keyframes floatSlow {

## Responsive Breakpoints

**768px and below:**
- Hide nav-links and desktop CTA button, show hamburger
```

```markdown
> - Text: `"shop {category name}"` in lowercase (e.g., "shop face", "shop beauty tools", "shop body").

>
> **Required CSS for `btn-primary` (in global stylesheet):**
> ~~~css
> .btn-primary {
>   position: relative;
>   overflow: hidden;
>   transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
> }
> .btn-primary::before {
>   content: '';
>   position: absolute;
>   inset: 0;
>   background: linear-gradient(120deg, transparent 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) 50%, transparent 100%);
>   transform: translateX(-100%);
>   transition: transform 0.5s ease;
> }
> .btn-primary:hover {
>   transform: translateY(-2px);
>   box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
> }
> .btn-primary:hover::before {
>   transform: translateX(100%);
> }
> .btn-primary:active {
>   transform: translateY(0);
>   box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
> }
> ~~~
>
> **IntersectionObserver hook (`useInView`):**
> - Accepts a `threshold` parameter (default `0.15`), uses a ref.
> - Observes the element; once `isIntersecting` is true, sets `isVisible = true` and unobserves (one-shot animation).
> - Returns `{ ref, isVisible }`.
> - This section calls it with threshold `0.1`.
```

```markdown
Build a full-screen hero section for a fictional vinyl record label called **"quietpress"** using React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Vite. The page is a single viewport-height hero with no scrolling. Use **lucide-react** for icons. No other UI libraries.

### Background: Boomerang Video Loop

Use this CloudFront video as the background:
~~~
https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20260611_183632_c311af08-e4b7-458f-81e7-79847a49b3d3.mp4
~~~

Create a `BoomerangVideoBg` component that:
1. Plays the video once (muted, playsInline, crossOrigin="anonymous"), capturing every frame into off-screen canvases (max width 960px, scaled proportionally).
2. Uses `requestVideoFrameCallback` when available, falling back to `requestAnimationFrame`.
3. When the video ends, hides the `<video>` element and renders a `<canvas>` that plays the captured frames in a ping-pong (boomerang) loop at 30fps -- forward then backward, endlessly.
4. The container is `absolute inset-0 z-0` with `scale-[1.08] origin-center overflow-hidden` to slightly zoom the video and hide edges.

---

### Liquid Glass CSS Effect

Create a reusable `.liquid-glass` CSS class:
~~~css
.liquid-glass {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
  background-blend-mode: luminosity;
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  border: none;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.liquid-glass::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  padding: 1.4px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg,
    rgba(255,255,255,0.45) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 20%,
    rgba(255,255,255,0) 40%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 60%,
    rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 80%, rgba(255,255,255,0.45) 100%);
  -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
  mask-composite: exclude;
  pointer-events: none;
}
~~~

---

### Fade-Up Entrance Animation

~~~css
@keyframes fade-up {
  from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
  to   { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
}
.animate-fade-up {
  animation: fade-up 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) backwards;
}
.delay-1 { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
.delay-2 { animation-delay: 0.25s; }
.delay-3 { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
.delay-4 { animation-delay: 0.55s; }
.delay-5 { animation-delay: 0.75s; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .animate-fade-up { animation: none; }
}
~~~

**CRITICAL:** Use `animation-fill-mode: backwards` (not `both` or `forwards`). Using `both` or `forwards` leaves a `transform` on the element after the animation ends, which breaks `backdrop-filter` on any child using `.liquid-glass`. `backwards` applies the "from" state before the animation starts but fully releases all properties when it finishes, so the glass blur works correctly.
```

```markdown
## ICON PIPELINE (the animated centerpiece)

Container `.icon-pipeline`: `position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; max-width: 700px; margin-bottom: 52px; z-index: 1;`

Children in this exact order:

1. **`<svg class="beam-svg">`** — absolutely-positioned over the whole pipeline (`overflow: visible`), containing:
   - A `<filter id="glow">` with `feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="2"` then `feComposite ... operator="over"`.
   - A `<linearGradient id="beam-gradient" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse">` with stops:
     - `0%` `#b04090` opacity 0
     - `20%` `#b04090` opacity 0.8
     - `50%` `#fff` opacity 1
     - `80%` `#c8a0e0` opacity 0.8
     - `100%` `#c8a0e0` opacity 0
   - Two `<path>` elements both stroked with `url(#beam-gradient)`:
     - Glow path: `stroke-width="2"`, `filter="url(#glow)"`, `opacity: 0.6`.
     - Core path: `stroke-width="0.8"`.

2. **Left node** `.icon-node.node-light-right` (id `node-stack`) — Lucide-style **layers** SVG (3 stacked diamonds): `<polygon points="12 2 2 7 12 12 22 7 12 2"/><polyline points="2 17 12 22 22 17"/><polyline points="2 12 12 17 22 12"/>`.

3. **`.pipeline-line`** — `width: 160px; height: 1px;` linear gradient `90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.15), rgba(255,255,255,0.07)`.

4. **Center wrapper** with `position: relative;` containing:

5. **`.pipeline-line.right`** — same 160×1 line, gradient reversed.

6. **Right node** `.icon-node.node-light-left` (id `node-shield`) — Lucide-style **shield-check** SVG: `<path d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10z"/><polyline points="9 12 11 14 15 10"/>`.

~~~

## BEAM ANIMATION (JavaScript / requestAnimationFrame)

Implement a state machine with four phases. On mount and on every window `resize`, recompute the SVG path:

~~~
const pRect = pipeline.getBoundingClientRect();
const sRect = nodeStack.getBoundingClientRect();
const xRect = nodeX.getBoundingClientRect();
const shRect = nodeShield.getBoundingClientRect();
const startX = sRect.left + sRect.width/2 - pRect.left;
const startY = sRect.top  + sRect.height/2 - pRect.top;
// midX/midY from nodeX, endX/endY from nodeShield
const d = `M ${startX},${startY} L ${midX},${midY} L ${endX},${endY}`;
~~~
Set this `d` on **both** beam paths.

The gradient is animated by mutating `x1` / `x2` of `#beam-gradient` (in `userSpaceOnUse`) so the bright window slides along. Use `halfWidth = 5` (percentage units), `center = percentage * 100`:
~~~
gradient.x1 = (center - 5) + '%'
gradient.x2 = (center + 5) + '%'
y1 = y2 = '0%'
~~~

State machine in a `requestAnimationFrame` loop, tracking `lastStateChange` timestamp:

| State | Duration | Behavior |
|---|---|---|
| **`p1`** | 800 ms | `percentage` interpolates `0 → 0.5`. While `p < 0.4`, add `.active` to `node-stack`; remove after. At end: switch to `splash`, hide both beam paths (`opacity: 0`), add `.animate` to splash. |
| **`splash`** | 800 ms | Wait. After elapsed: switch to `p2`, remove `.animate`, restore `opacity: 1` on both beam paths. |
| **`p2`** | 800 ms | `percentage` interpolates `0.5 → 1.0`. While `p > 0.6`, add `.active` to `node-shield`. At end: remove `.active`, switch to `idle`. |
| **`idle`** | 1000 ms | Wait, then loop back to `p1`. |

Total cycle ≈ 3.4 seconds, infinite.
```

```markdown
## Page Structure & Layers (z-index order)

### Navigation (z-50, fixed)
- **Logo (top-left):** Custom SVG geometric logo (white, 28x28), resembling angular interlocking shapes. The exact SVG path: `M 256 64 L 256 128 L 192.5 128 L 160 95 L 128 64 L 96 95 L 63.5 128 L 64 128 L 128 192 L 128 256 L 64.5 256 L 32 223 L 0 192 L 0 64 L 64 0 L 192 0 Z M 256 192 L 256 256 L 192.5 256 L 160 223 L 128 192 L 128 128 L 192 128 Z` (viewBox 0 0 256 256, fill white)
- **Desktop center pill nav (hidden on mobile):** Fixed horizontally centered, contains buttons: "Device", "Real Stories", "Science", "Plans", "Reach Us". Uses `.liquid-glass` styling (frosted glass). Buttons are `text-white/70`, `text-sm`, `font-medium`, rounded-full, hover to white.
- **Desktop CTA (top-right, hidden on mobile):** `.liquid-glass` pill button with a small green dot (w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-green-400) and text "Reserve Yours", white text-sm font-medium.
- **Mobile hamburger (top-right, hidden md+):** `.liquid-glass` rounded-full pill, contains two white lines (w-5 h-[1.5px] and w-3.5 h-[1.5px]).

### Mobile Fullscreen Menu (z-55)
- Background: `#0a0a0a` solid
- Close button: top-right, `.liquid-glass` rounded-full with X made of two rotated white lines (+45deg, -45deg)
- Nav items stacked vertically, centered, `text-3xl sm:text-4xl`, white/90, font-medium
- "Reserve Yours" CTA at bottom with green dot, `.liquid-glass` pill
- Staggered entry animations: each item slides up from 24px with opacity 0->1, delays incremented by 60ms starting at 100ms. Uses `cubic-bezier(0.77, 0, 0.18, 1)` easing. Close button rotates in from -90deg with scale 0.8.

### Hero Section (100vh, overflow hidden)

**Layer 1 — Grid Background (z-0, opacity 0.1):**
- SVG with a repeating pattern of 48px cells. Pattern draws an L-shaped path (`M 48 0 L 0 0 0 48`), stroke `#64748b`, strokeWidth 0.6, no fill.
- The grid subtly parallax-shifts based on cursor position (offset calculated as cursor position relative to section center * 16, eased at 0.06 factor).

**Layer 2 — Background Image (z-10):**
- `BG_IMAGE_1` displayed as `background-image`, `bg-center bg-cover bg-no-repeat`, absolutely positioned inset-0.

**Layer 3 — Hero Text (z-20):**
- The word "Measured" in huge uppercase text
- Font: `'Instrument Serif', serif`
- Sizes: `text-[4.5rem]` default, `xs:text-[5.5rem]`, `sm:text-[10rem]`, `md:text-[13rem]`, `lg:text-[16rem]`
- `leading-[0.9]`, white, centered, positioned `top-20 sm:top-28 md:top-32`

**Layer 4 — Overlay Image (z-25):**
- `OVERLAY_IMAGE` as an `<img>` tag, absolutely positioned inset-0, `w-full h-full object-cover`, pointer-events-none. This is a semi-transparent PNG that sits on top of the background to add depth/atmosphere.

**Layer 5 — Spotlight Reveal (z-30):**
- A cursor-following radial reveal mask that shows a video underneath only where the cursor hovers.
- **Radius:** 260px
- **Mask gradient stops:** center full white (0-40%), then feathers out: 60% at 0.75 alpha, 75% at 0.4, 88% at 0.12, 100% at 0 (fully transparent).
- **Implementation:** A hidden `<canvas>` draws the radial gradient at the smoothed cursor position. The canvas is exported as a dataURL and applied as a CSS mask (`-webkit-mask-image` / `mask-image`) on a div that contains the video.
- **Cursor smoothing:** Uses `requestAnimationFrame` loop with lerp factor 0.1 (`smooth += (target - smooth) * 0.1`).
- **Video placement:** The video (`FRONT_VIDEO`) is clipped to the bottom 60% of the viewport using `clipPath: 'inset(40% 0 0 0)'`. It autoplays, loops, is muted, and uses playsInline.

## Liquid Glass CSS Effect (`.liquid-glass`)

~~~css
.liquid-glass {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
  background-blend-mode: luminosity;
  backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  border: none;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.liquid-glass::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  padding: 1.4px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg,
    rgba(255,255,255,0.45) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 20%,
    rgba(255,255,255,0) 40%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 60%,
    rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 80%, rgba(255,255,255,0.45) 100%);
  -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
  -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
  mask-composite: exclude;
  pointer-events: none;
}
~~~

This creates a near-invisible frosted glass background with a subtle gradient border using the mask-composite trick (border-only gradient).

---

## Key Behaviors

1. **Body overflow locks** when mobile menu is open
2. **No scrolling** — single viewport hero only
3. **Background is white** on the root container (`bg-white`), but the hero section fills the entire viewport with dark imagery
4. **The reveal effect only shows video in the bottom 60%** of the screen (the top 40% is masked out via clipPath), so hovering over the top portion shows nothing extra — just the base layers

---

## Summary of the Visual Effect

The user sees a dark, atmospheric product shot (wearable device on a wrist) with "Measured" in giant serif text overlaid. A semi-transparent overlay adds haze/depth. As the user moves their cursor, a soft spotlight circle reveals an underlying looping video (showing the product in motion) — but only in the lower portion of the screen. The grid background subtly shifts with parallax. Navigation uses an elegant frosted-glass pill aesthetic.
```

```markdown
=====================================================================
6. HOVER-REVEAL EFFECT (JavaScript, wrapped in an IIFE)
=====================================================================
Concept: a paint-brush trail follows the pointer. Inside the trail, the FRONT image is fully erased and the BACK (pink biker) image shows instead, so the front never shows through transparent parts of the back. Each brush stamp is an organic blob made of several overlapping circles with hard edges, so the edges look torn. The stamp holds for a moment, then shrinks and disappears.

Setup:
- Read #hero, #figure, #front (img), #reveal (canvas), #cursor.
- Touch detection must be LIVE: const touchMQ = matchMedia("(hover: none), (pointer: coarse)"); let coarse; syncTouch() sets coarse = touchMQ.matches and sets #hintText to "Drag to suit up" (touch) or "Move your cursor to suit up" (mouse). Call it once, then on touchMQ "change".
- Two offscreen canvases: `mask` (the brush trail) and `buf` (the back image clipped to the mask).
- back = new Image(), src = BACK_URL; set backReady=true on load.
- frontReady = true when #front has loaded (check front.complete && front.naturalWidth, otherwise listen for "load"); then add class "ready" to the canvas.
- resize(): r = figure.getBoundingClientRect(); dpr = min(devicePixelRatio, 2); W=r.width; H=r.height; set canvas/mask/buf width = round(W*dpr) and height = round(H*dpr). Call it on load and on window resize.

Stamps:
- LIFE = 1100 ms.
- addStamp(x, y, now): base = max(W, 260) * (coarse ? 0.15 : 0.12); n = 3 + random 0..2 lobes; each lobe gets a random angle, offset distance random*base*0.45, and radius base*(0.45 + random*0.55). Push { x, y, t: now, lobes }.
- pointerTo(clientX, clientY, now): convert to figure-local coordinates. If a previous point exists, interpolate between it and the new point with step = max(W,260)*0.04, capped at 40 stamps, so fast moves leave a continuous stroke. Then add a stamp at the point, set last = {x, y} and lastMove = now.
- Events on #hero: "pointermove" calls pointerTo, moves #cursor with transform translate(clientX px, clientY px) and adds class "on". "pointerleave" sets last=null and removes "on". "pointerdown" calls pointerTo.
- Auto-wander (only when coarse, i.e. touch devices): if there has been no pointer input for 2500 ms, autoT += 0.016; x = W*(0.5 + sin(autoT*1.3)*0.28); y = H*(0.32 + sin(autoT*0.9 + 1)*0.22). Add a stamp whenever the point has moved more than W*0.02 from the last one.

Render loop (requestAnimationFrame):
1. If coarse, call autoWander. Remove stamps older than LIFE.
2. Mask: mctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0), clear it, fill black. For each stamp: k = 1 - age/LIFE; scale = k < 0.75 ? k/0.75 : 1. Draw each lobe as a filled circle at (s.x + dx*scale, s.y + dy*scale) with radius r * scale^0.8.
3. Main canvas: reset the transform, use source-over, clear. If frontReady, drawCover(ctx, front).
4. If any stamps exist:
   a. ctx "destination-out": draw mask (erases the front inside the trail). Switch back to source-over.
   b. If backReady: clear buf, draw mask into buf, set bctx "source-in", drawCover(bctx, back), then ctx.drawImage(buf, 0, 0).
- drawCover(c, img): cover-fit the image into canvas.width x canvas.height, centred horizontally and anchored to the BOTTOM, so both layers line up exactly.

=====================================================================
7. RESULT CHECKLIST
=====================================================================
- Baby-pink light theme. The two uppercase marquee rows move in opposite directions BEHIND the cut-out girl: light grey "DREAM RIDE SPARKLE" moving left, bold black "RIDE PRETTY STAY BOLDER" moving right.
- Moving the mouse paints a torn brush trail that swaps her into the pink helmet and jacket. The trail fades after about 1.1 s.
- Inside the trail, the front image is never visible.
- No drop shadows on the logo or the button, and no glowing or pulsing circles: all dots are flat solid pink.
- On mobile: the nav shows only the logo and "Say hi!", the figure is enlarged, the hint becomes a centred pill reading "Drag to suit up", and the reveal wanders on its own when the screen is idle. No horizontal scroll.
```

```markdown
# VirtualFit: Spatial Try-On Arc (exact recreation prompt)

Build a single-screen, visionOS-style virtual try-on hero called **VirtualFit**.

- **Scene:** a softly blurred bright living room fills the screen. A man stands in the centre, cut off at mid-thigh, in front of a huge ghosted `FIT` word.
- **Garment arc:** frosted-glass garment cards curve around him in a 3D arc. They recede, shrink, tilt and blur toward the edges and bob gently. You can drag, flick, scroll, use the arrow keys or buttons, or click a card.
- **Try-on:** when the arc settles on a garment, a glowing horizontal scan line sweeps down the model with a faint scan-line grid and reveals him wearing that garment.
- **Controls:** a glass pill tab bar sits at the top, a glass tool rail on the left, and a glass buy card at the bottom (thumbnail, rolling name and price, size chips and colour dots).
- **Cursor:** a 58px glass cursor reads `TRY ON` over cards and `DRAG` over empty space.

Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS in one file, with no libraries. Reproduce every value, string, timing and URL exactly.

---

## 1. Page basics

- `<html lang="en">`, title `VirtualFit: Spatial Try-On`, viewport `width=device-width,initial-scale=1`.
- **Font:** Inter 400, 500, 600, 700, 800 and 900 from `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap`, with preconnects to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com (crossorigin). The standalone version embeds the latin woff2 as base64 `@font-face` rules instead.
- **Reset:** `*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}`. `html,body{height:100%}`.
- **`body`:** background `#e9e4dc`, colour `#fff`, Inter, `overflow:hidden`, antialiased, `user-select:none`.
- **Buttons:** reset to inherit font and colour, no background and no border.
- On `(pointer:fine)`, `cursor:none` on html, body and buttons.
- **CSS variables:**
  - `--ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`
  - `--sans:"Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif`
  - `--MH:min(78vh,62vw)` (model height; `min(62vh,128vw)` below 768px)
  - `--CW`, the card width, set by JS
  - the three image variables in section 2

## 2. Assets (use these exact URLs)

| Variable | URL | What it is |

| `--room` | `https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261104_080623_c94c85a3-23d5-4a0c-afff-41be1b5b8191.png&w=2400&q=85` | Bright Scandinavian living room, 16:9. Big window with plants at left, beige sofa and round coffee table lower left, white wall with leaf shadows in the middle, a plant in a grey pot and an oak shelf with books at right, oak floor with a cream rug. |

The same man (short dark hair, trimmed beard, charcoal trousers) five times side by side, from head to mid-thigh, in: a white crew tee, an oversized white sweatshirt, a white linen shirt, a heather-grey hoodie, and a white ringer tee with black trims. |

Top row: white tee, white sweatshirt, white linen shirt. Bottom row: grey hoodie, ringer tee, navy tee (the navy tee is unused). |

**Crops:**

## 3. Data

~~~js
const ITEMS=[
  {n:"Basic T-shirt", p:45,  g:[1.14,3.06],  m:.37,   c:[["White","#f4f2ee"],["Ash","#c9c7c2"],["Charcoal","#3b3c3f"],["Navy","#27324d"]]},

  {n:"Linen Shirt",   p:95,  g:[98.2,3.33],  m:49.86, c:[["White","#f7f6f1"],["Sand","#d9ccb4"],["Sky","#bcd0e2"],["Olive","#717556"]]},
  {n:"Grey Hoodie",   p:110, g:[1.14,93.3],  m:74.77, c:[["Heather","#a9a9a8"],["Bone","#e6e1d6"],["Forest","#33463a"],["Black","#1f1f21"]]},
  {n:"Ringer Tee",    p:55,  g:[49.7,95.3],  m:99.35, c:[["White / Black","#f4f2ee"],["Cream / Navy","#efe6d3"],["Grey / Red","#c9c7c2"],["White / Green","#e9efe8"]]},

- `g` is the garment `background-position` (x%, y%).
- `m` is the model `background-position-x` (%).
- There are 10 cards in all (two copies of the 5 items, so the arc loops seamlessly).

## 4. Layers and styling

1. **`.room`** (fixed, inset -3%): the room on `center/cover`, `filter:blur(2.5px) saturate(1.05)`, `transform:scale(1.08)`. An `::after` overlay adds `radial-gradient(70% 60% at 50% 45%, rgba(255,252,246,.10), rgba(40,30,20,.16))`.
2. **`.ghost`** (fixed, z 2): `FIT` with each letter in its own inline-block span.
   - Position: centred at `top:calc(50% − MH×.42)`.
   - Font: Inter 900 at `MH×.42`, line-height .8, letter-spacing -.04em.
   - Colour `rgba(255,255,255,.3)`, a 1px stroke `rgba(255,255,255,.35)`, and text-shadow `0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35)`.
3. **Glass material `.glass`** (used by the tabs, rail, arrows, cards and buy card):
   - background `linear-gradient(155deg, rgba(250,248,245,.30), rgba(150,144,136,.20) 48%, rgba(205,200,192,.24))`
   - `backdrop-filter:blur(22px) saturate(1.5)`
   - border `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.5)`
   - shadows `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.7), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.12), 0 20px 50px -24px rgba(40,30,20,.45)`
4. **Tabs `.tabs.glass`:**
   - Layout: fixed, centred, top 4.2vh, z 30, padding 5px, radius 999px, gap 2px.
   - Buttons: `Tops` (active), `Bottoms`, `Outerwear`, `Shoes`, `Accessories`. Each is 38px tall with 0 22px padding, Inter 500 14px, colour `rgba(30,30,32,.72)`; the active one is `#111`.
   - A sliding white pill (`rgba(255,255,255,.92)`, shadow `0 4px 14px -6px rgba(0,0,0,.3)`) sits under the active tab. It moves with `transform` and `width` over .6s `--ease`.
5. **Rail `.rail.glass`:**
   - Layout: fixed, left `max(18px,1.8vw)`, vertically centred, padding 8px, gap 10px, radius 999px.
   - Four 42px round buttons with 20px icons: a filled tee (active: white `rgba(255,255,255,.9)` disc, colour #111), a cart, a calendar and a profile.
   - Inactive icons are `rgba(30,30,32,.8)` and hover to `rgba(255,255,255,.35)`.
6. **Stage `.stage`** (fixed, inset 0, z 10, `touch-action:pan-y`) holds `.arc` at the centre.
   - Each `.card.glass` is `CW` wide and `CW×1.42` tall, centred on the arc origin, radius 22px, overflow hidden.
   - Inside each card:
     - Garment image `.g`: left/right 8%, top 5%, height 66%, `drop-shadow(0 14px 14px rgba(40,30,20,.22))`.
     - Name: Inter 500 at `CW×.068`, bottom 17%.
     - Price `$NN`: Inter 700 at `CW×.095`, bottom 7%.

7. **Model `.model`** (fixed, centred, bottom 0, height `--MH`, `aspect-ratio:524/1360`, z 50, no pointer events). Layers:

Gradient `transparent → #fff 18% → #fff 82% → transparent`, glow `0 0 18px 4px rgba(255,255,255,.75), 0 0 60px 10px rgba(190,225,255,.45)`. Its `::after` trails a `MH×.12` tall wash, `linear-gradient(to top, rgba(220,238,255,.32), transparent)`, above it.
8. **Arrows:** 46px glass circles with 16px chevrons in `#222`, vertically centred. Left one at `calc(max(18px,1.8vw) + 76px)`, right one at `max(18px,1.8vw)`. Hidden on phones.
9. **Buy card `.buy.glass`:**

   - **Thumbnail:** 64px, radius 14px, `rgba(255,255,255,.3)`, garment inset 6px.
   - **Info:** name in Inter 600 16px; price in Inter 500 14px at .9 opacity. Each sits in a `.ln` mask, 1.15em tall with overflow hidden, so text can roll.
   - **`Size`** label (Inter 500 12px, .85 opacity), then 30px round chips `S` `M` `L` `XL`. They are `rgba(255,255,255,.22)` with white text; the active one (`M` at start) is white with #111 text; pressing one scales it to .9.
   - **Colour:** the label `Color · <name>` rolls when it changes. Below it are four 18px dots in the item's colours. The active dot has a ring: `0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.95), 0 0 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,.12)`.
10. **Cursor `.cur`** (58px, fixed, z 100):
    - Ring: 1.5px `rgba(255,255,255,.95)` border, `rgba(255,255,255,.14)` fill, `backdrop-filter:blur(6px)`, shadow `0 6px 20px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.35)`.
    - A 6px white dot in the centre.
    - Hidden labels in Inter 700 10px, letter-spacing .12em: `TRY ON` (#111) and `DRAG` (white).
    - It follows the pointer with `pos += (target − pos) × .22`.
    - Over a card (`try`): the ring scales to 1.5 and fills `rgba(255,255,255,.92)`, and `TRY ON` scales in.
    - Over empty stage or while dragging (`drag`): the ring scales to 1.2 and `DRAG` shows.
    - Over a button (`btn`): the ring scales to .6.
    - Pointer down: 1.05.
    - Transitions: ring .5s, dot .4s, text .45s, all `--ease`.

## 5. Arc maths (every animation frame)

**State:** `pos` (float), `target` (int). When not dragging, `pos += (target − pos) × .11`.

**Card offset:** for card `i`, `u = mod(i − pos + 5, 10) − 5`. Let `a = |u|` and `sg = sign(u)`.

**Horizontal placement:**
- Table `XS = [0, .215, .345, .432, .49, .52] × W` (phones: `[0, .36, .5, .56, .6, .62] × W`).
- `xAt(a)` interpolates linearly through that table.
- `x = sg × xAt(a) × ie`, where `ie` is the intro ease (below).

**Per-card values:**
- **Behind the model** (`a < 1`): `s = .55 + .45a`, `z = −260(1 − a)`, opacity `a`, `ry = −sg × 16a`.
- **Otherwise:** `s = 1 / (1 + .3(a − 1)^1.15)`, `z = −110(a − 1)`, `ry = −sg × (16 + 9 × min(2, a − 1))`, blur `max(0, a − 1.6) × 2.4` px.
- **Far edge** (`a > 3.4`): opacity `1 − (a − 3.4)/.8`.
- **Bob:** `sin(t × 1.1 + seed) × H × .006 × min(1, a)`. `y = bob − (1 − s) × H × .04`.
- **Pointer tilt:** `ry += sx × 10`, where `sx` and `sy` are the smoothed pointer offsets in [-.5, .5], smoothed by `× .06`.

**Transform:** `translate(x, y) perspective(1300px) translateZ(z) rotateY(ry) rotateX(−sy × 6) scale(s × (.6 + .4ie))`. Each card carries its own perspective; there is no shared `preserve-3d` scene, which keeps the backdrop blur from flickering.

**Stacking and visibility:** z-index is 1 behind the model, otherwise `round(100 − 10a)`. A card is hidden when its opacity is below .01. Card opacity is multiplied by `ie`.

**Intro:** `intro += .012` per frame, and `ie = 1 − (1 − intro)³`. The cards spread out from the centre and scale up.

**Parallax:**
- Room: `translate3d(−sx × 22px, −sy × 14px, 0) scale(1.08 − .03ie)`.
- Ghost word: `translate(calc(−50% − sx × 40px), −sy × 16px)`.
- Ghost letters rise in: letter `i` gets `translateY((1 − ie)(60 + 30i)px)`.

**Settle:** when `|target − pos| < .02` and `mod(round(target), 5)` differs from the outfit shown (and nothing is being dragged), run try-on for that item.

## 6. Try-on scan (950 ms, `cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)`)

1. Update the buy card, cancel any running scan, and set `#mNext` to the new figure.
2. Run these Web Animations together:
   - **`#mNext` clip:** `inset(0 0 100% 0)` → `inset(0 0 0% 0)` over 950ms, fill forwards.
   - **`.grid` clip:** `inset(0 0 100% 0)` → `inset(0 0 0 0)` at 50% → `inset(100% 0 0 0)` over 1092ms.
   - **`.scan`:** top 0%, `scaleX(.2)`, opacity 0 → top 6%, `scaleX(1)`, opacity 1 at 8% → top 94% at 92% → top 100%, `scaleX(.2)`, opacity 0.
   - **`#mNext` settle:** `scale(1.012)` → 1 over 1250ms, ease-out.
3. When the clip animation finishes, copy the figure to `#mCur` and cancel all four animations.

On load, `#mCur` stays hidden and the first scan reveals the model from nothing.

## 7. Buy card updates

- **Name, price and colour label** roll: the old text animates `translateY(0)` → `−110%` while the new text animates `110%` → `0`, over 620ms with `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`.
- **Thumbnail:** jumps to the new crop and animates from `translateY(70%) scale(.8)` over 650ms.
- **Colour dots:** rebuilt from the item's colours with the first one active. Clicking a dot rolls the label to `Color · <name>`.
- **Size chips:** clicking one sets it active.

## 8. Input

- **Drag:** pointerdown on the stage starts a drag. `pos = p0 − dx / XS[1]` (one card per arc step), and the velocity is tracked in px/ms. On release, `target = round(pos − flick × 3.2)`.
- **Click:** a click (moved under 6px) on a card sets `target` so that card comes to the centre.
- **Wheel:** horizontal or vertical delta builds up past 60, then steps ±1 with at least 260ms between steps.
- **Keys and buttons:** arrow keys and the arrow buttons step ±1.
- **Tabs:** clicking a tab slides the pill to it and adds 5 to `target`, so the arc does a full lap and lands back on the same garment.

## 9. Phones (≤767px) and reduced motion

- **Phones:**
  - The tabs shrink to 32px with 0 13px padding and 12px text, and scroll sideways.
  - The rail moves to bottom left (`left:10px`, `bottom:calc(4.6vh + 150px)`) with 34px buttons.
  - The arrows are hidden.
  - The buy card wraps onto two lines.
- **Reduced motion:**
  - The spring snaps straight to the target and the intro is instant.
  - No bob and no sheen.
  - The scan is skipped: the outfit swaps instantly.
  - The buy card text swaps without rolling.
```

```markdown
# Nectarline — exact recreation prompt

Build a single-file, five-section landing page called **Nectarline** ("Supply Side Studio®"), a fictional self-serve programmatic-media curation product. The page sits on top of a fixed, full-viewport scene: a looping dusk lotus-pond video in the hero (drawn through a WebGL hover-ripple lens), which crossfades to a deep violet gradient for the middle sections and to a night version of the pond behind the footer. A 3D crystal-glass koi fish (a real GLB model rendered with Three.js) swims through every section, its position, size and heading driven by scroll, and its body bending in a swimming wave. All UI is ordinary HTML laid over that scene. Recreate it exactly as specified below: every text, colour, size, position, timing and formula is the real one.

Everything is one HTML file: inline CSS, two inline scripts (one classic, one ES module), Three.js from a CDN import map. No build step, no framework.

## 4. Scaling system

One design unit, u, is derived from a 1440 px wide frame: u = content width / 1440 on screens wider than 820 px, and content width / 390 at 820 px and below. Use the document's clientWidth (which excludes the scrollbar), set by script as the CSS custom property --u in px on load and on resize (the stylesheet fallback is 100vw/1440, or 100vw/390 in the small-screen query). Every desktop measurement below is in u; "40u" means calc(40 × var(--u)). On phones most rules switch to fixed px values (section 12).

## 5. The fixed scene stack (behind everything)

A fixed full-viewport container, z-index 0, pointer-events none, overflow hidden, aria-hidden. It holds four layers, each absolutely filling it, in this order (back to front):

1. **Day plate**: background-image = day plate, cover, centred; will-change opacity and transform. Inside it: the pond video (absolute, 100%×100%, object-fit cover, opacity 0, transition opacity 1.2 s ease; it only becomes visible if WebGL is unavailable, by gaining a class that sets opacity 1), then the ripple canvas "pondfx" (absolute, 100%×100%, block, opacity 0, transition opacity 1.2 s ease; it gets opacity 1 on the video's first "playing" event).
2. **Violet layer**: background linear-gradient(180deg, #160c40 0%, #0f0832 50%, #0b0626 100%), opacity 0. It is a flat gradient with no radial glows or blobs.
3. **Night plate**: background-image = night plate, cover, centred, opacity 0. A ::after overlay darkens it for footer legibility: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(13,8,40,.15) 0%, transparent 30%, rgba(13,8,40,.6) 58%, rgba(11,6,34,.94) 100%).
4. **Koi canvas**: a full-viewport transparent WebGL canvas (Three.js renderer, alpha true, antialias true).

Main content is position relative, z-index 1, above the scene.

**Scroll crossfade** (runs on scroll and resize; h = viewport height, y = scrollY, smoothstep(a,b,v) = t²(3−2t) with t = clamp((v−a)/(b−a))):
- toViolet = smoothstep(0.15h, 1.05h, y).
- Day plate opacity = 1 − toViolet; its transform = scale(1 + 0.08·toViolet) translateY(−0.06·y px) (a slow push-in and parallax as you leave the hero).
- toNight = smoothstep(endTop − 1.1h, endTop − 0.1h, y), where endTop is the CTA/footer section's offsetTop.
- Violet layer opacity = toViolet × (1 − toNight). Night plate opacity = toNight.
- The nav gets the class "scrolled" when y > 0.5h.
- The pond video plays while toViolet < 0.999 and is paused otherwise (no decoding when it can't be seen).

## 9. Hero hover lens (WebGL, matches the original's post effect)

The pond is drawn into the "pondfx" canvas with WebGL 1. If WebGL is unavailable, or the program fails to link, show the plain video instead.
- Canvas backing size = viewport × min(devicePixelRatio, 1.5), updated on resize.
- One full-screen quad (two triangles over −1..1); vUv = position·0.5 + 0.5.
- Texture: the video element, re-uploaded every frame (RGB, unsigned byte, flip-Y on, clamp to edge, linear filtering).
- Cover fit: A = canvas aspect, V = video aspect (1276/720). If A > V then scale = (1, V/A), else scale = (A/V, 1). Multiply the scale by z = 0.975 (a slight zoom that leaves room for the tilt). Sampling: texture2D(tex, (uv − 0.5)·scale + 0.5 + tilt).
- Fragment shader, exactly the original's ripple: dist = distance(vUv, mouse); ripple = sin(dist·20 − time·5)·0.006; strength = smoothstep(0.2, 0.0, dist)·presence; offset = normalize(vUv − mouse + 1e−5)·ripple·strength. Red is sampled at vUv + offset + (0.005, 0)·strength, green at vUv + offset, blue at vUv + offset − (0.005, 0)·strength. Output alpha is 1. This gives a circular ripple of about a fifth of the screen around the cursor, with a red/blue colour split at its edge.
- time = seconds since the effect started. mouse = the pointer in uv (x/width, 1 − y/height). presence eases toward 1 while the pointer is in the window and toward 0 when it leaves, with rate k = 1 − e^(−6·dt). The mouse uniform keeps its last value while presence fades.
- Tilt: target tx, ty = pointer mapped to −1..1 (u·2 − 1, v·2 − 1; 0 when the pointer leaves), eased with k = 1 − e^(−dt/0.1) (settles in about 0.3 s, like the original's 0.3 s easing). The tilt uniform = (tx·0.009·scale.x, ty·0.009·scale.y), about 1° at this field of view.
- The loop runs on requestAnimationFrame but only draws when the video is ready (has played once), not paused and has data (readyState ≥ 2). dt is capped at 0.05 s.
- Pointer state is shared by both scripts: one window pointermove listener sets u, v, tx, ty and inside = true; a pointerleave listener on the document element sets inside = false and tx = ty = 0.

The html element starts with the class "anim"; while present, every element marked data-in has opacity 0. The script starts the animations below with fill "backwards" (so each holds its first keyframe during its delay), then removes "anim" on the next animation frame. A 3 s failsafe timeout also removes it. Easing for all: cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1).

## 11. The 3D koi (Three.js module)

- **Renderer**: on the koi canvas, alpha true, antialias true, high-performance power preference, pixel ratio min(devicePixelRatio, 2), sRGB output, ACES filmic tone mapping at exposure 0.95. The size follows the window.
- **Scene lighting**: environment = PMREM of RoomEnvironment (sigma 0.04); hemisphere light 0xc6b2ff / 0x2a1c80 at 0.7; key directional light 0xffc8f0 at 1.6 from (3, 5, 6); rim directional light 0x8c7bff at 2.8 from (−5, −1, −4). There is no glow sprite and no halo: the fish is drawn alone.
- **Camera**: perspective, 30° vertical field of view, near 0.1, far 100, at (0, 0, 10) looking down −Z. Visible frustum at z = 0: height fh = 2·tan(15°)·10, width fw = fh·aspect.
- **Model normalisation** (bake every mesh's world transform into its geometry first): take the bounding box; the longest axis is the fish's length. If it is Z, rotate +90° about Y; if Y, rotate −90° about Z. Then rotate 180° about Y so the nose points to +X (this Tripo model faces −X otherwise). Translate the box centre to the origin and scale uniformly so the length is 1. Recompute normals.
- **Material** (replaces the model's own; keeps its base-colour texture as both map and emissive map): MeshPhysicalMaterial with colour 0xc9b4ff (0xb8a4ff if there is no texture), roughness 0.18, metalness 0.15, clearcoat 1, clearcoat roughness 0.1, iridescence 0.85, iridescence IOR 1.4, thickness range 260–700, emissive 0x7a46ff at intensity 0.55, sheen 0.25 with sheen colour 0xff9ce6, transparent at opacity 0.95, environment intensity 0.75, double-sided. This gives a lilac-pink crystal look that stays bright against the dark violet background.
- **Swim deformation** (injected into the vertex shader in place of the begin_vertex chunk, using model-space position with the head at +X): tail = clamp((0.32 − x)/0.82, 0, 1); z += sin(x·freq − time·speed)·amp·(0.15 + 1.6·tail²); y += cos(x·freq·0.5 − time·speed·0.5)·amp·0.12·tail. Defaults: freq 5.2, speed 6.5, amp 0.075.
- **Swim speed follows scroll**: track scroll velocity vel (pixels per second, smoothed: vel += (instant − vel)·0.1). speedUp = min(|vel|/1800, 1.4). The shader time advances by dt·(1 + speedUp) each frame, and amp = 0.07 + 0.03·speedUp.
- **Scene graph**: rig (position and heading) → body (uniform scale) → mesh.
- **Scroll choreography**: one pose per section. x and y are in half-viewport units (−1..1, x to the right, y up), s is the fish length as a share of viewport height, and yaw, pitch and roll are in radians (yaw about Y, where 0 faces right; pitch about Z, where negative is nose down; roll about X).

| Pose | Scroll position where it applies (h = viewport height) | x | y | s | yaw | pitch | roll |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| hero | 0 | 0.02 | 0.16 | 0.72 | 0.18 | −0.92 | 0.05 |
| statement | Studio section top + 0.2h | −0.66 | −0.6 | 0.42 | 0.5 | 0.2 | −0.1 |
| dash | dashboard top + half its height − 0.5h | 0.5 | −0.5 | 0.46 | −0.35 | 0.32 | 0.1 |
| packs | Packages section top + 0.3h | 0.4 | −0.78 | 0.5 | 0.55 | −0.05 | 0.08 |
| uses | Use-cases section top + 0.3h | −0.42 | −0.42 | 0.6 | 3.0 (turned to face left) | 0.12 | −0.06 |
| end | min(CTA/footer section top, maximum scroll) | −0.7 | 0.56 | 0.48 | 0.3 | −0.14 | 0.05 |

  Section tops are page-absolute (bounding rect top + scrollY), recomputed on load and resize. Between two neighbouring poses, interpolate every value with easeInOutCubic of the scroll progress between their positions (4t³ below 0.5, otherwise 1 − (−2t + 2)³/2). Before the first pose use the first; after the last, the last.
- **Per frame** (dt capped at 0.05 s, t = elapsed seconds): ease the current pose toward the target with k = 1 − e^(−3.2·dt) (k = 1 under reduced motion). Idle bob: y += sin(0.9t)·0.018. Position = (x·fw/2, (y + bob)·fh/2, 0). Rotation (XYZ order) = (roll + sin(0.7t)·0.04, yaw + sin(0.5t)·0.06, pitch). Scale = s·fh.
- **Pointer tilt** (the original's TILT camera control): camera.rotation.y eases toward −tx·0.01745 and camera.rotation.x toward ty·0.01745 (1° maximum) with k = 1 − e^(−dt/0.1).
- **Phone poses** (≤ 820 px wide) override only x, y and s: hero (0.12, 0.38, 0.46), statement (0.42, −0.72, 0.3), dash (−0.35, −0.74, 0.3), packs (0.38, −0.74, 0.3), uses (−0.3, −0.76, 0.32), end (0.3, −0.74, 0.32).
```

```markdown
# Mossline: Floating Moss Island Scroll Fly-In (exact recreation prompt)

Build a single-file landing page for **Mossline**, a fictional environmental-data company that measures ecosystems with field sensors. The page is one long pinned scroll story followed by a white solutions section.

The story has five beats:

1. **Hero:** a misty pale-grey sky with a huge floating rock island covered in moss and ferns, and the one-line headline "Measure the Living Planet". The island's ferns grow in front of the bottom of the headline letters.
2. **Fly-in:** scrolling scrubs a cinematic video in which the camera pushes into the island, glides over its mossy top and lands at eye level in a moss landscape facing a slim sensor mast. Two small floating rocks fly past the camera, and the vision statement resolves out of blur mid-flight.
3. **Landscape:** an accounting paragraph writes in word by word and four lime hotspots pop up on the moss. A fog bank rolls in from the left to keep the sky behind the text clean.
4. **Station:** a heading, a glass "Accumulated carbon balance" card with a count-up and a drawing sparkline, and a five-row feature list.
5. **Solutions:** a white rounded panel slides up with a heading, three tilting image cards and four count-up stats.

Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS in one file, with no libraries. Every value below is exact. Reproduce every string, number, timing and URL as written.

    - A hexagon filled with currentColor: path `M16 2l12 7v14l-12 7-12-7V9z`.
    - A lime `#c6f35c` leaf on top: path `M16 8c-4 4-5 9-1 16 1-5 4-9 8-11-3 0-5 1-7 3 0-3 0-5 0-8z`.
- **Menu (centre):**
  - Four links with a 30px gap: "Solutions", "Our tech", "Company", "Resources".
  - Each is mono 11.5px, letter-spacing .14em, uppercase, with a 7px gap before a chevron.
  - Chevron: a 6×6 box with 1.3px right and bottom borders in currentColor, `translateY(-2px) rotate(45deg)`.
```
