```markdown
The cloth repositions in JS (see "View" below). Must work down to 375px wide with no horizontal scroll.

=== THE CLOTH (WebGL 1, written from scratch, no libraries) ===
Get a "webgl" context with alpha true, antialias true, premultipliedAlpha true, powerPreference high-performance. If WebGL is missing, shaders fail, the image fails to load, or the context is lost, add class "no-cloth" to the hero.

Settings:
size 0.90 (cloth height as a share of hero height), aspect 1.12 (width/height), spread 0.98, pinRoll 5.5 degrees, flutter 0.35, damping 0.30, stiffness 0.60, crumple 0.55, grabRadius 0.12, carryRadius 0.20, gravity 2.6, tilt -10 degrees, turn -12 degrees, perspective 0.45, maxSpeed 12, steps 8.
Grid: 46 columns x 42 rows of points. CH = size, CW = size * aspect. Row 0 is the bottom edge, the last row is the top edge.

Camera: t = tilt, r = turn in radians. World-to-view rows:
R0 = (cos r, 0, sin r); R1 = (sin t * sin r, cos t, -sin t * cos r); R2 = (-cos t * sin r, sin t, cos t * cos r).
CAM = exp(ln(18) * (1 - perspective) + ln(1.7) * perspective).
Projection: q = R * p; scale = CAM / max(CAM - q.z, 0.001); screen = q.xy * scale * zoom. Screen units: 1.0 = hero height.
Clip position: x = 2 * (cx + screen.x / aspectRatio) - 1; y = 1 - 2 * (cy - screen.y); z = -q.z * 0.5; w = 1.

View (recomputed on resize, via ResizeObserver and window resize; canvas pixel size = hero size * min(devicePixelRatio, 2)):
- Wide layout (width >= 1100 and width/height >= 1.25): cx 0.402, cy 0.485, zoom = min(1, 0.58 * aspectRatio / (CW * 1.12)).
- Stacked layout (otherwise): cx 0.5; cy 0.41 if aspectRatio < 0.75 else 0.43; zoom = min(1, 0.92 * aspectRatio / (CW * 1.12), (0.60 if aspectRatio < 0.75 else 0.66) / CH).

Rest shape: each point's flat position is ((u - 0.5) * CW, (v - 0.5) * CH), plus a permanent crease height in z:
ridge(x) = sqrt(sin(x)^2 + 0.03) - 0.64
crease(u,v) = crumple * 0.045 * CH * [ ridge(2.7u + 2.9v + 0.7) + 0.8 * ridge(-2.6u + 3.3v + 2.1) + 0.5 * sin(4.9u - 1.4v + 2.2) + 0.55 * ridge(1.1u + 6.4v + 1.3) + 0.4 * ridge(8.3u + 3.9v + 0.2) + 0.3 * ridge(-5.7u + 9.1v + 1.6) ]

Pins: the top-left and top-right points are fixed. half = 0.5 * CW * spread, top = 0.5 * CH, roll = pinRoll in radians. Left pin at (-half * cos roll, top + half * sin roll, 0); right pin at (half * cos roll, top - half * sin roll, 0). So the left pin sits higher.

Links (distance constraints, rest length measured on the creased rest shape):
- neighbours right and up: stiffness 1
- both diagonals of each cell: stiffness 0.5
- two apart (right and up): stiffness bend = 0.02 + (0.60 - 0.02) * 0.60
- five apart (right and up): stiffness bend * 0.5
Tethers: no point may be further from either pin than 1.02 x its flat distance to that pin; clamp after each step.

Starting pose: x scaled by spread + (1 - spread) * (1 - v)^2, then the whole sheet rotated by the roll angle about the middle of the top edge so it already leans with the pins.

Each animation frame: dt = min(elapsed seconds, 1/30); run 8 sub-steps of h = dt / 8. Each sub-step:
1. Time T advances by h. damp = exp(-(0.15 + 5.85 * damping) * h). gust = 0.6 + 0.4 * sin(0.37T) * sin(0.23T + 1.0). wind = flutter * 2.4 * gust * (gravity / 2.6); wind is 0 under prefers-reduced-motion.
2. Verlet step for every free point: velocity = (pos - prev) * damp + accel * h^2, with speed capped at maxSpeed * h. accel = (wind * 0.25 * sin(3.3v + 1.1T + u), wind * 0.1 * s2 - gravity, wind * (0.45 * s1 + 0.35 * s2 + 0.3 * s3)), where s1 = sin(9.1u - 3.7v + 3.1T), s2 = sin(6.3u + 7.9v - 2.3T + 1.3), s3 = sin(2.9u + 1.7T + 0.8 * sin(0.5T)) * cos(2.3v - 0.9T).
3. One sweep over all links, moving both ends toward the rest length weighted by inverse mass (pinned and held points do not move). Alternate sweep direction every sub-step (forwards, then backwards).
4. Apply the two tethers to every free point.
Before the first frame, run 360 sub-steps of 1/240 s with damping temporarily set to 1, so the cloth appears already hanging, never as a flat sheet.

Grabbing:
- Convert the pointer to screen units: x = ((clientX - left) / width - cx) * aspectRatio / zoom; y = (cy - (clientY - top) / height) / zoom.
- On pointerdown (left button only for mouse), project every point; pick the point with the lowest score = distance - 0.08 * viewDepth among those within grabRadius / zoom. If none, do nothing.
- Remember that point's view depth and its offset from the pointer, so there is no jump.
- Carry weights: for every point, d = flat distance to the grabbed point / (carryRadius * CH); weight = (1 - d^2)^2 if d < 1, else 0; the grabbed point is 1; pins are 0.
- While held, each sub-step: target = pointer unprojected at the remembered depth plus offset, rotated back to world space, then clamped by the two tethers of the grabbed point. delta = target - grabbed point position. Points with weight >= 0.98 move by the full delta and are treated as fixed for that step; other points move by weight * delta without gaining that as velocity.
- Release on pointerup, pointercancel, or lostpointercapture. Use setPointerCapture.
- Mouse hover: toggle class "is-over" when a pick would succeed; add "is-held" while dragging.
- Touch: a non-passive touchstart calls preventDefault only when the finger is on the cloth, and touchmove only while dragging, so the page still scrolls everywhere else.

Rendering, per frame:
1. Compute smooth per-point normals from central differences (cross of the horizontal and vertical neighbours' differences). Upload positions and normals as dynamic buffers. Texture coordinates: u = column / 45, v = 1 - row / 41 (so the top row shows the top of the image). Indexed triangles, two per cell.
2. Shadow: draw the cloth as solid white into an off-screen texture 1/8 the canvas size. Then draw a full-screen triangle that samples it with a 7x7 Gaussian (weight exp(-d^2 / 6), tap spacing = texel * (0.9 + 1.5 * zoom * heroHeight / 724)), shifted by (-0.012 * zoom / aspectRatio, -0.045 * zoom), colour (0.07, 0.07, 0.16) at 0.30 strength, premultiplied, blended ONE / ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA.
3. Cloth: depth test on (LEQUAL), no blending, no face culling.

Cloth fragment shader (precision highp):
- n = normalised view-space normal; back = n.z < 0, and if so flip n.
- V = normalize((0,0,CAM) - viewPosition); Rf = reflect(-V, n); KEY = normalize(-0.42, 0.45, 0.79); nv = clamp(dot(n,V)); nl = max(dot(n,KEY), 0).
- print = texture colour raised to 2.2 (until the image has loaded use flat colour (0.10, 0.02, 0.32)).
- shade = 0.46 + 0.68 * nl + 0.08 * n.y
- key = pow(max(dot(Rf,KEY),0), 26)
- box(dir, centre, halfSize, soft): a soft rectangular light seen in the reflection, with smoothstep(-0.5, 0.5) edges.
  strip = box(Rf, normalize(0.08, 0.93, 0.36), (1.1, 0.07), 0.22)
  side = box(Rf, normalize(0.86, 0.12, 0.50), (0.06, 0.85), 0.20)
  fill = box(Rf, KEY, (0.42, 0.30), 0.35)
- phase = 3.0 * (0.85 * dot(n.xy, (0.6, 0.8)) + 0.75 * (1 - nv) + 0.3 * dot(Rf.xy, (-0.8, 0.6))) + 0.4 * sin(5 * uv.x + 7 * uv.y)
- rainbow(p) = clamp((0.74, 0.58, 0.96) + (0.26, 0.24, 0.10) * cos(2*pi * (p + (0.0, 0.28, 0.62))))  — stays in violet, pink and blue
- holo = mix(white, rainbow(phase)^2.2, 0.8)
- lum = luminance of print; gloss = mix(1.0, 0.45, smoothstep(0.55, 0.9, lum))  (white lettering is less shiny)
- spec = holo * gloss * mix(white, print * 2.4 + 0.08, 0.65) * (0.34 * key + 0.11 * strip + 0.07 * side + 0.02 * fill)
- colour = print * shade + spec + holo * print * 0.6 * (1 - nv)^3
- back face: foil = (0.30, 0.22, 0.52) * (0.35 + 0.9 * nl) + spec * 1.3; colour = mix(foil, print * shade, 0.38)
- soft highlight roll-off above 0.8: colour = min(colour, 0.8) + 0.2 * (1 - exp(-max(colour - 0.8, 0) / 0.2))
- output pow(colour, 1/2.2), alpha 1.

Image loading: create an Image with crossOrigin = "anonymous", set src to the URL above. On load, upload with texImage2D (no Y flip), clamp to edge, linear magnification, mipmaps with LINEAR_MIPMAP_LINEAR (the image is power-of-two), anisotropic filtering up to 8x if available. Show the print at full strength immediately on load and draw a frame straight away — do NOT fade it in over frames. On error, add "no-cloth".

Loop: requestAnimationFrame, running only while the hero is on screen (IntersectionObserver) and the tab is visible; resume on visibilitychange.

=== QUALITY ===
Visible keyboard focus on all controls, no console errors, no horizontal scroll at any width, smooth at 60fps on a laptop. Result at 1280x724: cloth spans roughly from 11% to 65% of the width and 6% to 92% of the height, slightly rotated clockwise, bottom edge wider than the top, with a soft shadow below it; heading "Grab me" (black) over "I dare you" (50% black) on the right; "Peculiar Atelier" top-left; black "More" pill and violet "Start a brief" pill top-right.
```

```markdown
ARROWS (top-right, left of the dots column)
.arrows { position:absolute; top:18.9%; left:76.7%; display:flex; gap:32px; transform:translate(-19px,-50%) }
.arrow { width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:50%; border:2.5px solid #fff; background:transparent; color:#fff; display:grid; place-items:center; cursor:pointer; transition:background .25s, color .25s }
.arrow svg { width:18px; height:18px }
.arrow:hover { background:#fff; color:#000 }

PAGINATION DOTS (vertical, right edge)
.dots { position:absolute; right:calc(var(--pad-x) - 7px); top:49.4%; transform:translateY(-50%); display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:33px }
.dot { width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%; border:2px solid #fff; background:#fff; cursor:pointer; transition:background .25s }
.dot.active { background:transparent }   /* active = hollow ring, middle one active by default */

TAGLINE (bottom-left)
.tagline { position:absolute; left:var(--pad-x); bottom:clamp(40px,7.5vh,70px); font-size:clamp(24px,2.65vw,44px); line-height:1.2; font-weight:300; letter-spacing:-0.01em }
.tagline strong { font-weight:700; display:block }

CTA ROW (button → horizontal line → giant outlined "07" bleeding off the right edge)
.cta-row { position:absolute; left:45.6%; right:-1vw; top:88.7%; transform:translateY(-50%); display:flex; align-items:center }
.cta { flex:none; padding:0 15px; height:48px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.85); border-radius:6px; background:rgba(0,0,0,.15); color:#fff; font-size:14px; font-weight:400; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; transition:background .25s, color .25s }
.cta:hover { background:#fff; color:#000 }
.cta-line { flex:1; height:1.5px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.8); min-width:40px }
.count { flex:none; font-size:clamp(140px,19.8vw,360px); font-weight:400; line-height:1; letter-spacing:-0.02em; color:transparent; -webkit-text-stroke:1.5px rgba(255,255,255,.9); transform:translateY(6%); user-select:none }

LOADER
.loader { position:absolute; left:50%; top:50%; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); font-size:12px; letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase; opacity:.6; transition:opacity .6s }
.loader.done { opacity:0 }

RESPONSIVE
@media (max-width:900px), (max-aspect-ratio:1/1) {
  .arrows { left:auto; right:var(--pad-x); top:15%; transform:translateY(-50%); gap:14px }
  .tagline { bottom:clamp(150px,20vh,220px) }
  .cta-row { left:var(--pad-x); right:-3vw; top:auto; bottom:24px; transform:none }
  .count { font-size:clamp(120px,22vw,200px) }
}
@media (max-width:640px) {
  .nav-links { gap:16px }
  .nav-links a, .logo { font-size:13px }
  .dots { gap:20px; right:16px }
  .dot { width:10px; height:10px }
  .cta-row { right:-8vw }
  .count { font-size:120px }
}
@media (max-width:420px) { .nav-links li:nth-child(2) { display:none } }   /* hide "Portfolio" */
No horizontal page scroll at any width.

==================================================
4. WEBGL SCENE (Three.js)
==================================================
Renderer: WebGLRenderer({ canvas:#scene, antialias:true, alpha:false }), clearColor #000, outputColorSpace SRGBColorSpace, pixelRatio = min(devicePixelRatio, 2).
Camera: PerspectiveCamera(fov 30, aspect W/H, 0.1, 100) at (0,0,10) looking at origin.

4a. Background headline (drawn into an offscreen 2D canvas → CanvasTexture)
- Canvas size = viewport × DPR, filled #000.
- mobile = (W < 768) || (W/H < 1).
- fontSize fs = min(H*0.21, W*(mobile ? 0.21 : 0.118)); font = `800 ${fs}px Poppins`.
  If the widest line is wider than W*(mobile ? 0.9 : 0.5), scale fs down to fit.
- Lines: "Explore", "New", "Ideas". Fill #e9e9e9, textAlign center, baseline alphabetic.
- Centre x = W*(mobile ? 0.5 : 0.505); centre y = H*(mobile ? 0.45 : 0.468).
  Line gap = fs*1.07; cap height ≈ fs*0.7. Line i (0..2) baseline y = cy + cap/2 + (i-1)*gap.
- Texture: colorSpace SRGB, LinearFilter, no mipmaps. Redraw on resize and on document.fonts 'loadingdone'.
- Show it with a fullscreen quad (PlaneGeometry(2,2), ShaderMaterial, vertex outputs position.xy directly, fragment = texture2D(uTex, vUv) followed by #include <colorspace_fragment> ON ITS OWN LINE; depthTest/depthWrite false; frustumCulled false) in its own bgScene.
- Wait for fonts before first draw: Promise.race([Promise.all([document.fonts.load('800 100px Poppins'), document.fonts.ready]), 2500ms timeout]) then layout() + start loop.

4b. Model loading
- GLTFLoader.load(MODEL_URL). Traverse gltf.scene; for each mesh: clone geometry, delete 'uv','color','tangent' attributes, mergeVertices(g, 1e-4), computeVertexNormals(), applyMatrix4(mesh.matrixWorld). Merge all parts with mergeGeometries.
- Centre the geometry on its bounding box and scale uniformly so its largest dimension = 1.
- Scene graph: scene → pivot (screen position + scale) → spinner (rotation) → cube mesh. On load add class "done" to #loader.

4c. Cube placement (in layout(), on load and on resize)
- visH = 2*tan(fov/2)*10; visW = visH*aspect.
- Screen-fraction centre: sx = mobile ? 0.5 : 0.517, sy = mobile ? 0.45 : 0.488.
  pivot.position = ((sx-0.5)*visW, (0.5-sy)*visH, 0).
- On-screen edge length px = min(H*0.44, W*(mobile ? 0.45 : 0.29)); pivot.scale = (px/H)*visH.
- Initial spinner rotation: Euler(-0.42, 0.62, 0.18).

4d. Glass material — custom ShaderMaterial, screen-space refraction with 6-band chromatic dispersion, rendered in two passes (back faces, then front faces).
Vertex shader:
  varying vec3 vNormal; varying vec3 vEye;
  worldPos = modelMatrix*position; mvPos = viewMatrix*worldPos; gl_Position = projectionMatrix*mvPos;
  vNormal = normalize(normalMatrix*normal); vEye = normalize(mvPos.xyz);
Fragment shader:
  uv = gl_FragCoord.xy / uResolution (drawing-buffer size).
  n = normalize(vNormal); if (uBackside > 0.5) n = -n;   // do NOT use gl_FrontFacing, three.js flips winding for BackSide
  eye = normalize(vEye).
  LOOP = 16 iterations; slide = i/LOOP * 0.045.
  For each band compute refract(eye, n, 1.0/ior) with iorR/Y/G/C/B/P and sample uTexture at
    uv + refr.xy * (uRefractPower + slide*k) * uChromatic, with k = 1 (R), 1 (Y), 2 (G), 2.5 (C), 3 (B), 1 (P):
    r = tex(R).x*0.5
    y = (tex(Y).x*2 + tex(Y).y*2 - tex(Y).z)/6
    g = tex(G).y*0.5
    c = (tex(C).y*2 + tex(C).z*2 - tex(C).x)/6
    b = tex(B).z*0.5
    p = (tex(P).z*2 + tex(P).x*2 - tex(P).y)/6
    R = r + (2p + 2y - c)/3;  G = g + (2y + 2c - p)/3;  B = b + (2c + 2p - y)/3
    color += vec3(R,G,B)
  color /= LOOP; saturation adjust: mix(luma(color), color, uSaturation) with luma weights (0.2125, 0.7154, 0.0721).
  Specular (Blinn-Phong, light vector = normalize(-light), view = -eye):
    spec = specular(uLight, uShininess, uDiffuseness) + 0.6 * specular(vec3(1,1,-1), uShininess*0.6, uDiffuseness*0.5)
    spec(x) = pow(max(dot(n,halfVec),0), shininess) + max(0,dot(n,lightVec))*diffuseness
    color += spec * (backside ? 0.35 : 1.0)
  Fresnel: f = pow(1.0 + dot(eye, n), uFresnelPower); color = mix(color, vec3(1), f * (backside ? 0.25 : 0.55)).
  color += vec3(0.004, 0.005, 0.007). gl_FragColor = vec4(color,1); then #include <colorspace_fragment> on its own line.
Uniform values:
  uIorR 1.15, uIorY 1.16, uIorG 1.18, uIorC 1.22, uIorB 1.22, uIorP 1.22,
  uRefractPower 0.30 (front) / 0.22 (back), uChromatic 0.5, uSaturation 1.08,
  uShininess 90, uDiffuseness 0.02, uFresnelPower 5.0, uLight (-1, 1, 1),
  uBackside 0 (frontMat, side FrontSide) / 1 (backMat, side BackSide).

4e. Render pipeline (every frame)
- Two WebGLRenderTargets sized to drawing buffer (W*DPR × H*DPR), type HalfFloatType, default (linear) colour space: rtBack, rtFront.
- backMat.uTexture = rtBack.texture; frontMat.uTexture = rtFront.texture.
  1) render bgScene → rtBack
  2) render bgScene → rtFront, then (autoClear=false) cube with backMat → rtFront
  3) render bgScene → screen, then (autoClear=false, clearDepth) cube with frontMat → screen
- This gives the look: text seen through the cube is magnified, mirrored and split into blue/yellow fringes, inner rounded edges of the cube are faintly visible, and the bevelled edges glow white.

==================================================
5. INTERACTION & ANIMATION
==================================================
- Drag to rotate (pointer events on the canvas, setPointerCapture):
  dx = Δx*0.008, dy = Δy*0.008; apply as world-space rotation: premultiply spinner.quaternion by axisAngle(Y, dx) then axisAngle(X, dy).
  Track velocity per 16.67ms frame; add class "dragging" to the canvas while dragging.
- Inertia after release: keep applying velocity, damped by 0.94^(dt*60) per frame.
- Idle drift: 0.6s after release, blend in a constant slow rotation of 0.0035 rad/frame around Y and 0.0012 rad/frame around X (blend ramps 0→1 over 1s). It also runs from page load.
- Prev/Next arrow buttons: smoothly rotate the cube -90°/+90° around Y (ease: each frame apply remaining*min(1, 0.09*dt*60) until remaining < 0.0005). Cancels inertia; dragging cancels the spin.
- Dots: clicking a dot makes it the only .active one (hollow ring).
- Hover transitions: nav link underline wipe (.35s), arrow and CTA buttons invert to white bg / black content (.25s).
- Clamp frame dt to 0.05s. Recompute layout (renderer size, camera aspect, render-target sizes, uResolution, headline canvas, cube position/scale) on window resize.

==================================================
6. LAYOUT REFERENCE (desktop 1440×806)
==================================================
- Logo at (100, 38), 40px tall. Nav links right-aligned, right edge ≈ 1340, vertical centre ≈ 58.
- Arrow circles centred at ≈ (1105, 152) and (1175, 152).
- Dots at x ≈ 1340, y ≈ 351 / 398 / 445 (middle one hollow).
- Headline "Explore / New / Ideas" centred at x ≈ 727, ~170px ExtraBold, baselines ≈ 272 / 445 / 637.
- Glass cube occupies ≈ x 510–1000, y 145–600, slightly right of centre, overlapping the headline.
- Tagline "Let's Build the / Future of / Design." at left 100, bottom ≈ 60px, ~38px, Light with Bold "Design.".
- "Explore Now" button at (657, 691), 48px tall; a 1.5px line runs right to a huge outlined "07" whose "0" starts at x ≈ 1140 and whose "7" is clipped by the right and bottom edges.
- Pure black background, all UI white.

Mobile (≤767px or portrait): headline and cube centred at 50% x / 45% y, headline up to 90% width, arrows move under the nav on the right, tagline sits above the CTA row, and the CTA row is pinned 24px from the bottom with "07" partly off-screen on the right.

Output: one complete index.html, nothing else.
```

```markdown
# Prompt: RidgeAI hero

Build a single-file, full-viewport **AI app-builder landing hero** for a fictional company, **RidgeAI** ("ship real apps from a plain idea"). Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step.

## Look and feel

- **Background:** a full-bleed cinematic photograph of snowy alpine peaks at sunrise, with a low sun on the right, a calm blue sky across the upper half, and glowing amber circuit-like light paths tracing the dark forested valleys and converging at the bottom centre.
  - Over it sits a slow looping video of the same scene, where the light pulses through the paths and clouds drift.
  - On top of that are two screen-blended CSS layers: an amber bloom over the valleys that swells and fades (4.6s, alternate), and a soft light band that sweeps across them (6.5s).
  - A faint dark radial shade sits behind the centre copy so white text stays readable over the bright peaks.
- **Type:** **Inter** (variable, self-hosted).
  - headline 400 weight, white
  - nav ink `#2e2e2e`
  - accent amber `#ff8a12` (CTA, send button, "AI" in the logo)
  - prompt placeholder `#9389cf`
  - perk sparkles lime `#8fd61b`
- **Blueprint frame:** thin white lines (`rgba(255,255,255,.28)`) form an architectural grid over the photo:
  - two rails on each side and two horizontal rules
  - small white square handles at the intersections
  - diagonal hatching in two cells, upper-right and lower-left

## Layout (desktop)

Every size is in design units of a **1372×872 reference**, where `u = clamp(.5px, min(max(100vw/1372, .8px), 100vh/872), 2px)`.

1. **Top bar:** a white bar inset 27.8u from the sides and 20.8u from the top, 53.5u tall.
   - **Left:** an amber hexagon logo and the wordmark **Ridge**, with **AI** in amber, in Inter 600, 23.5u, with tight tracking.
   - **Centre:** the links **Product · Templates · Pricing · Changelog**.
   - **Right:** an amber **Start Climbing** button (115×29u, radius 3.4u) with a warm glow beneath it.
2. **Centre column:**
   - **Badge:** a glass pill with a sparkle icon, "Now with multi-agent app builders".
   - **Headline:** two lines at 60u / 61u line-height, **Ship Real Apps / from a Plain Idea.**
   - **Subline:** two lines at 14.9u: "Turn one sentence into a working app with auth, data, and payments. No code / to write. Describe the tool you need and RidgeAI builds, then ships."
   - **Prompt box:** white, 511×112u, radius 6u, with the placeholder "Build a booking app for a salon" and a 31u amber send button with a › chevron. It sends nothing.
   - **Perks:** three items with lime sparkle icons: No credit card required · Free plan available · Live in one click.
   - **Social proof:** five overlapping 34u circular **initial avatars** (MK, JL, AS, RT, EV, each on its own gradient, with white rings), and "Loved by 40,000 builders" under them.

## Motion

- **Entrance:** pure CSS, run once.
  - The bar drops in, then the badge settles.
  - Each headline line rises out of a clip mask, 0.13s apart.
  - The subline settles, then the prompt box with a 1.5% scale.
  - The perks, then the social-proof row, fade up last.
- **Reduced motion:** nothing animates and the still photo shows.

## Smaller screens (< 900px)

- The bar becomes a compact white bar with the logo, the Start Climbing button and a menu button that opens a white dropdown.
- The frame collapses to the two outer rails and two rules, with small hatched corner blocks.
- The copy stacks centred: the headline wraps (clamp 30–58px), the prompt box goes full width, and the perks wrap.

## Media (use these URLs)

- **Background still:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/fab71b48-e739-4ff3-b93a-232b2bb5b74f.jpg` (1920×1086 JPEG)
- **Background loop:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/d7dbb9fc-403e-411f-b640-58716b95355f.mp4` (1276×720, 5s, muted, loops, first frame = last frame). Use `object-fit: cover` and the same position as the still so the two align exactly.

## Acceptance check (1440×900)

- **Top:** the white bar sits at the top with the amber CTA.
- **Middle:** the blueprint grid frames the screen, and the centred headline, prompt box, perks and avatar row read clearly over the alpine scene.
- **Bottom:** the amber light paths in the valleys visibly pulse and glow, and a light band sweeps across them.
- **Content:** no real company or person names appear anywhere.
```

```markdown
# Prompt: Recreate the Keylight sign-in page exactly

Copy everything below the line into your AI coding tool.

---

Recreate the **Keylight** sign-in page: one self-contained `index.html` (inline CSS + vanilla JS, no framework, no build step). It must match **exactly**, so reproduce the source at the end byte for byte. Do not restyle, re-time or refactor anything.

## What it is

- **Split screen.**
  - **Left:** a brand panel about 41% wide on a 1470√ó900 design frame. It holds:
    - a still of a keyhole cut into a dark navy wall, with warm orange light pouring through it into blue haze
    - two pure-CSS light layers over the still, both on `alternate` loops: a warm bloom over the keyhole that swells and fades (5.5s), and a cool drift in the beam below it (9s)
    - the "keylight." logo
    - the headline "Unlock calmly. Grow without worry." and a grey paragraph
    - a marquee of frosted-glass testimonial cards that runs forever (42s) and pauses on hover
    - "Relied on by teams that build" with six customer marks
    - the copyright line
  - **Right:** the sign-in panel:
    - "Hello again!" / "Sign in to carry on."
    - a dark **"Unlock using a passkey"** button with a fingerprint icon and a blue "Most secure" pill
    - "Or use your password", then email/username and password fields (with show/hide), "Remember me", "Forgot your key?" and a black "Sign in" button
    - "Or continue with": Google, Apple, GitHub
    - "No Keylight space yet? Open a free space", and the Terms ¬∑ Privacy ¬∑ Support footer
- **Scaling:** everything is sized in design pixels √ó `--u`, so the whole layout scales with the viewport. Below 740px it becomes one column: still band (logo + headline, showing the blue beam) ‚Üí form ‚Üí still band (testimonials + logos + copyright). There are no light layers on phones.
- **Entrance:** a Web Animations timeline runs once on load:
  - headlines rise line by line out of masks
  - the form rows settle, the passkey button lands with a hair of scale, and the divider rules draw outward
  - the cards lift in, then the quiet details fade in
- **Reduced motion:** the page is static: no marquee and no light layers.
- **The form sends nothing:** submit is prevented in script.

## Media (remote, Higgsfield storage on CloudFront)

The keyhole sits at the right edge of the panel, fully inside it.

- **Right:**

~~~html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Sign in ¬∑ Keylight</title>
<meta name="theme-color" content="#030712">
<style>
/* ------------------------------------------------------------------
   Fonts ‚Äî Google Sans (SIL OFL 1.1), embedded so the page works offline
   ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
@font-face{font-family:"GS";font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-display:block;src:url(/assets/fonts/google-sans-400.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"GS";font-style:normal;font-weight:500;font-display:block;src:url(/assets/fonts/google-sans-500.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"GS";font-style:normal;font-weight:600;font-display:block;src:url(/assets/fonts/google-sans-600.woff2) format("woff2")}
@font-face{font-family:"GS";font-style:normal;font-weight:700;font-display:block;src:url(/assets/fonts/google-sans-700.woff2) format("woff2")}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------------
   Design tokens. Every length below is written in design pixels of the
   1470 √ó 900 reference frame and multiplied by --u.
   Desktop + tablet (split, >= 740px):
       --u = max(floor, min(viewport-width/1470, viewport-height/900))
       floor = .8 on desktops, rising fluidly to 1 by 940px wide, so the
       desktop frame (scale >= .8) is untouched and tablets never shrink
       text below the design's 14px body size.
   Mobile (stacked, < 740px): --u = 1px (true design pixels).
   ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
:root{
  --u:1px;
  --font:"GS",ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;

  --ink:#030712;          /* headings, button, checkbox, strong text */
  --muted:#4a4d54;        /* labels, sub copy, placeholders */
  --icon:#4e5157;         /* input icons */
  --line:#e5e5e5;         /* borders + divider */
  --paper:#ffffff;
  --on-ink:#f9fafb;

  --hero-title:#e5e6ee;
  --hero-copy:rgba(255,255,255,.50);
  --hero-faint:rgba(255,255,255,.50);
  --hero-rule:rgba(255,255,255,.22);
  --logo-ink:rgba(199,210,254,.55);

  --glass-bg:rgba(11,8,19,.44);
  --glass-border:rgba(255,255,255,.10);
  --glass-filter:blur(16px) saturate(.8);

  --shadow-xs:0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.05);
}
:root{--brand-img:url(https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/d889cba6-535c-450f-9b74-7270c0e01e9a.webp)}
@media (min-width:740px){
  :root{
    /* width-driven floor (.8 -> 1 between 1176px and 940px wide), but never more
       than the height can hold (the brand column needs 772 design px). On phone
       landscape (< 500px tall) scrolling is unavoidable, so readability wins. */
    --u-floor:min(clamp(.8px, calc(.8px + (1176px - 100vw) / 1180), 1px), max(.8px, calc(100vh / 772), calc(500px - 100vh)));
    --u:min(4px, max(var(--u-floor), min(calc(100vw / 1470), calc(100vh / 900))));
  }
  @supports (height:100dvh){
    :root{
      --u-floor:min(clamp(.8px, calc(.8px + (1176px - 100vw) / 1180), 1px), max(.8px, calc(100dvh / 772), calc(500px - 100dvh)));
      --u:min(4px, max(var(--u-floor), min(calc(100vw / 1470), calc(100dvh / 900))));
    }
  }
}
/* Portrait split (large tablets, portrait monitors): plenty of height, so use
   the full design scale rather than the width-squeezed one. */
@media (min-width:740px) and (orientation:portrait){
  :root{ --u-floor:min(1px, calc(100vh / 772)); }
  @supports (height:100dvh){ :root{ --u-floor:min(1px, calc(100dvh / 772)); } }
}

*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;text-size-adjust:100%}
body{
  font-family:var(--font);
  background:var(--paper);
  color:var(--ink);
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing:grayscale;
  text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
  font-feature-settings:"kern" 1;
}
button,input{font:inherit;color:inherit}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}

/* ==================================================================
   Shell ‚Äî two panels, always full height: no letterboxing, ever
   ================================================================== */
.shell{display:flex;min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;width:100%}

/* ---------------- Brand panel (left) ---------------- */
.brand{
  position:relative;
  flex:0 0 calc(100% * 610 / 1470);
  max-width:calc(100% - 450 * var(--u)); /* tablet: keeps >= 450 for the form column */
  min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;gap:calc(24 * var(--u));
  container-type:inline-size;
  padding:calc(32 * var(--u)) 0 calc(32 * var(--u));
  overflow:hidden;
  isolation:isolate;
  color:#fff;
  background:#0b0a1f var(--brand-img) center / cover no-repeat;
}
/* the keyhole breathes: a warm bloom over the keyhole that swells and fades, and a cool drift
   in the beam below it. Pure CSS over the still, behind the content (the panel isolates). */
.brand::before,.brand::after{content:"";position:absolute;pointer-events:none;z-index:-1}
.brand::before{
  left:58%;top:6%;width:62%;height:42%;
  background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(255,170,72,.55),rgba(255,120,40,.18) 55%,transparent);
  mix-blend-mode:screen;filter:blur(calc(6 * var(--u)));
  animation:bloom 5.5s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1) infinite alternate;
}
.brand::after{
  left:-10%;top:42%;width:120%;height:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(70,120,255,.32),transparent);
  mix-blend-mode:screen;
  animation:drift 9s cubic-bezier(.45,0,.55,1) infinite alternate;
}
@keyframes bloom{
  from{opacity:.35;transform:scale(.9)}
  to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.12)}
}
@keyframes drift{
  from{opacity:.45;transform:translate3d(-6%,2%,0)}
  to{opacity:1;transform:translate3d(6%,-3%,0)}
}
/* Content column: 144 inset + 338 measure on desktop. When the panel narrows
   (tablet), the inset gives way first (144 -> 24), then the right margin,
   and only then the measure itself. */
.brand__inset{
  --inset:clamp(calc(24 * var(--u)), calc(100cqi - 465.75 * var(--u)), calc(144 * var(--u)));
  --measure:min(calc(338 * var(--u)), calc(100cqi - var(--inset) - 24 * var(--u)));
  padding-left:var(--inset);padding-right:calc(24 * var(--u));
}

.logo{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:calc(40 * var(--u));gap:calc(10 * var(--u))}
.logo__mark{
  width:calc(40 * var(--u));height:calc(40 * var(--u));flex:none;
  border-radius:calc(12 * var(--u));background:#fff;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
}
.logo__mark svg{width:calc(22 * var(--u));height:calc(22 * var(--u))}
.logo__word{font-size:calc(22 * var(--u));line-height:1;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:#fff}

.hero__title{
  margin:0;
  max-width:var(--measure);
  /* shrinks only when the measure can no longer hold "Scale confidently." */
  font-size:min(calc(30 * var(--u)), calc(var(--measure) / 7.9));
  line-height:min(calc(36 * var(--u)), calc(var(--measure) / 7.9 * 1.2));
  font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.034em;
  color:var(--hero-title);
}
.hero__copy{
  margin:calc(11.5 * var(--u)) 0 0;
  max-width:var(--measure);
  font-size:calc(16 * var(--u));line-height:calc(24 * var(--u));
  font-weight:400;color:var(--hero-copy);
}

/* testimonial marquee */
.reel{position:relative;margin-top:calc(40 * var(--u));height:calc(260 * var(--u))}
.reel__track{
  position:absolute;left:0;top:0;display:flex;gap:calc(16 * var(--u));
  transform:translateX(calc(-43 * var(--u)));
  animation:reel 42s linear infinite;
  will-change:transform;
}
@media (hover:hover){.reel:hover .reel__track{animation-play-state:paused}}
@keyframes reel{
  from{transform:translateX(calc(-43 * var(--u)))}
  to{transform:translateX(calc((-43 - 828) * var(--u)))}
}
.card{
  flex:none;width:calc(260 * var(--u));height:calc(260 * var(--u));
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:calc(24 * var(--u));
  border:calc(1 * var(--u)) solid var(--glass-border);
  border-radius:calc(14 * var(--u));
  background:var(--glass-bg);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter:var(--glass-filter);
  backdrop-filter:var(--glass-filter);
}
.card__quote{
  margin:0;font-size:calc(14 * var(--u));line-height:calc(20 * var(--u));
  font-weight:400;color:rgba(255,255,255,.87);
  position:relative;top:calc(-1 * var(--u));
}
.card__who{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:calc(12 * var(--u));height:calc(32 * var(--u))}
.card__id{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:relative;top:calc(-1 * var(--u))}
.card__name{font-size:calc(13 * var(--u));line-height:calc(16 * var(--u));font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.05em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.9);white-space:nowrap}
.card__role{margin-top:calc(1.5 * var(--u));font-size:calc(12 * var(--u));line-height:calc(16 * var(--u));color:rgba(255,255,255,.47);white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.avatar{
  flex:none;width:calc(32 * var(--u));height:calc(32 * var(--u));border-radius:50%;
  display:grid;place-items:center;
  font-size:calc(11 * var(--u));font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.02em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.9);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 calc(1 * var(--u)) rgba(255,255,255,.18);
}
.avatar--a{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f6b6a0,#8d6ab8)}
.avatar--b{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#9aa3b8,#3c4256)}
.avatar--c{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#ffb36b,#5b6cd6)}

/* trusted-by */
.trust{margin-top:calc(39.5 * var(--u));container-type:inline-size}
.trust__rule{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:calc(8 * var(--u));max-width:var(--measure)}
.trust__rule::before,.trust__rule::after{content:"";flex:1;height:calc(1 * var(--u));background:var(--hero-rule)}
.trust__label{font-size:calc(14 * var(--u));line-height:calc(20 * var(--u));color:rgba(255,255,255,.92);white-space:nowrap}
.marks{max-width:var(--measure);margin-top:calc(24.5 * var(--u));display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:calc(20 * var(--u))}
.marks__row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:calc(14 * var(--u)) calc(22 * var(--u));min-height:calc(20 * var(--u))}
.mark{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:calc(5 * var(--u));color:var(--logo-ink);font-size:calc(17 * var(--u));line-height:1;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.02em;white-space:nowrap}
.mark svg{width:calc(17 * var(--u));height:calc(17 * var(--u));flex:none}
.mark--word{font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.04em}
/* When the column can't hold the 4-up row (narrow tablet / small phone),
   the six marks re-flow as an even 3 x 2 grid instead of orphaning one. */
@container (max-width:333.5px){
  .marks{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,auto);justify-content:center;justify-items:center;gap:calc(14 * var(--u)) calc(12 * var(--u))}
  .marks__row{display:contents}
}

.legal{margin:0;font-size:calc(14 * var(--u));line-height:calc(20 * var(--u));color:var(--hero-faint);text-wrap:balance}

/* ---------------- Auth panel (right) ---------------- */
.auth{
  flex:1 1 auto;min-width:0;
  min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  background:var(--paper);
}
.auth__main{flex:1;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:calc(33.5 * var(--u)) calc(24 * var(--u)) 0}
.panel{width:calc(402 * var(--u));max-width:100%}

.panel__title{margin:0;font-size:calc(32 * var(--u));line-height:calc(40 * var(--u));font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.022em;color:var(--ink)}
.panel__sub{margin:calc(2 * var(--u)) 0 0;font-size:calc(17 * var(--u));line-height:calc(24 * var(--u));color:var(--muted)}

.form{margin-top:calc(20 * var(--u))}

/* passkey first (recommended): the strongest action, above the password form */
.passkey-slot{margin-top:calc(24 * var(--u));height:calc(44 * var(--u));padding:calc(1 * var(--u))}
.passkey{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:calc(12 * var(--u));width:100%;height:100%;
  padding:0 calc(10 * var(--u)) 0 calc(16 * var(--u));
  border:0;border-radius:calc(8 * var(--u));background:var(--ink);color:var(--on-ink);
  font-size:calc(15 * var(--u));line-height:calc(20 * var(--u));font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;
  transition:background-color .15s ease;
}
@media (hover:hover){.passkey:hover{background:#111827}}
.passkey:focus-visible{outline:calc(2 * var(--u)) solid #9ca3af;outline-offset:calc(2 * var(--u))}
.passkey__icon{width:calc(22 * var(--u));height:calc(22 * var(--u));flex:none}
.passkey__label{flex:1}
.pill{
  flex:none;padding:calc(3 * var(--u)) calc(8 * var(--u));border-radius:calc(6 * var(--u));
  background:#3b4fd8;color:#eef0ff;font-size:calc(11.5 * var(--u));line-height:calc(14 * var(--u));font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.005em;
}
.or.or--top{margin-top:calc(20 * var(--u))}
.field + .field{margin-top:calc(15 * var(--u))}
.label{display:block;font-size:calc(14 * var(--u));line-height:calc(20 * var(--u));font-weight:400;color:var(--muted)}
.control{position:relative;margin-top:calc(7 * var(--u))}
.control__icon{
  position:absolute;left:calc(9.5 * var(--u));top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  width:calc(16 * var(--u));height:calc(16 * var(--u));color:var(--icon);pointer-events:none;
}
.input{
  display:block;width:100%;height:calc(36 * var(--u));
  padding:0 calc(40 * var(--u)) 0 calc(30 * var(--u));
  font-size:calc(14 * var(--u));line-height:calc(20 * var(--u));color:var(--ink);
  background:var(--paper);
  border:calc(1 * var(--u)) solid var(--line);
  border-radius:calc(8 * var(--u));
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-xs);
  outline:none;
  transition:border-color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease;
}
.input::placeholder{color:var(--muted);opacity:1}
.input:focus-visible{border-color:#a3a3a3;box-shadow:var(--shadow-xs),0 0 0 calc(3 * var(--u)) rgba(163,163,163,.35)}
.reveal{
  position:absolute;right:calc(4.25 * var(--u));top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  width:calc(28 * var(--u));height:calc(28 * var(--u));padding:0;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;
  display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--icon);border-radius:calc(6 * var(--u));
}
.reveal svg{width:calc(14 * var(--u));height:calc(14 * var(--u))}
.reveal::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-6px}
.reveal:focus-visible{outline:calc(2 * var(--u)) solid #a3a3a3;outline-offset:0}

.row{margin-top:calc(16 * var(--u));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:calc(20 * var(--u))}
.check{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:calc(12.5 * var(--u));cursor:pointer;font-size:calc(14 * var(--u));line-height:calc(20 * var(--u));color:var(--ink)}
.check input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:1px;height:1px}
.check__text{position:relative;top:calc(-1 * var(--u))}
.check__box{
  width:calc(16 * var(--u));height:calc(16 * var(--u));flex:none;border-radius:calc(4 * var(--u));
  border:calc(1 * var(--u)) solid var(--line);background:var(--paper);box-shadow:var(--shadow-xs);
  display:grid;place-items:center;color:var(--on-ink);
}
.check__box svg{width:calc(11 * var(--u));height:calc(11 * var(--u));opacity:0}
.check input:checked + .check__box{background:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink)}
.check input:checked + .check__box svg{opacity:1}
.check input:focus-visible + .check__box{box-shadow:0 0 0 calc(3 * var(--u)) rgba(163,163,163,.45)}
.link-strong{font-size:calc(14 * var(--u));line-height:calc(20 * var(--u));font-weight:500;color:var(--ink)}
@media (hover:hover){.link-strong:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:calc(3 * var(--u))}}

.cta-slot{margin-top:calc(20 * var(--u));height:calc(36 * var(--u));padding:calc(1 * var(--u))}
.cta{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%;height:100%;
  border:0;border-radius:calc(8 * var(--u));background:var(--ink);color:var(--on-ink);
  font-size:calc(14 * var(--u));line-height:calc(20 * var(--u));font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;
  transition:background-color .15s ease;
}
@media (hover:hover){.cta:hover{background:#111827}}
.cta:focus-visible{outline:calc(2 * var(--u)) solid #9ca3af;outline-offset:calc(2 * var(--u))}

.or{margin-top:calc(24 * var(--u));display:flex;align-items:center;gap:calc(16 * var(--u));height:calc(20 * var(--u))}
.or::before,.or::after{content:"";flex:1;height:calc(1 * var(--u));background:var(--line);transform:translateY(calc(-.5 * var(--u)))}
.or span{font-size:calc(14 * var(--u));line-height:calc(20 * var(--u));color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}

.providers{margin-top:calc(24 * var(--u));display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:calc(12 * var(--u))}
.provider{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:calc(8 * var(--u));
  height:calc(36 * var(--u));width:100%;
  border:calc(1 * var(--u)) solid var(--line);border-radius:calc(8 * var(--u));
  background:var(--paper);box-shadow:var(--shadow-xs);cursor:pointer;
  font-size:calc(14 * var(--u));line-height:calc(20 * var(--u));font-weight:500;color:var(--ink);
  transition:background-color .15s ease;
}
@media (hover:hover){.provider:hover{background:#f9fafb}}
.provider:focus-visible{outline:calc(2 * var(--u)) solid #a3a3a3;outline-offset:calc(2 * var(--u))}
.provider__mark{width:calc(16 * var(--u));height:calc(16 * var(--u));flex:none}

.switch{margin:calc(24 * var(--u)) 0 0;text-align:center;letter-spacing:-.0045em;font-size:calc(14 * var(--u));line-height:calc(20 * var(--u));color:var(--muted)}
.switch a{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
@media (hover:hover){.switch a:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:calc(3 * var(--u))}}

.auth__foot{padding:calc(24 * var(--u)) calc(24 * var(--u)) calc(33 * var(--u));display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:calc(12 * var(--u))}
.auth__foot a{font-size:calc(14 * var(--u));line-height:calc(20 * var(--u));color:var(--muted)}
@media (hover:hover){.auth__foot a:hover{color:var(--ink)}}

/* ==================================================================
   Touch: inputs at 16px+ so iOS/iPadOS never zoom on focus
   ================================================================== */
@media (pointer:coarse){
  .input{font-size:max(16px, calc(14 * var(--u)))}
}

/* ==================================================================
   Mobile architecture (< 740px)
   Below 740px the split cannot hold both a 290px brand column (one full
   glass card + inset) and a 450px auth column (402px form + gutters).
   The same DOM is re-placed on a single-column grid:
     [gradient]  logo ¬∑ headline ¬∑ copy
     [paper]     sign-in form ¬∑ legal links
     [gradient]  testimonials ¬∑ trusted-by ¬∑ copyright
   Brand and auth wrappers become display:contents so their children are
   grid items; the two gradient bands are the grid's own ::before/::after.
   ================================================================== */
@media (max-width:739.98px){
  :root{--g:clamp(16px, 5vw, 32px)}

  .shell{
    display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);
    grid-template-rows:auto auto 1fr auto auto auto auto;
  }
  .shell::before,.shell::after{
    content:"";grid-column:1;z-index:0;
    background:#0b0a1f var(--brand-img) center top / cover no-repeat;
  }
  .shell::before{grid-row:1 / 3;background-position:center 72%} /* the beam, not the keyhole, behind the phone headline */
  .shell::after{grid-row:5 / 8;background-position:center bottom}

  .brand,.brand__mid,.auth{display:contents}
  .brand::before,.brand::after{display:none}  /* the panel is display:contents here: no layers, the still shows in two bands */
  .brand__top,.hero,.auth__main,.auth__foot,.reel,.trust,.brand__bottom{grid-column:1;position:relative;z-index:1}
  .brand__top{grid-row:1}
  .hero{grid-row:2}
  .auth__main{grid-row:3}
  .auth__foot{grid-row:4}
  .reel{grid-row:5}
  .trust{grid-row:6}
  .brand__bottom{grid-row:7}

  /* brand content column */
  .brand__inset{--inset:var(--g);--measure:min(100%, 480px);padding-left:var(--g);padding-right:var(--g)}
  .brand__top{padding-top:calc(20px + env(safe-area-inset-top))}
  .hero{padding-top:32px;padding-bottom:36px}
  .hero__title{max-width:min(100%, 338px);font-size:clamp(26px, 7.6vw, 30px);line-height:1.2}

  /* testimonials: same 260px glass cards, marquee aligned to the gutter */
  .reel{margin-top:40px;height:260px;overflow:clip}
  .reel__track{animation-name:reel-m;transform:translateX(var(--g))}
  @keyframes reel-m{
    from{transform:translateX(var(--g))}
    to{transform:translateX(calc(var(--g) - 828px))}
  }
  .trust{margin-top:36px}
  .brand__bottom{padding-top:36px;padding-bottom:calc(28px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}

  /* auth */
  .auth__main{align-items:flex-start;padding:32px var(--g) 8px}
  .input{height:40px;font-size:16px}
  .cta-slot{height:42px}
  .provider{height:40px}
  .reveal{width:36px;height:36px;right:0}
  .check{padding-block:6px;margin-block:-6px}
  .link-strong{padding-block:8px}
  .auth__foot{padding:4px var(--g) 28px;gap:4px}
  .auth__foot a{padding:12px 4px}
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .reel__track{animation:none}
  .brand::before,.brand::after{animation:none}
  *{transition:none!important}
}
/* ==================================================================
   Entrance ‚Äî pre-roll states only.
   Applied solely while <html> has .is-entering (set by a tiny head script
   when motion is allowed). The timeline removes the class on its first
   frame; a 3s failsafe removes it if the script never runs.
   Backgrounds are never touched: the gradient and the paper are the stage.
   ================================================================== */
html.is-entering :is(
  .logo__mark,.logo__word,.hero__title,.hero__copy,.card,
  .trust__label,.marks__row,.legal,
  .panel__title,.panel__sub,.passkey-slot,.field,.row,.cta-slot,.or span,.provider,.switch,.auth__foot a
){opacity:0}
html.is-entering :is(.or,.trust__rule)::before,
html.is-entering :is(.or,.trust__rule)::after{opacity:0}

/* line masks used only during the headline reveal (removed afterwards) */
/* clip, not overflow+padding: zero layout footprint, room for descenders */
.e-line{display:block;clip-path:inset(0 -.1em -.25em -.1em)}
.e-in{display:block}
</style>
<script>
/* Entrance pre-roll: only when motion is welcome and WAAPI exists. Failsafe un-hides after 3s. */
(function(){var d=document.documentElement;
  if(!('animate' in d)||(window.matchMedia&&matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches))return;
  d.classList.add('is-entering');
  window.__entranceFailsafe=setTimeout(function(){d.classList.remove('is-entering')},3000);
})();
</script>
</head>
<body>
<div class="shell">

  <!-- ============================ BRAND PANEL ============================ -->
  <aside class="brand" aria-label="About Keylight">
    <div class="brand__inset brand__top">
      <a class="logo" href="#" aria-label="Keylight home">
        <span class="logo__mark" aria-hidden="true">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><circle cx="12" cy="9.5" r="5" stroke="#030712" stroke-width="2.6"/><rect x="10.7" y="13" width="2.6" height="8" rx="1.3" fill="#030712"/></svg>
        </span>
        <span class="logo__word">keylight.</span>
      </a>
    </div>

    <div class="brand__mid">
      <div class="brand__inset hero">
        <h2 class="hero__title">Unlock calmly. Grow without worry.</h2>
        <p class="hero__copy">Sign in with a glance, not a guess. Made to keep every team in flow while each account stays sealed.</p>
      </div>

      <div class="reel" aria-label="What teams say">
        <div class="reel__track">
          <figure class="card" style="margin:0"><blockquote class="card__quote">"Passkeys rolled out in one single afternoon. Our support queue for lost passwords simply went quiet."</blockquote><figcaption class="card__who"><span class="card__id"><span class="card__name">Nora Lindqv</span><span class="card__role">Co-founder, Tidewater</span></span><span class="avatar avatar--a" aria-hidden="true">NL</span></figcaption></figure>
          <figure class="card" style="margin:0"><blockquote class="card__quote">"Exactly the right mix of strictness and ease. It let us ship our new app weeks ahead of the plan we made."</blockquote><figcaption class="card__who"><span class="card__id"><span class="card__name">Ravi Shankar</span><span class="card__role">Head of Platform at Copperline AI</span></span><span class="avatar avatar--b" aria-hidden="true">RS</span></figcaption></figure>
          <figure class="card" style="margin:0"><blockquote class="card__quote">"Sign-in is now the part nobody asks about. Rollout was quick, and the final flow feels really finished."</blockquote><figcaption class="card__who"><span class="card__id"><span class="card__name">Maren Okonkwo</span><span class="card__role">Design Lead at Fernhill Co</span></span><span class="avatar avatar--c" aria-hidden="true">MO</span></figcaption></figure>

          <button class="provider" type="button"><svg class="provider__mark" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M15 3h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-4"/><path d="m10 17 5-5-5-5"/><path d="M15 12H3"/></svg><span>Continue with Apple</span></button>
          <button class="provider" type="button"><svg class="provider__mark" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M15 3h4a2 2 0 0 1 2 2v14a2 2 0 0 1-2 2h-4"/><path d="m10 17 5-5-5-5"/><path d="M15 12H3"/></svg><span>Continue with GitHub</span></button>

      <a href="#">Terms</a><a href="#">Privacy</a><a href="#">Support</a>
    </nav>
  </main>
</div>

<script>
(() => {
  const btn = document.querySelector('.reveal');
  const pw = document.getElementById('password');
  btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    const show = pw.type === 'password';
    pw.type = show ? 'text' : 'password';
    btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(show));
    btn.setAttribute('aria-label', show ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password');
    btn.querySelector('.eye-open').hidden = show;
    btn.querySelector('.eye-off').hidden = !show;
  });
  document.getElementById('signin').addEventListener('submit', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const bad = [...e.target.querySelectorAll('.input')].find(i => !i.value.trim());
    if (bad) { bad.focus(); return; }
  });
})();

/* ==================================================================
   Entrance ‚Äî one master timeline, played once on first load.
   Built on the Web Animations API (no dependency). Every tween is placed on
   the same clock via `delay`, resolves to the authored style, and is
   cancelled when the whole timeline has finished ‚Äî leaving the page static.

   Motion vocabulary
     RISE     headlines rise line-by-line out of an invisible line mask
     SETTLE   supporting copy + form rows: short rise with opacity
     LIFT     glass cards: rise + scale .985 -> 1, layered behind the copy
     DRAW     hairline rules grow outward from the label they frame
     PRESENCE micro / legal details: opacity only, nearly unnoticed

   Eye path:  brand mark  ->  statement  ->  greeting  ->  form, top to bottom
              (cards lift in beneath while the form resolves)  ->  quiet details
   ================================================================== */
(() => {
  const root = document.documentElement;
  if (!root.classList.contains('is-entering')) return;      // reduced motion / no WAAPI
  let started = false;

  const EXPO   = 'cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)';    // decisive start, long silk finish
  const QUINT  = 'cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)';
  const DRAW   = 'cubic-bezier(.65,0,.35,1)';   // symmetric, for lines being drawn
  const SOFT   = 'cubic-bezier(.33,1,.68,1)';

  const start = () => {
    if (started) return;
    started = true;
    clearTimeout(window.__entranceFailsafe);
    try { run(); } catch (e) { root.classList.remove('is-entering'); }
  };
  // fonts are embedded; wait for them (max 400ms) so line masks match final wrapping
  Promise.race([document.fonts.ready, new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 400))])
    .then(() => requestAnimationFrame(start));

  function run() {
    const $  = (s, c = document) => c.querySelector(s);
    const $$ = (s, c = document) => [...c.querySelectorAll(s)];
    const W = innerWidth, H = innerHeight;

    // one design pixel at the current scale (--u), and a calmer distance on phones
    const probe = document.createElement('div');
    probe.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;visibility:hidden;width:calc(100 * var(--u))';
    document.body.appendChild(probe);
    const u = probe.getBoundingClientRect().width / 100 || 1;
    probe.remove();
    const k = matchMedia('(max-width:739.98px)').matches ? .75 : 1;
    const d = px => +(px * u * k).toFixed(2);

    const anims = [], restores = [];
    // only the opening composition performs; anything below the fold is simply there
    const inView = el => { const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.height > 0 && r.bottom > 0 && r.top < H && r.right > 0 && r.left < W; };
    const play = (el, frames, delay, duration, easing, pseudoElement) => {
      const opts = { delay, duration, easing, fill: 'both' };
      if (pseudoElement) opts.pseudoElement = pseudoElement;
      anims.push(el.animate(frames, opts));
    };

    /* ---- behaviours ---- */
    const RISE = (el, t, dur = 950, stagger = 90) => {
      if (!el || !inView(el)) return t;
      splitLines(el).forEach((line, i) =>
        play(line, [{ transform: 'translateY(125%)' }, { transform: 'none' }], t + i * stagger, dur, EXPO));
    };
    const SETTLE = (el, t, y = 10, dur = 640, scale) => {
      if (!el || !inView(el)) return;
      const from = `translate3d(0,${d(y)}px,0)` + (scale ? ` scale(${scale})` : '');
      play(el, [{ opacity: 0, transform: from }, { opacity: 1, transform: 'none' }], t, dur, QUINT);
    };
    const LIFT = (el, t) => {
      if (!el || !inView(el)) return;
      play(el, [{ opacity: 0, transform: `translate3d(0,${d(28)}px,0) scale(.985)` }, { opacity: 1, transform: 'none' }], t, 1050, EXPO);
    };
    const DRAWN = (el, pseudo, t, origin) => {
      if (!el || !inView(el)) return;
      const base = getComputedStyle(el, pseudo).transform;
      const b = base && base !== 'none' ? base + ' ' : '';
      play(el, [{ opacity: 1, transformOrigin: origin, transform: b + 'scaleX(0)' },
                { opacity: 1, transformOrigin: origin, transform: b + 'scaleX(1)' }], t, 760, DRAW, pseudo);
    };
    const PRESENCE = (el, t, dur = 520) => {
      if (!el || !inView(el)) return;
      play(el, [{ opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 1 }], t, dur, SOFT);
    };

    /* headline line masks: wrap each rendered line, restore the original markup afterwards */
    function splitLines(el) {
      const original = el.innerHTML;
      const esc = s => s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;');
      const words = el.textContent.trim().split(/\s+/);
      el.innerHTML = words.map(w => `<span class="e-w">${esc(w)}</span>`).join(' ');
      const lines = []; let top = null;
      $$('.e-w', el).forEach(s => { if (s.offsetTop !== top) { top = s.offsetTop; lines.push([]); } lines[lines.length - 1].push(s.textContent); });
      el.innerHTML = lines.map(l => `<span class="e-line"><span class="e-in">${l.map(esc).join(' ')}</span></span>`).join('');
      restores.push(() => { el.innerHTML = original; });
      return $$('.e-in', el);
    }

    /* ---- MASTER TIMELINE (ms) ---- */
    // 01  brand signature: the mark settles, the wordmark is unveiled from it
    SETTLE($('.logo__mark'), 0, 0, 760, .86);
    if (inView($('.logo__word')))
      play($('.logo__word'), [{ opacity: 1, clipPath: 'inset(-30% 100% -30% 0)', transform: `translate3d(${-d(8)}px,0,0)` },
                              { opacity: 1, clipPath: 'inset(-30% -6% -30% 0)', transform: 'none' }], 90, 860, EXPO);

    // 02  the statement ‚Äî the loudest type on the page rises first
    RISE($('.hero__title'), 160);

    // 03  the greeting answers it on the right, same vocabulary, quieter
    RISE($('.panel__title'), 320, 860);
    SETTLE($('.panel__sub'), 430, 8, 600);
    SETTLE($('.passkey-slot'), 500, 10, 680, .985);
    const orTop = $('.or--top');
    DRAWN(orTop, '::before', 560, 'right center');
    DRAWN(orTop, '::after', 560, 'left center');
    PRESENCE($('.or--top span'), 600, 480);

    // 04  supporting copy under the statement
    SETTLE($('.hero__copy'), 470, 12, 720);

    // 05  the form resolves top to bottom; the CTA lands with a hair of scale
    $$('.form .field, .form .row').forEach((el, i) => SETTLE(el, 620 + i * 70, 10, 620));
    SETTLE($('.cta-slot'), 840, 10, 680, .985);

    // 06  glass testimonials lift in underneath, in reading order (left -> right)
    $$('.card').filter(inView)
      .sort((a, b) => a.getBoundingClientRect().left - b.getBoundingClientRect().left)
      .forEach((c, i) => LIFT(c, 620 + i * 90));

    // 07  divider draws outward from its label, then the providers settle
    const or = $('.or:not(.or--top)');
    DRAWN(or, '::before', 900, 'right center');
    DRAWN(or, '::after', 900, 'left center');
    PRESENCE($('.or:not(.or--top) span'), 940, 480);
    $$('.provider').forEach((el, i) => SETTLE(el, 960 + i * 60, 8, 560));

    // 08  quiet details close the composition
    const rule = $('.trust__rule');
    DRAWN(rule, '::before', 1000, 'right center');
    DRAWN(rule, '::after', 1000, 'left center');
    PRESENCE($('.trust__label'), 1060);
    PRESENCE($('.switch'), 1080);
    $$('.marks__row').forEach((el, i) => PRESENCE(el, 1140 + i * 80, 600));
    $$('.auth__foot a').forEach((el, i) => PRESENCE(el, 1160 + i * 40, 480));
    PRESENCE($('.legal'), 1280, 520);

    // the first frame already carries every pre-roll state (fill: both), so lift the CSS veil now
    root.classList.remove('is-entering');

    // 09  stillness: cancel every tween (each ends on the authored style), restore markup
    Promise.all(anims.map(a => a.finished)).then(() => {
      anims.forEach(a => a.cancel());
      restores.forEach(f => f());
    }, () => restores.forEach(f => f()));
  }
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
~~~
```

### [FREE-102] KAIRN (`kairn`)
- **Danh mục:** Ski Gear | **Loại:** hero | **Độ dài:** 4,151 ký tự
- **Video Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/kairn-hero.mp4
- **Poster 1280px:** https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261021_014946_d3c77a92-fd20-4fbd-aeb9-063b4da8009c.png&w=1280&q=85

```markdown
# Prompt: KAIRN Alpine 26 hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **landing hero for a premium ski-goggle brand**, **KAIRN** (collection "Alpine 26"). Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is light-mode winter editorial: a full-bleed photo of a model in an all-white puffer suit and white knit beanie, seated in the snow and looking up, wearing mirrored **ice-blue goggles** that reflect glacier peaks. The background is a calm, almost studio-clean pale icy sky with only a faint low mountain ridge and light snow.

## Scene

- **Plate:** the background is ONE 16:10 photo (1728×1080): `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/18a4a3c1-2af7-4c4a-9045-f6ddff26f4ca.jpg`. `object-fit:cover`, position 50% 30% (phones: 50% 18%, then 50% 0).
- **Motion:** a 5s muted looping video of the same plate plays over it with **identical cover rules**: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/823d013d-bf03-4967-b08f-63c3752df435.mp4` (1152×720). Snow drifts across the frame, the model turns her head slightly and the goggle reflections glint.
  - Fade it in once its first frame is ready.
- **Readability:** a soft, cool navy side-shade (`rgba(22,52,84,.34)` → 0 by 55% from the left, and .2 at the far right) keeps white type readable on the pale sky.
- **Rule:** nothing in the scene is drawn or animated in code.

## Type and colour

- **Display:** **Anybody** (variable width), set wide (font-stretch 115–150%), for the logo, nav, headline, card titles and buttons.
- **Text:** **Inter** for small text.
- **Colours:** text white, accent **ice cyan `#44DAFD`**, cream card `#F3F1E9`, ink black.

## Layout (desktop: a measured 1546×1017 canvas scaled by --k = min(vw/1546, vh/1017))

- **Top left:** the text wordmark **"KAIRN"** at 28px, wide, with "KA" in cyan and "IRN" in white.
- **Top centre:** "COLLECTION / OUR WORLD", wide caps, 15.4px.
- **Top right:** an account icon, "BAG" and a round white counter "0".
- **Middle left:**
  - three slider dots (the first cyan)
  - the eyebrow "BUILT FOR THE WHITEST DAYS"
  - a huge wide, thin headline at about 106px: **"FORM." / "FUNCTION."**, then **"VISION"** in outline letters with a cyan stroke
- **Middle right, a 2×2 tile cluster:**
  - **Lens card** (cyan): "01 / LENS EDITION", a large bold "BLUE / FROST" and "A cooler perspective".
  - **Beside it:** "ALPINE / 26" in large wide type.
  - **Glass circle:** a frosted cool-blue circle with a ↗ arrow and "01 / 04" with a progress ring (cyan arc).
  - **Product card** (cream): the ice-blue mirrored goggles, then "MODEL 03" and "EXPLORE THE FRAME".
- **Bottom left:** a frosted navy glass story card with a skier thumbnail, "GLACIER COLLECTION" in cyan, and "Crafted for the summits. / KAIRN goggles sharpen every / view. Read more".
- **Bottom centre:** a cyan "EXPLORE COLLECTION" button sitting on a thin horizontal rule across the page.
- **Bottom right:** "FOLLOW US" and three round outline social icons (X, Facebook, Instagram), the first ringed in cyan.

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:** a one-time CSS entrance, about 2.2s.
  - The logo and nav settle; the dots, then the eyebrow.
  - Each headline line types up in turn.
  - The lens card, ALPINE 26, the glass circle and the product card arrive.
  - Then the story card and the button; the rule draws across; the social links fade in last.
- **Hover:** the button lightens to `#6FE3FF`.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no video.

## Tablet and phone

- **Tablet:** a one-screen portrait composition: a header row, the photo, the headline, the story card with the 2×2 tiles, and the action row.
- **Phone:**
  - a viewport-height hero with the photo masked into the page
  - the nav moves into a burger menu
  - below come the 2×2 tiles, the story card and the social row

## Acceptance check (1440×900)

- The pale icy hero shows the white-suited model with blue goggles in the centre, the big wide FORM / FUNCTION / VISION on the left and the cyan / cream tile cluster on the right.
- Snow visibly drifts and the goggles glint in the loop.
- **Content:** no real brand names.
```

```markdown
# Prompt: Corvana AI hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **landing hero for an AI copilot that runs clinic front desks** for a fictional company, **Corvana AI**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. It's bright, clean and warm: a white page, a coral accent, a pixel-art heartbeat line running behind the main button, and a strip of three tall rounded panels (a laughing patient, a check-ins chart and a patient-trust widget over a coral peony).

## Type and colour

- **Type:** a tight neo-grotesk (Inter / Inter Display style) for everything, self-hosted woff2 at 400/500/600. The headline is 500 weight with very tight tracking (about −0.045em).
- **Page:** white `#FEFEFE`, ink `#000`, nav ink `#3A3C40`, muted `#5E6064`.
- **Accents:** coral `#F8533F`, announcement coral `#FA6E5C`, data violet `#7A5CF0`, chip lavender `#F1EDFE→#E8E2FD` with violet text `#6A4CEB`.

## Scaling

- **Desktop:** the composition is authored in reference px of a **1514×1039** artboard: `--u = min(100cqw/1514, max(100svh/1039, .68px))`, centred.
- **Below 1024px wide or portrait:** the page re-flows into one locked screen with real px and a swipeable panel strip with dots.

## Layout (desktop, reference px)

1. **Announcement bar:** coral, 38px tall. "30% off for all new clinics." plus the underlined link "CLAIM THE DEAL NOW".
2. **Nav:** white, 68px, with a hairline bottom border.
   - **Left:** a blue-violet gradient "V" mark and "Corvana AI".
   - **Centre:** Care (current, bold) · Features · Clinics · Customers · Careers.
   - **Right:** a light-grey "Watch a Demo" pill.
3. **Headline:** two centred lines, about 72u, **"The AI Copilot Made For Calmer / Clinical Coordination"**.
4. **Subline:** about 22.4u / 31u, two lines: "From first check-in to aftercare reminders, take over routine tasks / and paperwork while giving every patient a warm welcome."
5. **Main button:** a 233×71.5u glass ring (translucent white, hairline border, soft drop shadow) around a black pill, "Start Your Trial", 22u.
6. **Heartbeat field:** behind the button, a pixel ECG trace spans the whole 1514u width.
   - **Pixels:** 6.2u squares on a 9.6u grid, coral `#F8533F` with lighter `#FB7565` baseline dots.
   - **Shape:** the baseline sits 9u below the button centre. Four heartbeats at −462, −225, +231 and +468u from centre each have a small P bump, a Q dip, a tall R spike (≈60u up), an S drop (≈47u down) and a T bump. Draw every spike as a vertical pixel staircase.
   - **Ends:** the baseline thins to sparse dots and fades toward both ends.
7. **Panel strip:** 1313.5×429.5u, radius 16, three columns 436.5 / 425.5 / 436.5u with 7.5u gaps.
   - **Patient panel:** a laughing older woman with wavy silver hair, gold hoops and a coral knit sweater, on a smooth **mint-green → pale sky-blue studio gradient**.
     - Still: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/c43c6772-ae79-45f3-a2ff-90a401f03b48.webp
     - Loop on top: `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/39c69b84-0ac5-485f-ae42-3bd7d521989e.mp4` (960×960, 5s, muted, loops; first = last frame). She laughs, her shoulders shake, and her hair sways.
     - The loop is the portrait mirror-padded 47/1208 on each side to a square. Lay it at **107.78% width, left −3.89%, full height** over the 1208:1302 portrait frame so it aligns exactly. Fade it in once it is playing.
   - **Metric panel:** `#EAEAEA` with a white 339×316u card.
     - **Text:** "Check-ins Completed" with a › button, "18.7" (50u, 600) with a small "K", and a lavender chip "+21.3%" followed by "vs Prior Week".
     - **Chart:** a violet line `#7A5CF0` and a coral line `#F8533F` rise left to right. The coral end has a filled dot with a soft ring, the violet end has a ringed dot, there's a grey drop line, and a row of grey tick marks runs along the bottom.
   - **Peony panel:** a macro of ruffled coral peony petals filling the whole panel: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/b6730025-6d74-465e-8978-f9909c47095a.webp.
     - **Trust card:** a frosted 292×241u card, "Patient Trust Rating", "98%" (44.5u, 400), a symmetric violet bar-wave meter and "Wonderful".
     - **Avatars card:** a white 66.5u card below it, with three overlapping rounded-square avatars, "62K+" and "Clinicians Onboarded".

## Motion

- **Entrance:** one Web Animations timeline behind an `entry-pending` class, with a failsafe.
  - The bar text, the logo, the nav links (55ms stagger) and the demo pill rise in.
  - Each headline line wipes up out of a clip mask, then the subline.
  - The glass ring fades in and the black button rises.
  - The metric card and the right stack rise. The chart ticks fade, the two lines draw in with stroke-dashoffset, then the dots pop, and the bar-wave opens from the centre.
- **Heartbeat trace:** loops forever. Each pixel has `--t` = its x-fraction, and a 3.2s linear animation delayed by `--t`. A bright head sweeps left → right like a monitor, and pixels settle to 58% opacity behind it.
- **Hover:** the black button lifts 1px with a deeper shadow, and the › button gets a grey disc.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance, no sweep, no video.

## Acceptance check (1440×900)

- **Above the strip:** the coral bar, the nav, the two-line headline, the subline and the glass-ringed black button. The heartbeat line runs edge to edge through the button row, with four spikes and a moving bright trace.
- **Panel strip:** the woman laughs in motion on the mint-to-sky gradient, the chart has coral and violet lines, and the peony panel holds the trust card and the avatars card.
- **Content:** no real company names anywhere.
```

```markdown
- **Projection:** Lambert conformal conic (standard parallels 29.5° and 45.5°, central meridian 106°W). It's fitted by least squares to a 1440×810 frame so that, for example:
  - the Washington/BC coast sits at about (539, 343)
  - San Diego at (539, 600)
  - the tip of Florida at (1009, 733)
  - eastern Maine at (1107, 402)
```

```markdown
- **Colours:** text white, page `#1e0a00` behind the image, graffiti orange gradient `#C2410C` → `#F97316` → `#FB923C` with an orange glow.

## Layout

- **Nav:** spread across the top edge, "ABOUT US — SERVICES — OUR CASES — BLOG — CONTACTS — VACANCIES", with flexible hairline rules between items.
- **Title:** "MK CONSULTING" spans the full width under the nav.
- **Ring:** hangs centred below the title, about 886u wide; the chains rise behind the title letters.
- **Graffiti:** "WE BUILD YOUR CASE" in spray-paint lettering follows the curve of the ring's front band, using an SVG `textPath` on a quadratic arc with a grainy turbulence and glow filter.
- **Tagline:** "LEGAL STUDIO FOR / CREATIVES" centred under the ring.

## Motion (UI)

- **Entrance:**
  - The nav fades in, then the title letters wipe up one by one.
  - The ring fades in.
  - The graffiti draws left to right with a clip.
  - The tagline lines wipe up.
- **Magnet ring:** the hanging ring (with its workers, chains and graffiti, as one layer) follows the mouse slightly, like a magnet.
  - **Pivot:** it swings from the point where the chains fade out at the top (`transform-origin: 50% 33%`), so the chains stay attached.
  - **Pull:** measure the pointer's offset from the ring's centre (50% across, 66% down the ring box). The pull fades smoothly to zero beyond about the ring's width. Up close it moves toward the pointer by up to 34px (vertical movement at 45% of horizontal) and leans up to 3.5° toward it, pendulum style: pointer on the right swings the bottom right.
  - **Easing:** each frame eases toward the target with a frame-rate-independent factor `1 − e^(−dt/140ms)`, so it glides with no jitter, and drifts back to rest when the pointer leaves the window.
  - **Clock:** time comes from a long Web Animation clock rather than wall-clock time.
  - **Limits:** only on fine, hover-capable pointers; off on touch and for reduced motion.
- **Hover:** nav links dim to 70%.
- **Reduced motion:** no entrance and no magnet.

## Phones

- **Nav:** wraps into two compact rows.
- **Title:** stacks as "MK / CONSULTING".
- **Ring:** shows its full hoist chain.
- **Tagline:** sits at the bottom.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- The orange graffiti wall fills the page and MK CONSULTING spans the top.
- The rusty ring with workers hangs below on chains, with "WE BUILD YOUR CASE" sprayed along its band.
- The tagline is centred beneath it.
- **Content:** no real brands and no gibberish graffiti.
```

```markdown
# Prompt: Zapline trading CTA hero ("Royal Violet")

Build a single-file, one-screen **trading-product hero** for a fictional on-chain trading tool, **Zapline**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. The look is a pure black starfield with the glowing violet rim of a giant planet arching across the top. A big bold headline sits under it, and a dark product dashboard rises from the bottom of the screen with a violet light line along its top edge.

## Media

- **Glow video:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e859f229-8ebd-43fb-a5a0-58006ba75327.mp4` (1460×624, 4s, muted, loops).
  - **Content:** the violet and magenta planet rim on black. The glow pulses, plasma ripples along the arc, light streaks race outward, and the camera pushes in slowly.
  - **Loop:** the last second crossfades into the first, so it loops without a jump and never plays in reverse.
  - **Placement:** desktop only. Lay it over the star layer with `mix-blend-mode: screen` so its black stays transparent. It covers the top 1672×717 design px of the stage, and fades in (0.8s) when ready.
- **Fallback:** until then (and on phones), the rim is painted on a canvas from a small polar colour table, `panel-texture.png` / `chart-texture.png` (violet, embedded).
- **Stars:** procedural white dots on a canvas.
- **Dashboard glow:** `https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/e0e14572-12e1-4c08-b471-a21521844945.png`, a screen-blended strip above the dashboard.
```

```markdown
- .btn: inline-flex centered, height 36px, padding 0 16px, radius 999px, bg var(--olive), color #f3f8e4, 13px, weight 600, letter-spacing -.01em, white-space nowrap,
  box-shadow inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.25), 0 2px 6px rgba(60,80,10,.25); transition transform .3s, background .3s; hover: translateY(-1px), bg #5a7c14.
- .w (split word span): inline-block, will-change transform/filter/opacity.
- .glass (frosted square): absolute, radius 12px, bg rgba(255,255,255,.16), 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.55), backdrop-filter blur(10px) saturate(1.2) (+ -webkit-), box-shadow inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4).
- .grid-sq: absolute, 1px solid #edf0e8, radius 10px, pointer-events none.
- Keyframes: driftA → translateX(26px) translateY(4px); driftB → translateX(-30px) translateY(6px).
  .drift-a: driftA 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate. .drift-b: driftB 17s ease-in-out infinite alternate.

==================================================
4. STRUCTURE
==================================================
<body class="intro">
  <div class="backdrop">  (fixed, inset -40px, z 0, background HERO_POSTER center 70%/cover, filter blur(18px) saturate(1.1), transform scale(1.3))
  <div id="app">  (relative, z 1, bg #fff, transform-origin 50% 50vh, overflow clip; while body.intro: transform scale(.9), border-radius 28px)
     sections: #hero, #stats, #loop, #cta, footer#footer

--------------------------------------------------
4a. HERO  (section.hero#hero: relative, height 100vh, min-height 620px, overflow hidden, bg #fff)
--------------------------------------------------
- Floating pill nav (.nav): absolute top 22px, centered (left 50%, translateX(-50%)), z 20, flex, gap 44px, padding 5px 5px 5px 16px, radius 999px, bg rgba(255,255,255,.9),
  box-shadow 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.05), 0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.06), backdrop-filter blur(8px).
  - Brand link (.brand, href #hero, aria-label "Petalyx home"): flex, gap 6px, 22px, weight 500, letter-spacing -.04em. Logo SVG 30x22:
    <svg viewBox="0 0 30 22"><circle cx="4" cy="17" r="3.6" fill="currentColor"/><path d="M10.5 18.5 16.8 5.2 25.5 18.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="5.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg>
    then lowercase text "petalyx".
  - Button .btn "Start for $0" (href #cta).
- Cloud left (.cloud.cloud-l, data-par="-60"): absolute, top -3%, left -5%, width min(44vw,640px); inner <img class="drift-a"> = CLOUD_A at width 100%.
- Cloud right (.cloud.cloud-r, data-par="-90"): top 2%, right -6%, width min(42vw,620px); <img class="drift-b"> = CLOUD_B.
- Headline h1#heroTitle.split: absolute, z 6, top 31%, full width, centered, font-size clamp(34px,5.2vw,76px), weight 400, letter-spacing -.045em, line-height 1.04, padding 0 16px.
  Text: "Benchmark the impact of<br>all your <em>AI staff.</em>"  — em: color var(--olive), italic, weight 500.

  <video id="heroVideo" autoplay muted loop playsinline preload="auto" poster=HERO_POSTER src=HERO_VIDEO>, width/height 100%, object-fit cover, object-position center 70%.

4b. STATS  (section.stats#stats: relative, 100vh, min-height 680px, overflow hidden, bg #fff)
--------------------------------------------------

- Tree: .tree-wrap absolute z 2, left 50% translateX(-50%), bottom -2%, width min(340px,58vw); <img id="tree" class="tree"> = TREE.
- .stats-inner: relative z 3, height 100%, flex column, centered both axes, gap 22px, padding 0 16px. Contains:
  1) span.pill.reveal "Teams rely on us"

       "Staff Time Freed"   40   0  "%"

     Store as data-to, data-dec, data-suf; initial text "0%" / "0+".
  4) .cards-shadow: width min(820px,94%), height 10px, margin-top -18px, radius 50%, background radial-gradient(closest-side, rgba(0,0,0,.08), transparent), z 3.

4c. HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP HOVER ACCORDION  (section.loop#loop: relative, 100vh, min-height 680px, overflow hidden, bg #fff)
--------------------------------------------------
NOT a horizontal scroll. It's a full-width, full-height row of 3 vertical panels separated by thin 1px lines (var(--line)). One panel is active (expanded); the others collapse to narrow strips that clip their giant number.
- .loop-cloud (data-par="-50"): absolute z 3, top 4vh, left -4vw, width min(36vw,520px). <img class="drift-a"> = CLOUD_A plus three .glass squares inside: (left 6%, top 30%, width 15%), (left 23%, top 58%, width 13%), (left 38%, top 24%, width 13%), all aspect-ratio 1.
- .loop-head: absolute z 4, top 9vh, full width, centered column, gap 16px, padding 0 16px:
```
