```markdown
- .track#track: absolute z 2, inset 0, display flex.
- .panel (tabindex 0): relative, flex 0 0 clamp(96px,11vw,170px), height 100%, overflow hidden, border-right 1px solid var(--line) (none on last), cursor pointer, outline none,
  transition flex-grow .9s cubic-bezier(.77,0,.18,1). .panel.is-active: flex-grow 1, cursor default. First panel starts active.
- .panel-in: absolute, left clamp(14px,1.8vw,28px), bottom 10vh, flex, align-items flex-end, gap clamp(16px,2vw,30px), width max-content.
- .num: font-size clamp(170px,36vh,380px), weight 600, line-height .74, letter-spacing -.07em. Colors: 1 = var(--olive), 2 = var(--green), 3 = var(--lime).
- .step: relative, width min(400px,30vw), padding-bottom 4px; inactive: opacity 0, translateX(-24px), blur(6px), transition opacity .4s, transform .5s, filter .4s.

- Panels:
  1  "Ticket comes in" — "A shopper files a return claim with the purchase details, why it's going back, and any proof they can share."  (mini-cloud = CLOUD_B)
  2  "Review record"   — "Your agent scans the buyer profile, earlier purchases, prior returns, and any notable account events."     (mini-cloud = CLOUD_A)

==================================================
5. JAVASCRIPT (vanilla + GSAP/ScrollTrigger/Lenis, wrapped in an IIFE)
==================================================
1) gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger); reduce = prefers-reduced-motion; isMobile = innerWidth <= 760.
2) Split every .split element's text nodes into <span class="w"> per word, recursing into <em> and keeping <br>.
3) .sq-field generator: style = absolute, inset 0 0 auto 0, height 42%, z 1, pointer-events none, mask linear-gradient(#000, transparent).
   For data-count squares: size 46, random col 0–29 and row 0–5, left = col*48-10px, top = row*48+6px, 46x46 .grid-sq. Each gets a GSAP opacity 0→1 yoyo repeat -1, duration 1.2, random delay 0–4s, random repeatDelay 0–3s.
4) Hero glass squares appended to #heroGlass at [x%, y%]:
   left [3,64],[3,71],[6.5,71],[10,71],[3,78]; [-1,70]; center [45.5,76],[49,80],[49,76],[52.5,76]; right [86,58],[86,67],[82,76],[89.5,76],[86,84].
   Size: center ones (40<x<60) clamp(28px,3.4vw,44px), others clamp(36px,5.4vw,74px), aspect-ratio 1. On mobile hide every odd-indexed square.
   Unless reduced motion: gsap.to opacity .15, duration .9, yoyo repeat -1, ease sine.inOut, random delay 0–3s, repeatDelay 1–4s (flickering glass).
5) Petals: 18 spans, random left 0–100%, --dx random -80..80px, duration 9–18s, negative delay 0–15s, scale .6–1.4.
6) Lenis smooth scroll: new Lenis({duration:1.25, easing:t=>Math.min(1,1.001-Math.pow(2,-10*t)), smoothWheel:true}); lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update);
   gsap.ticker.add(t=>lenis.raf(t*1000)); gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0). All a[href^="#"] use lenis.scrollTo(id,{duration:1.6}).
7) INTRO (page zooms out of a blurred landscape): lenis.stop(); set hero words {opacity 0, y 24, blur(10px)}, nav {opacity 0, y -16}.
   Timeline (delay .25):
   - #app fromTo {scale .9, borderRadius 28} → {scale 1, borderRadius 0}, 1.4s, expo.inOut
   - .nav → opacity 1, y 0, .8s power3.out at "-=.5"
   - hero words → opacity 1, y 0, blur(0), 1s, stagger .07, power3.out at "-=.7"
   - .cloud-l from x -120 opacity 0, 1.6s power3.out at .4; .cloud-r from x 120 opacity 0, same at .4
   - #heroGlass .glass from opacity 0 scale .6, .6s, stagger {each .05, from random}, back.out(2) at "-=1"
   onComplete: remove body.intro, gsap.set('#app',{clearProps:'all'}) (so pins work), remove .backdrop, lenis.start(), then setupScroll().
8) setupScroll():
   - Hero parallax (trigger #hero, top top → bottom top, scrub): #heroTitle yPercent -60; each .hero [data-par] y = data-par*2; .hero-media yPercent 8.
   - .reveal elements: from opacity 0, y 16, .8s power3.out, start "top 85%".
   - Word reveal for .split in stats/loop/cta: words from opacity 0, y 22, blur(8px), .9s, stagger .06, power3.out, start "top 80%".
   - Counters: setCounters(p) writes (data-to*p).toFixed(data-dec)+data-suf into each card <b>.
   - gsap.matchMedia:
     (min-width:901px): cards from y 40 opacity 0 stagger .08 (start top 70%). PIN #stats: timeline scrollTrigger {start top top, end "+=120%", pin true, scrub 1};
        tween proxy p 0→1 (ease none) calling setCounters; simultaneously #tree fromTo yPercent 75 → 6 (tree rises from behind the cards, blurred where it passes the logo band).
     (max-width:900px): cards from y 30 opacity 0 stagger .08 (start top 85%); counters animate 0→1 over 2s power2.out when .cards hits top 80%;
        #tree yPercent 40 → 0 scrubbed across the section.
     (min-width:761px): attach hover/focus/click accordion handlers to .panel; .panel-in from y 120 opacity 0, 1.1s stagger .12 (trigger #loop top 60%);
        .loop-cloud x → 60 scrubbed (#loop top bottom → bottom top).
     (max-width:760px): each .panel's children from y 40 opacity 0, .9s stagger .1, start top 85%.
   - CTA: #ctaImg fromTo yPercent -12 → 0 scrubbed (#cta top bottom → bottom bottom); #ctaCard from y 80, scale .94, opacity 0, blur(10px), 1.2s power3.out at #cta top 60%.
   - Footer logo timeline (trigger #footer top 92%): dots bounce y -8 (.25s, stagger .08, yoyo, repeat 3, sine.inOut) → all dots move to cx 27 cy 50 (.45s power3.inOut)
     → dots 2 and 3 fade out (.1s) → #fMark strokeDashoffset 0 (.6s power3.out, "-=.05") with dot 1 r → 5.5 (back.out(3), "<") → #fRing strokeDashoffset 0 (.9s power2.inOut, "-=.3").
   - ScrollTrigger.refresh(); also refresh on window load.

==================================================
6. RESPONSIVE
==================================================
@media (max-width:900px):
  .nav gap 24px; .cards 2 columns; .card height 120px; .logos wrap, centered, gap 14px 26px, item font 17px;
  .stats height auto, min-height 100vh, padding 90px 0 300px (no pin); .tree-wrap bottom 0; .band hidden.
@media (max-width:760px):
  .hero height 100svh, min-height 560px; h1 top 26%;
  .hero-media height 66%, mask transparent 0 → #000 14%; video object-position 38% 100%, transform scale(1.12), origin 50% 100%;
  .cloud-l width 70vw, left -18vw, top 6%; .cloud-r width 66vw, right -20vw, top 10%;
  .nav top 16px, gap 18px, padding-left 12px; .brand 19px;
  .loop height auto, min-height 0, padding 12vh 0 40px; .loop-head relative, top auto; .loop-cloud width 62vw, left -14vw, top 2vh, opacity .9;
  .track relative, inset auto, flex-direction column, margin-top 40px;
  .panel flex none, height auto, overflow visible, no right border, border-top 1px solid var(--line), cursor auto;
  .panel-in relative, left/bottom auto, width auto, padding 28px 16px, gap 18px; .num 150px;
  .step (all states) opacity 1, no transform/filter, width auto; .mini-cloud hidden  → steps become a simple stacked list.
  .cta height auto, min-height 0, padding 60px 0 0; .cta-img relative, height 92vh, min-height 620px; img object-position 30% 60%;
  .cta-card top 120px, padding 34px 18px 42px (still overlaps the night image);
  footer single column, centered items, .f-social centered, .f-links gap 18px wrap centered.
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce): disable .drift-a, .drift-b, .petal animations.
No horizontal scroll at any width (body overflow-x hidden, #app overflow clip).

==================================================
7. RESULT CHECKLIST
==================================================
- On load the white page starts at 90% scale with rounded corners over a blurred cherry-blossom backdrop, then grows to full screen.
- Hero: centered pill nav, drifting pastel clouds top-left/right, headline revealing word by word from blur, looping cherry-blossom valley video in the lower 72% fading into the white sky, flickering frosted glass squares.
- Stats pins on desktop: counters scrub up to 40% / 300+ / 99.2% / 99.2% while the cherry tree rises behind the lime ticket cards and a frosted band blurs it behind the logo row.
- Steps: 3-panel hover accordion with giant olive / green / lime numbers; inactive panels show clipped numbers; the active panel shows title, text and a drifting cloud.
- CTA: frosted white-to-clear card over a moonlit valley with falling pink petals.
- Lime footer: three dots bounce, merge into the Petalyx mark, and a ring draws around it.
- All smooth-scrolled with Lenis.
```

### [FREE-128] Freight Services Hero (`freight-services-hero`)
- **Danh mục:** Logistics | **Loại:** hero | **Độ dài:** 7,659 ký tự
- **Video Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/freight-services-hero.mp4
- **Poster 1280px:** https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261023_083805_02383c71-a993-4c36-9e83-d0cf7fe456d1.png&w=1280&q=85

```markdown
# Prompt: KV freight services scroll hero

Build a single-file **scroll-driven freight hero** for a fictional freight group, **KV**, in plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS, with no framework and no build step. It's a clean product-render story on a white page.

1. A teal reach-stacker lifts a navy container off a stack, turns, and lowers it onto a black semi-truck's trailer.
2. The camera pulls back and a black band rises until the truck sits on its top edge.
3. Huge light-grey "OUR SERVICES" letters slide past *behind* the truck while a dark-band strip (a headline, then five service cards) slides in from the right.

Scrolling drives everything. The scene is one sticky viewport.

## Media

- **Handling clip:** one scrubbed clip, a continuous 4.04s shot at 24fps (97 frames), muted, every 4th frame a keyframe for fast seeking.
  - 1080p: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/409763c0-95f4-49d3-a601-dc564d55072b.mp4
  - 720p, used at 900px wide and below: https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/b3718419-7a0a-478d-bfb0-0ff8bef7f3f7.mp4
  - Poster (first frame): https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/2307e4bf-be39-42b4-b579-e168aeccabf0.jpg
- **Clip content:** pure white background with a flat near-black ground band (#111). Its top edge sits at 82.9% of the frame height until about 3.1s.
  - The stacker lifts, turns toward camera and lowers the container onto the arriving truck.
  - The spreader releases and leaves top-left.
  - The camera pulls back, and by 3.75s the band edge is at 44.8%, with the truck's wheels on it. The rig spans about 16–66% of the frame width.
  - The last ~0.3s holds.
- **Rule:** the vehicles are never drawn or moved in code; all their motion is in the clip. No opacity transitions on the video. It is never played, only scrubbed.

## Type and colour

- **Anton** for the big caps (headline, card titles, giant letters).
- **Archivo** (variable, 400–600) for body, nav and pill.
- **JetBrains Mono** 400 for the speed readout.
- Self-host latin woff2.
- **Colours:** white #fff, ink and band #111, cobalt #2f63ff, giant letters #e9e9e9.
- **Unit:** u = min(100vw/1440, 100vh/960).

## Structure

- **Track:** `.track` (white), whose height is set by JS to (1 + A + B) × viewport.
  - A = 2.4 viewports for the clip.
  - B = (strip width + 0.45 × vw) / vw × 1.1 viewports for the services strip.
- **Nav:** absolute at the top of the track, so it scrolls away.
  - Left: "KV" (Archivo 600, 30u, tracking −.06em).
  - Right: "→ Menu", "Follow", and an outline pill "Work with us" (Archivo 500, 10u, uppercase, tracking .1em).
- **Scene:** `.scene` is sticky at top:0, 100vh (100lvh), overflow hidden. Its background is white above and #111 below a line placed inside the clip, which only matters where the clip doesn't cover the screen.
- **Layers, bottom to top:**
  1. **The `<video>`**, absolutely sized by JS.
     - Wide screens: cover (scale = max(vw/1920, vh/1080), centred).
     - Portrait or narrow screens (below 768px, or vw ≤ vh): width 155vw, horizontally positioned so 40% of the frame sits at mid-screen, and vertically so the final band edge lands at 36% of the viewport.
  2. **Giant letters:** "OUR SERVICES" in Anton at 330u, line-height .8, #e9e9e9, nowrap. Its bottom sits on the final band edge (JS writes `--edge-px` = clip top + 0.448 × clip height). It has **`mix-blend-mode: darken`**, so it only shows where the clip is white. The truck and container, whose silver tops out around #e5, always win, so the letters read as behind the truck. Phones: 180u.
  3. **Speed readout:** top-left (26u, 52u), "NN KM/H" in mono at 10.5u. It shows the smoothed scroll speed (|Δy|/Δt ÷ 32, capped at 99, two digits) and appears once the truck has settled.
  4. **Band:** from `--edge-px` to the bottom, holding the horizontal strip and the "Our services" outline pill. The pill sits centred 36u from the bottom; once the truck settles it fades and rises 24px into place.

## The strip (dark band, slides left)

- **Placement:** a flex row, top 76u, gap 120u, white text.
- **Lead block** (gap 64u):
  - Headline "EVERYTHING YOUR / FREIGHT NEEDS. / UNDER ONE GROUP." in Anton 64u, line-height .98. The third line is cobalt.
  - Beside it, a 250u column of two small paragraphs (Archivo 12u, white at 62%):
    - "From air to sea, from customs clearance to the last mile, we bring decades of practice to every freight discipline."
    - "One integrated network means one partner, one point of contact and full visibility from origin to destination."
- **Five cards**, each 270u wide with 30u side padding and a 1px divider (white at 12%) on the left; the first has no divider. Each has a 38u white line icon, a two-line Anton title at 26u, and Archivo body at 12.4u:
  - **Air freight** (plane): "Express, priority and deferred options across global lanes, booked and tracked end to end."
  - **Ocean freight** (ship): "FCL and LCL sailings on every major trade lane, with carrier choice based on cost and transit time."
  - **Customs brokerage** (document with check): "Licensed in-house brokers for classification, duties and inspections, so goods clear first time."
  - **Warehousing and 3PL** (warehouse): "Bonded and general storage, pick and pack, and distribution that plugs straight into transport."
  - **Project cargo** (crane hook and load): "Oversized and heavy-lift moves, engineered, permitted and escorted from factory to foundation."
- **Card reveal:** title and body use a background-clip:text gradient: white up to (s − 34%), cobalt at (s − 6%), transparent at (s + 26%). Here s = clamp((0.98 − cardLeft/vw) / 0.3, −0.4, 1.6) × 100%, so each card's text sweeps in from blue to white as it travels in from the right.

## Scroll mapping (JS, one rAF loop)

- **Clip time:** q = clamp(scrollY / (A·vh)), and target time = q × (duration − 1/48). Ease toward it each frame (cur += (target − cur) × 0.2). Seek only when the video isn't already seeking and the difference is more than 1/60s, and re-seek on `seeked`.
- **Settled flag:** when q ≥ 0.94, set `--ph = 1`. This shows the readout and the pill.
- **Strip:** r = clamp((scrollY − A·vh) / (B·vh)).
  - Strip translateX = vw − r × (stripWidth + 0.45·vw).
  - Giant letters translateX = vw − r × (lettersWidth + vw).
- **Recorder mode (`?rec=1`):** an 11s Web Animation drives progress (hold to 4%, ease cubic-bezier(.4,.05,.55,.95) to 96%, then hold). `window.__recTime(video, t)` scrolls to that progress, updates the readout from the scripted speed, and returns the clip time, so a frame-by-frame recorder is deterministic.

## Phones (below 768px, or any portrait screen)

- u = min(100vw/430, 1.4px). The clip is framed as above, with white above and black below it.
- **Strip:** top 44u, gap 56u, 22px left padding. The lead block stacks the headline (46u) over the paragraphs (300u wide, 13u).
- **Cards:** 250u wide, titles 26u, body 13u.
- **Readout:** 11px at (20px, 22px). The nav hides "Follow".
- **Overflow:** no sideways scroll.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- **On load:** the stacker holds the navy container over the stack, under the KV nav.
- **Handling:** scrolling lifts the container, turns the stacker, loads the truck, and pulls back until the truck sits on the black band.
- **Services:** "OUR SERVICES" then slides past behind the truck, with no letters showing through the container or cab. The headline enters from the right, followed by the five cards sweeping from blue to white. The KM/H number follows scroll speed.
- **Scrubbing:** scrolling back reverses everything.
- **Content:** no real brands or logos.
```

- **Poster 1280px:** https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261025_014231_5396db47-91ee-4da6-ab2e-e0d8b3705cb6.png&w=1280&q=85

```markdown
# Prompt: Verra Events hero

Build a single-file **community-platform hero** for a fictional creator platform, **Verra**, in plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS with no framework, no build step and no media files. A black page holds a rounded dark frame. Inside it, a huge glowing vortex ring of fine red, pink and orange fins is drawn live on a canvas, cropped by the top of the frame. Below it sit a giant gradient word with a typing caret, a two-line subline and a white button. The ring turns slowly and the word types itself through a short list.

## Frame and scale

- **Page:** `#000`. The frame is inset 5vw left and right and 7.2vh top and bottom, with radius 14u, a 1px border at white 9%, and overflow hidden.
- **Unit:** `u = min(frameWidth / 1052, frameHeight / 754)`, written to `--u`. On phones (under 768px) `u = frameWidth / 600` and the frame is inset 10px.
- **Font:** Inter (variable, 400 to 600), self-hosted latin woff2.

## Nav (24u from the top, 26u and 24u side insets)

- **Left:** a small two-chevron logo (an outlined diamond over an open V, 1.7px white stroke) and "Verra" at 17.5u, weight 500.
- **Right:**
  - a frosted pill (29u tall, radius 8u, background `rgba(150,150,150,.38)`, 14px blur) holding "Explore", "Circles" and "People" at 14u;
  - a 4u gap;
  - a white "Connect" button (29u, radius 8u, dark text, weight 500) that lifts 1px on hover.
- **Phones:** the pill hides.

## The ring (canvas, redrawn every frame)

- **Geometry:**
  - centre (frameWidth/2 + 34u, −212u), so it sits above the frame and only the lower arc shows;
  - inner radius 435u, outer radius 652u;
  - vertical scale 1.03 (plus up to ±3.5% from pointer tilt).
- **Strands:** 196 of them, each sampled at 41 points from the inner rim to the outer rim, with q = 0 → 1 and r = ri + (ro − ri)·q.
  - **Angle:** θ = uᵢ + k·(1 − q)^4.2 + 0.05·k·q² + 0.02·sin(πq)·sin(3uᵢ + 0.4t), where uᵢ = 2πi/196 + spin.
  - **Result:** each strand curls tangentially along the inner rim and then runs almost radially to the outer rim, like a turbine fin.
  - **Motion:** spin = 0.06·t rad/s (a seamless rotation), and k = 0.42·(1 + 0.12·sin 0.55t) gently breathes the curl.
- **Fins:**
  - Each strand is a filled ribbon around its centreline. Its half-width is (0.15 + 3.3·s·(1 − 0.25q))·u, where s is a smoothstep of q over 0 to 0.28, so it tapers to nothing at the inner rim.
  - Draw them in angular order starting at the top of the ring (which is off-screen), so the overlap never shows a seam. Each body is opaque (`source-over`), then its leading edge, offset by the half-width, is stroked 1.45u wide in `lighter` mode. The next body covers part of that edge, which gives the layered-fin depth.
- **Colour (radial gradients from ri to ro, so colour follows radius):**
  - body: `#b01e50` → `#9c1236` (12%) → `#860c18` (40%) → `#9c1a0a` (70%) → `#c63c0e` (90%) → `#e85a18`.
  - edge: pink `rgba(255,130,185,.85)` → `rgba(255,84,138,.95)` (8%) → `rgba(255,56,80,.95)` (28%) → `rgba(255,58,44,.95)` (55%) → `rgba(255,92,36)` (80%) → `rgba(255,122,44)` (94%) → `rgba(255,150,70)`.
- **Light:**
  - a deep-red ambient fill in the annulus (`rgba(170,14,50,.35)` → `rgba(120,8,14,.45)` → `rgba(170,40,6,.4)`);
  - an orange halo from ro − 16u to ro + 70u (peak 0.42);
  - a faint pink inner halo (0.09);
  - a thin orange outer-rim line (1.6u).
- **Bloom:** draw every edge again on an offscreen canvas at 0.32× size (5.3u wide, alpha 0.7), plus a 9u orange outer-rim ring and a 5u pink inner-rim ring. Composite it onto the main canvas in `lighter` mode with an 8u blur.
- **Performance:** device pixel ratio is capped at 2. The loop pauses while the tab is hidden. Reduced motion draws one still frame.
- **Pointer:** the ring centre eases up to 14u × 10u toward the pointer (lerp 0.05).

## Headline group (cap top about 447u from the frame top, centred)

- **Word:** at 176u, weight 600, tracking −0.03em, filled with `linear-gradient(12deg, #fffaf6 28%, #ffe6d6 46%, #ffbc98 66%, #ff8f62 88%, #ff7a4c)`. The result is white at the lower left and peach-orange at the top right.
- **Caret:** a 1.6u × 124u bar in `#ffb48c`, 7u to the right of the word.
- **Typewriter:**
  - The words are Events, then Circles, then Creators, looping.
  - Each word holds for 2.6s with the caret blinking every 0.55s. It deletes at 70ms per letter, pauses 0.25s empty, types the next word at 100ms per letter, then pauses 0.15s.
  - Everything is a pure function of time.
- **Subline:** "Verra provides a space for creators to build / communities from zero to millions.", 26u below the word, 18u on a 24u line, white at 92%.
- **Button:** "Get started now", 19u below the subline. It's white, 41u tall with 17u side padding, radius 10u, 15u text at weight 500. On hover it lifts 2px and gains a soft orange glow.
- **Phones:**
  - the word is min(176u, 22vw);
  - the subline is 15px on a 21px line;
  - the whole ring and text block is centred vertically by shifting both the ring centre and the text down by half the leftover height.

## Timing and recording

- **Clock:** the ring and the typewriter read one clock, `performance.now()`.
- **`?rec=1`:** time comes instead from a paused Web Animation, a 100s linear `translateX(0 → 100000px)` on a hidden 1px element. A frame-by-frame recorder can seek it to get exact frames.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- **Look:** a crisp, glowing red-pink-orange fin vortex arcs across the top with a pure-black hole.
- **Text:** "Events" sits under the arc in a cream-to-orange gradient with a blinking caret.
- **Motion:** the ring turns slowly and seamlessly. After about 2.6s the word deletes and types "Circles".
- **Performance:** 60fps on a laptop.
- **Content:** no real brands or logos.
```

```markdown
# AXON — Motion research hub: recreation brief

Build a single full-screen dark page: a GPU particle cloud shaped like a sculpted logo form fills the viewport, stirred by the cursor through a fluid simulation, with a thin monospace UI layer on top (brand, tag chips, a scrollable column of video cards on the left, a text column on the right, a round counter top-right). Pure black background. No scrolling of the page itself.

All videos: `autoplay muted loop playsinline preload="metadata"`, `object-fit: cover`.

## 2. Fonts

System monospace stack, no web font: `"SF Mono", "Menlo", "Consolas", "Liberation Mono", monospace`. All UI text is uppercase, 13 px, line-height 1.35, letter-spacing 0.02em.

## 3. Head and tokens

- `<meta name="description" content="AXON is a motion research studio: an open logbook of real-time rendering studies in particles, fluids and signed surfaces.">`

--text:   #dddddd

body background #000, html/body height 100%, overflow hidden

## 4. Layers

2. `.ui` fixed inset 0, z-index 1, `pointer-events: none` (links and the card list re-enable pointer events). Text blocks use `mix-blend-mode: plus-lighter` so they glow over the particles; the video cards do not blend.

## 5. UI DOM, in order, desktop measurements

**Brand** `.brand` absolute top 24 left 24, flex row gap 14.
- A 40×40 SVG mark: 18.5 px radius circle stroke white 1.6, plus a white 8-point star polygon inside.

**Tags** `.tags` absolute top 120 left 24 width 320, flex wrap gap 6. Chips: background `--chip`, padding 5px 9px, 11 px, colour #cfcfcf. First chip "All" is active: background #e6e6e6, colour #000. Chips in order: All, Light, Physics, Fluids, Grid, Audio, Volumes, Particles, Capture, Render.

**Card list** `.list` absolute top 250 left 24 bottom 0 width 320, vertical scroll, scrollbar hidden. Each `.card`: padding 18px 0, 1 px top border `--line`.
- `.thumb` height 160, radius 2, background #0a0a0a, overflow hidden, video cover-fitted.

- Cards: Lattices / zone · Ambient light / study — Prism / shell · Dispersion hero / render — Nebular / loop · Procedural hero / sequence — Fall / forward · Dolly track / study.

**Text column** `.about` absolute right 90, top 50% translateY(-50%), width 380. Blocks separated by 2.2em. Headings `h2` 13 px accent colour, margin-bottom 1em. Paragraphs justified, margin-bottom 1em. Lists `list-style: inside`. Links block-level, underlined, margin 4px 0, hover opacity .7 over 300 ms.

~~~

~~~

## 6. Responsive

- ≤1100 px: text column right 24, width 320.
- ≤760 px: hide `.list` and `.tags`; text column becomes left 24 / right 24 / bottom 24, no transform, paragraphs left-aligned.

## 7. Particle system (the hero)

**Scene.** Perspective camera FOV 30, near 0.1, far 1000, base position (-1.17, 0, 6) looking at the origin. A group holds the points at position (0.343, 0.16, -1), rotation in degrees (-28.4, 390, 4.92), scale (5, 5, 6).

**Gaze camera.** Each frame the target position is base + (mouse.x mapped 0..width → -1..1) × (-1) on x and (mouse.y mapped 0..height → -1..1) × 2 on y; the camera lerps to it at 0.05 and looks at the origin.

**Count.** 262,144 points on desktop (512×512 position texture), 16,384 on mobile. Each point has a `random` vec4 attribute in 0..1 and looks up its position from a float RGBA texture using `position.xy` as UV.

**Simulation (ping-pong float render target, one fullscreen pass per frame).** Inputs: current position texture, origin texture (initial random positions uniform in [-1,1]³), random attribs, `time` (s), `HZ` (= dt × 60), fluid velocity texture, fluid density texture, projection matrix (camera projection × inverse camera world), model matrix (group world), normal matrix (camera world). Per particle:

~~~
if (length(pos) > 0.7) pos /= 2.0;
pos += curlNoise(pos * 0.1 + time * 0.05) * 1.0 * 0.0002 * HZ;        // uCurlNoiseScale 1, uCurlTimeScale 0.5, uCurlNoiseSpeed 1
vec3 gradient = sdfNormal(pos);   // central differences, step 0.001
float sdf = sdfShape(pos);
pos += cross(normalize(pos), normalize(gradient)) * 0.0005;           // swirl along the surface
pos += -gradient * sdf * 0.5;                                          // pull onto the surface
pos += (origin - pos) * 0.0002 * HZ;                                   // spring back to origin
// mouse fluid
vec2 screenUV = project(model * pos) → 0..1
vec3 flow = vec3(texture(fluidVelocity, screenUV).xy, 0.0) rotated by the camera's world rotation
pos += flow * 0.0001 * HZ * 0.4 * texture(fluidDensity, screenUV).r;  // uMouseStrength 0.4
~~~

**Shape.** A smooth, organic sculpted form about 0.7 units across: a bent, hollow ring/torus-like mass with one large opening and softer lobes, defined as a signed distance function. (The original uses a small sine-network SDF; any closed, smooth, slightly twisted ring with one big hole gives the same read. Before evaluating, mirror the depth axis: `p.z = sqrt(p.z*p.z + 0.0215) - sqrt(0.012)` so the form is symmetric front/back with a soft seam, and rotate `p` by the quaternion (0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5). Outside radius 0.8 return `length(p) - 0.7`.)

**Curl noise.** Analytic curl of three sine-sum potentials (Bridson-style), normalized.

**Point rendering.** Additive blending, transparent, depth test on, depth write off. Vertex: `pos *= mix(1.0, 1.5, pow(random.y, 150.0))`; `scale = smoothstep(3, 15, distToCamera) * mix(0.5, 1.0, random.z)`; `gl_PointSize = 0.04 * DPR * 2.0 * scale * (1000 / viewDistance)`. Fragment: discard outside a circle; discard when scale < 0.1; base colour `mix(0.0, 0.2, random.x)` grey, mixed to lavender (0.6, 0.45, 1.0) by `pow(random.z, 100)`; sparkle `0.5 + (0.4 + sin(time*4 + random.y*20)) * pow(random.z, 10) * 2.5`; matcap sampled with the sprite UV rotated by `sin(time + random.z*20)*0.5 + 1`, blended soft-light 0.8 then overlay 0.2; alpha 1.

## 8. Fluid simulation (drives the cursor interaction)

Classic GPU fluid (curl → vorticity → divergence → pressure → gradient subtract → advect velocity → advect density → display), half-float ping-pong targets.

| Setting | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Sim resolution | 256 × 256 |
| Dye resolution | 512 × 512 |
| Velocity dissipation | 0.98 |
| Density dissipation | 0.97 |
| Pressure dissipation | 0.95 |
| Pressure iterations | 5 |
| Curl | 30 |
| dt | 1/60 |

**Mouse input each frame.** `len` = cursor distance moved since last frame (px). Splat radius = clamp-map(len, 0..5 → 0..60) × 0.6 (× 0.8 on mobile); force multiplier = clamp-map(len, 0..15 → 0..10). When len > 0.01: splat a line from the previous point to the current with colour (dx × mult, -dy × mult, 1) into velocity (additive) and white into density, radius/200 in UV units, aspect-corrected. If more than 50 ms passed since the last splat, the line starts at the current point.

The density texture, rendered to a viewport-sized target with alpha = max(r, g, b), is the mask that limits the push to where the cursor has been.

## 9. Interactions and motion summary

- Cursor move anywhere: fluid splat → particles swirl and drift along the flow, then heal back onto the shape within ~1–2 s.
- Cursor move also pans the camera slightly (gaze).
- Touch: `touchstart`/`touchmove` feed the same mouse position.
- Resize: renderer, camera aspect and the fluid mask target follow the window.
- Links: hover fades to 70 % over 300 ms.
- No entrance animation; the cloud forms from random positions over the first ~3 s of simulation.

## 10. Acceptance checklist

- [ ] Black page, no scrollbars, canvas fills the viewport at any size.
- [ ] A dense white-grey particle cloud with sparse lavender points forms a hollow, twisted ring form, centred slightly right of the UI columns.
- [ ] Moving the cursor across the cloud visibly stirs it; it settles back within two seconds.
- [ ] Camera drifts a little with the cursor.
- [ ] Brand, counter, 10 chips, 4 video cards (all playing, muted), and the four text blocks with the exact copy above.
- [ ] Headings in #aa88ff; text blends additively over the particles; videos are opaque.
- [ ] Below 760 px the chips and cards hide and the text column sits at the bottom.
- [ ] No console errors; all four video URLs return 200.
```

```markdown
.h-display{font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(48px,7.6vw,112px);line-height:.96;letter-spacing:-.045em;color:#3a2419}
.h-display .w>span{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#3a2419 0%,#6d5547 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;color:transparent}

.h2{font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(34px,4.4vw,62px);line-height:1.02;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin-top:18px;color:#2a1a12}
.h2 .lt{color:#8d7b6f;font-weight:300}
.cta h2{font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(56px,8.4vw,128px);line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-.055em;color:#2a1a12}

/* Lenis required CSS */
html.lenis,html.lenis body{height:auto}
.lenis.lenis-smooth{scroll-behavior:auto!important}
.lenis.lenis-stopped{overflow:hidden}

.media{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.media.kb{animation:kb 26s var(--ease-io) infinite alternate}
@keyframes kb{from{transform:scale(1.04)}to{transform:scale(1.12) translate3d(-1.5%,-1%,0)}}

/* typed AI replies sit on top of an invisible full-length copy, so the card never changes height while typing */
.ai-t{display:grid}
.ai-t>span{grid-area:1/1}
.ai-t .ghost{visibility:hidden}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important;transition-delay:0ms!important}
  .js .rv,.js .split .w>span,.msg,.row{opacity:1!important;transform:none!important;filter:none!important}
}

Stagger rule: siblings get style="--d:1", "--d:2", … ; above-the-fold items get a fixed delay with style="--base:700ms".

HEADING MARKUP (use exactly; the script splits the words at runtime):
Hero:    <h1 class="h-display split" data-split style="--base:150ms">Creative AI,<br>Redesigned</h1>
Bento:   <h2 class="h2 split" data-split>Concepts Get Sharper with<br><span class="lt">A Guiding Direction</span></h2>
Prod:    <h2 class="h2 split" data-split>From Creative Blueprint to<br><span class="lt">Polished Imagery</span></h2>
CTA:     <h2 class="split" data-split>Craft<br>Ideas</h2>

<header class="nav" id="nav">: position fixed, inset 0 0 auto 0, z-index 50, padding 16px 0, transition background/padding/box-shadow .5s var(--ease). .nav.scrolled = background rgba(246,240,231,.72), backdrop-filter blur(18px) saturate(140%) (add -webkit- too), padding 10px 0, box-shadow 0 1px 0 var(--line).
Inner .wrap: display grid, grid-template-columns 1fr auto 1fr, align-items center.
- Left .nav-l (flex, gap 10px): pill links "Explore" (#product), "Benefits" (#features), "Billing" (#pricing). .pill = background var(--pill), radius 999px, padding 10px 24px, 13px, uppercase, letter-spacing .04em; hover background #e3d6c6 and translateY(-1px).
- Centre: <a class="logo"> 44×44 grid-centred with a 40×40 logo mark that rotates 90deg on hover (.8s var(--ease)).
- Right .nav-r (flex, justify-end, gap 22px): .lang = "ENG" 13px + a UK flag SVG 20×14 (radius 2px) + a 9×6 chevron; then <a class="btn-dark" href="#start">Begin Crafting</a>; then <button class="burger" id="burger">, which is hidden on desktop.
.btn-dark = background var(--brown), color #f6ede2, radius 999px, padding 11px 26px, 13px, uppercase, letter-spacing .05em, border 0, cursor pointer, position relative, overflow hidden, isolation isolate. Its ::before is a sheen: linear-gradient(120deg, transparent 30%, rgba(255,255,255,.22) 50%, transparent 70%) at translateX(-120%), z-index -1, moving to translateX(120%) on hover (.9s var(--ease)). Hover also applies translateY(-2px) and box-shadow 0 12px 28px -12px rgba(59,33,22,.6).
.burger = 42px circle, var(--pill), border 0, flex column centred, gap 5px, containing two <i> lines 16×1.5px in var(--ink). body.menu-open turns them into an X: first line translateY(3.25px) rotate(45deg), last line translateY(-3.25px) rotate(-45deg).
.mmenu (#mmenu): fixed inset 0, z-index 40, rgba(246,240,231,.96) with blur 20px, flex column centred, gap 18px, opacity 0 and pointer-events none, transition .5s. Its links are 34px with letter-spacing -.03em, starting at opacity 0 and translateY(16px). body.menu-open shows the menu, and the links animate in with delays 0, .06s, .12s, .18s. Links: "Explore", "Benefits", "Billing", "Begin crafting".

9. SCRIPT — VERBATIM (one <script> at the end of body, after the Lenis script)
====================================================================
document.documentElement.classList.add('js');

const VIDEOS = {
  "v-hero":  "https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261022_054532_4648c53b-8840-4872-b054-016a86833f5c.mp4",
  "v-bento": "https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261022_054543_65a4e3d3-ce77-45a9-8917-60ce35999ea7.mp4",
  "v-cta":   "https://d8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/hf_20261022_054543_cc94675a-b1cc-47a8-8843-c55665b0f33b.mp4"
};

(() => {
  const reduce = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  const wait = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));

  // 1) background videos: fade the still out once the video actually plays
  Object.entries(VIDEOS).forEach(([id, url]) => {
    const v = document.getElementById(id);
    const still = document.querySelector('[data-fallback="' + id + '"]');
    if (!v) return;
    v.src = url;
    v.addEventListener('playing', () => {
      if (still) { still.style.transition = 'opacity 1.2s'; still.style.opacity = 0; }
    }, { once: true });
    v.play().catch(() => {});
  });

  // 2) split headings into words, keeping nested spans and <br>
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-split]').forEach(el => {
    let i = 0;
    const walk = node => {
      [...node.childNodes].forEach(n => {
        if (n.nodeType === 3) {
          const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
          n.textContent.split(/(\s+)/).forEach(part => {
            if (!part) return;
            if (/^\s+$/.test(part)) { frag.appendChild(document.createTextNode(' ')); return; }
            const w = document.createElement('span'); w.className = 'w';
            const s = document.createElement('span'); s.textContent = part; s.style.setProperty('--i', i++);
            w.appendChild(s); frag.appendChild(w);
          });
          n.replaceWith(frag);
        } else if (n.nodeType === 1 && n.tagName !== 'BR') walk(n);
      });
    };
    walk(el);
  });

  // 3) count-up
  const countUp = el => {
    const end = +el.dataset.count, t0 = performance.now(), dur = reduce ? 1 : 2000;
    const tick = t => {
      const p = Math.min(1, (t - t0) / dur);
      el.textContent = Math.round(end * (1 - Math.pow(1 - p, 4)));
      if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  };

  // 4) reveal on scroll (low threshold so tall blocks, like the stacked hero card on phones, still trigger)
  const reveal = el => {
    if (el.classList.contains('in')) return;
    el.classList.add('in');
    el.querySelectorAll('[data-count]').forEach(countUp);
    if (el.id === 'gauge-card') document.getElementById('g-arc').style.strokeDashoffset = 252 * (1 - .94);
    if (el.id === 'match-card') document.getElementById('ring-arc').style.strokeDashoffset = 163.4 * (1 - .94);
  };
  const targets = document.querySelectorAll('.rv,[data-split]');
  const io = new IntersectionObserver(entries => entries.forEach(e => {
    if (e.isIntersecting) { reveal(e.target); io.unobserve(e.target); }
  }), { threshold: 0.08, rootMargin: '0px 0px -6% 0px' });
  targets.forEach(el => io.observe(el));
  // safety net: reveal anything already on screen even if the observer is late
  const sweep = () => targets.forEach(el => {
    const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (r.top < innerHeight * 0.94 && r.bottom > 0) reveal(el);
  });
  requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(sweep));
  addEventListener('load', sweep);

  // 5) hero card: reserve each reply's final height, then run two independent sequences that start together
  document.querySelectorAll('#studio .ai-t').forEach(el => {
    el.innerHTML = '<span class="ghost"></span><span class="live"></span>';
    el.firstChild.textContent = el.dataset.text;
  });
  const typeInto = (el, text, speed = 14) => new Promise(res => {
    const live = el.querySelector('.live');
    if (reduce) { live.textContent = text; return res(); }
    live.innerHTML = '<span class="typing"><i></i><i></i><i></i></span>';
    setTimeout(() => {
      live.textContent = ''; let k = 0;
      const step = () => { k += 2; live.textContent = text.slice(0, k); k < text.length ? setTimeout(step, speed) : res(); };
      step();
    }, 650);
  });
  const runColumn = async (items, done) => {
    await wait(reduce ? 0 : 1500);
    for (const m of items) {
      m.classList.add('show');
      if (m.id === 'hero-fig') m.classList.add('in');
      const t = m.querySelector('.ai-t');
      if (t) await typeInto(t, t.dataset.text);
      else await wait(reduce ? 0 : 380);
    }
    if (done) done();
  };
  runColumn([...document.querySelectorAll('#studio .chat .msg')], () => {
    document.getElementById('hero-track').style.width = '84%';
  });
  runColumn([...document.querySelectorAll('#studio .prod .msg')]);

  // 6) smooth scroll + one scroll handler for nav state and hand parallax
  const nav = document.getElementById('nav');
  const hand = document.getElementById('hand-img');
  const stage = document.getElementById('stage');
  const onScroll = () => {
    nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', scrollY > 20);
    if (!reduce && hand && stage) {
      const r = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
      const p = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (innerHeight - r.top) / (innerHeight + r.height)));
      hand.style.transform = 'translate3d(0,' + (-p * 12).toFixed(2) + '%,0)';
    }
  };
  let lenis = null;
  if (!reduce && window.Lenis) {
    lenis = new Lenis({ duration: 1.25, easing: t => Math.min(1, 1.001 - Math.pow(2, -10 * t)), smoothWheel: true });
    lenis.on('scroll', onScroll);
    const raf = t => { lenis.raf(t); requestAnimationFrame(raf); };
    requestAnimationFrame(raf);
  } else {
    let ticking = false;
    addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      if (!ticking) { requestAnimationFrame(() => { onScroll(); ticking = false; }); ticking = true; }
    }, { passive: true });
  }
  onScroll();

  // 7) anchor links + mobile menu
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(a => a.addEventListener('click', e => {
    const id = a.getAttribute('href');
    document.body.classList.remove('menu-open');
    if (id.length < 2) return;
    const target = document.querySelector(id);
    if (!target) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    if (lenis) lenis.scrollTo(target, { offset: -70 });
    else target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }));
  document.getElementById('burger').addEventListener('click', () => document.body.classList.toggle('menu-open'));
})();

====================================================================
10. RESPONSIVE BREAKPOINTS
====================================================================
@media (max-width:1100px): .studio width 90%; .hero-card height 720px. .bento columns 1fr 1fr; .c-big becomes grid-row auto, grid-column span 2, min-height 480px. .stage columns 1fr 1fr; .hand becomes grid-column span 2, order -1, height 520px, max-width 520px, width 100%, justify-self center. .stage .col padding-bottom 0, and the last .col padding-bottom 40px. .foot-grid becomes 3 columns, with .about spanning 3.
@media (max-width:860px): hide .nav-l and .lang; .burger becomes display flex. Nav grid becomes auto 1fr auto with the logo at order -1, and .nav-r gap 10px. .hero-card: height auto, padding 120px 14px 14px. .studio: position relative, left/top auto, transform none, width 100%, one column. .prod: border-left 0, border-top 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.45), padding 14px. #hero-fig: flex none, min-height 0, aspect-ratio 16/10; its img object-position 50% 30%.
@media (max-width:640px): .wrap padding 0 16px. .btn-dark padding 10px 18px, 12px. .hero padding-top 96px. .hero-card radius 24px, padding 72px 10px 10px. .studio radius 20px. .chat padding 18px 16px, gap 10px. .bubble and .ai max-width 92%, font-size 12px. .cd strong font-size 20px. .prod padding 12px 16px 16px. #hero-fig aspect-ratio 4/3. .cd becomes a column aligned to the start; .slider width 100%, text-align left. .s-bento, .s-prod and .s-foot padding-top 80px. .bento-shell and .prod-shell padding 48px 14px 14px, radius 24px (.prod-shell padding-bottom 0). .bento one column; .c-big grid-column auto, min-height 440px, padding 22px. .stage one column; .hand grid-column auto, height 420px. .cta padding 28px 20px, min-height 460px, radius 24px, with ::before changed to linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(246,240,231,.1) 0%, rgba(246,240,231,.55) 45%, rgba(246,240,231,.85) 100%). .foot-grid becomes 2 columns, .about spans 2, .mark is hidden. .legal becomes a centred column, gap 6px, margin-top 40px.
At every width from 320px to 2560px, document.documentElement.scrollWidth must not exceed the viewport width (no horizontal scroll), and the hero card must stay fully inside .wrap.

====================================================================

====================================================================
- On load, the hero headline "Creative AI, Redesigned" animates in word by word (rising from below its line mask) and is clearly visible, with the brown vertical gradient on every word. No word is clipped or invisible.
- At 1280px, 1440px and 1920px the hero card's right edge stays inside the window, and the glass studio panel stays fully inside the card.
- The hero card keeps exactly the same height from page load until the typing finishes, at every width.
- On phones the hero card stacks: chat on top, then "Visual Output Suite" with a 4:3 portrait. Text stays readable and there is no sideways scroll.
- Every section heading and card reveals once while scrolling, staggered; nothing stays permanently invisible.
- Scrolling feels smooth (Lenis), the nav turns frosted after 20px, and the hand image drifts up gently as the production section passes.
- The gauge and ring count up to 94% and their arcs draw in when scrolled into view.
- The two hero card columns start animating at the same moment, independently.
- All 3 videos autoplay muted on loop and replace their still images.
- Exactly 4 sections after the nav: Hero, Bento, Production, CTA + Footer.
```

### [FREE-135] Facet Glass (`facet-glass-hero`)
- **Danh mục:** 3D | **Loại:** hero | **Độ dài:** 6,848 ký tự
- **Video Preview:** https://pub-86dc5b5484314368ac5436a674b0d919.r2.dev/aaaf/facet-glass-hero.mp4
- **Poster 1280px:** https://images.higgs.ai/?default=1&output=webp&url=https%3A%2F%2Fd8j0ntlcm91z4.cloudfront.net%2Fuser_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P%2Fhf_20261026_045953_479b439c-09fa-4701-ba5e-4ff534c67858.png&w=1280&q=85

```markdown
# Prompt: Facet "Designed in glass" hero

Build a one-screen **WebGL hero for a fictional real-time material studio, Facet**. The page is a dark website shattered into **thick smoked-glass shards** floating on black. The content is printed on the shards. The whole slab tilts toward the cursor, the shard under the pointer lifts and tips, and "Read paper →" shatters the page to reveal a second view. Use plain HTML, CSS and JS with three.js 0.169.0 from jsDelivr (import map, plus `RoomEnvironment` from the addons). No build step and no images: all content is drawn in code. Font: Inter (variable woff2, 400–600).

## Scene and scale

- **Background:** #050507.
- **Camera:** perspective, fov 30°, placed so that 1 world unit = 1 CSS px at z = 0.
- **Renderer:** ACES filmic tone mapping, DPR capped at 2.
- **Environment:** PMREM RoomEnvironment, `environmentIntensity` .42, plus a soft white-blue key light from the top-left.
- **Page block:** centred, with side margins of 5.5 % of the width and top/bottom margins of 8.5 % of the height (16 px on phones).
  - The block is a **nav slab** (10.8 % of the block height) above a **14 px gap** and a **shard panel** (the rest).
  - Layout scale: S = blockWidth / 1730.

## The glass

- **Construction:** every piece is an `ExtrudeGeometry` of a rounded polygon.
  - Corner radius 20·S, depth 13·S, bevel 2.6·S with 3 segments.
  - The outline is inset by half the gap, so pieces sit 14·S apart.
- **Material:** MeshPhysicalMaterial.
  - color #17171b, roughness .36, clearcoat .7, clearcoatRoughness .12, specularIntensity .7.
  - Iridescence .55 (IOR 1.3, thickness 250–650 nm), rising to 1.0 together with envMapIntensity 1 → 1.9 while a piece is hovered.
  - The result: dark charcoal faces, soft studio gradients, thin bright rims, and a green/violet sheen when a piece tips toward the light.
- **Cursor glow:** a soft lavender emission injected into the glass shader via `onBeforeCompile`: `vec3(.42,.37,.62) · .16 · exp(−1.6·(d/300S)²)` around the pointer's world position. It fades in and out with the pointer.

## The cut pattern (live)

- **Cells:** five cells measured from the reference, in panel-normalised coordinates (x right, y down).
  - Edge points: top .22, .515, .84; bottom .34, .865.
  - Inner junctions: J0 (.385,.72), J1 (.48,.62), J2 (.716,.49).
  - A = TL·tAB·J0·bAD·BL (hero), B = tAB·tBC·J1·J0, C = tBC·tCE·J2·J1, D = J0·J1·J2·bDE·bAD, E = tCE·TR·BR·bDE·J2.
- **Drift:** every point drifts on its own slow sine (x ±.03; junctions also y ±.05; periods ≈10–20 s).
- **Cursor push:** points within .6 of the pointer are pushed away by up to .05, so the cell under the cursor grows.
- **Rebuild:** geometry is rebuilt about 45×/s.
- **Portrait screens:** the pattern is transposed so the hero cell sits on top.

## Content printed on the glass

- **Page image:** one canvas (DPR ≥1.5) of the whole panel. Each cell carries a `ShapeGeometry` of its own outline just above its top face, with UVs mapped to its original page position. A lifted or flying shard takes its slice of the text with it, and the seams read like refraction.
- **Panel content:**
  - Eyebrow "REAL-TIME MATERIAL STUDIO": 11·S px, tracking .2em, 38 % white, at 13.5 % of the height.
  - Headline "Designed / in glass.": Inter 500, size min(7.8 % of panel width, 20 % of height), tracking −.045em, leading .97, a #dcdce0→#bdbdc3 vertical gradient.
  - Two-line sub "Author dispersion, transmission, and refraction in the browser. Live / previews, real materials.": 55 % white.
  - "Open studio" light pill (116×40·S, radius 6). It **turns green #36d67e on hover**.
  - "Read paper →" link (underlines on hover).
  - "© Facet Lab" bottom-left and "KHR_materials_dispersion" bottom-right, 11·S px at 34 % white.
- **Nav slab:** square mark + "Facet", links "Studio · Materials · Pricing" (60 % white, brighten on hover), "Sign in" right.
- **Text layer:** a transparent DOM copy of all text is mapped onto the tilted panel with a homography (`matrix3d` from the panel's four projected corners). Text is selectable (blue selection box) and buttons and links are real hit areas.

## Interaction

- **Global tilt:** the block rotates as if pressed at the pointer: rotateY = x·7° − 1.2°, rotateX = −y·5.5° + .8°. It is smoothed with a 0.3 s exponential and eases back when the pointer leaves the window.
- **Hover:** a raycast picks the piece under the pointer (cells and nav). It springs (k 170, c 19) up 50·S toward the camera (nav 32·S) and tips up to ±.24 rad, with the edge nearest the pointer dipping away. Neighbours stay put.
- **Shatter (click "Read paper →"):**
  - Every piece, nav first, flies off in 0.72 s with ease-in cubic, with a small stagger per piece.
  - Each piece gets an outward and downward velocity plus 420–800·S toward the camera, gravity, and 2.0–3.6 rad of tumble about a random axis. The printed text rides along.
  - From 0.28 s the definitions view fades in on black over 0.4 s. Its type scales with viewport width, measured from the reference:
    - The column starts at 32.4 % W and is 33.9 % W wide. The title baseline sits at 35.9 % H.
    - Title "Real-time glass, in five terms.": Inter 650, 1.36 vw, tracking −.022em, white.
    - Five paragraphs (Iridescence, Index of refraction, Dispersion, Transmission, Roughness): .73 vw on a 1.72 line height, 60 % white, with the bold term in white + an em dash. Gaps are 1.05 vw.
  - The **"← Back" sliver** is a thin dark smoked-glass shard, the same material as the cells with iridescence .35 and no cursor glow.
    - Outline: viewport fractions (.147,.243) (.252,.169) (.287,.277) (.151,.258), with rounded corners, an 11·k extrusion and a bright bevel (k = W/1918).
    - It leans in 3D: rotateY −.16 (left end further away) and rotateX .08. It has a slow idle wobble (±.03–.04 rad at ≈1 Hz) and tips up to .14 rad toward the pointer on hover.
    - "← Back" is .66 vw Inter 500, white, centred at (.219 W, .238 H). It turns lavender #b9abff on hover.
    - It grows in from .3 s after the click and shrinks away on Back.
- **Back:** the definitions fade out in 0.25 s and the sliver shrinks away. The pieces fly back along the same paths in 0.72 s with ease-out-back (a slight overshoot), nav first, then a 30 ms stagger.
- **Load:** the page enters with the same fly-in.
- **Reduced motion / no WebGL:** a static styled HTML version.

## Acceptance check (1440×960)

- The dark glass shards and nav slab look thick, with bright hairline rims and black gaps. The headline is printed across the cuts.
- Moving the mouse tilts the whole slab, and the hovered shard lifts, tips, gains a sheen and glows lavender under the cursor.
- The cut lines slowly breathe.
- "Read paper →" shatters everything, with the text flying on the shards, into the five-terms view. "← Back" reassembles it.
- **Content:** no real brands or logos.
```

```markdown
ANIMATION ENGINE (requestAnimationFrame, NOT CSS marquee):
Constant SPEED = 0.8 px per frame (auto-scroll left)
Transform: translate3d(offsetPx, 0, 0)
Seamless wrap:
halfWidth = track.scrollWidth / 2
if offset <= -halfWidth → offset += halfWidth
if offset > 0 → offset -= halfWidth

DRAG / POINTER INTERACTION:
onPointerDown: set dragging true, velocity=0, capture pointer, store startX + startOffset, cursor-grabbing
onPointerMove while dragging:
  velocity = (dx / dt) * 16   // normalize ~60fps
  offset = dragStartOffset + (clientX - dragStartX)
onPointerUp / onPointerCancel: dragging=false, release grabbing cursor
While NOT dragging:
  if |velocity| > 0.1: offset += velocity; velocity *= 0.95 (momentum decay)
  else: velocity=0; offset -= SPEED (resume auto-scroll)
This yields: continuous left crawl → grab/drag → inertial coast → resume crawl
```

```markdown
### Online idle (code overlay on a canvas over the video)

- **Scanline:** a soft white scanline band (≈52 px tall, 10 % white) sweeps down the screen glass every ~1.8 s, with a faint flicker. It's clipped to the screen rectangle, which is (806, 505)–(1077, 724) in the clip's 1920×1080 frame, mapped through the same cover transform as the video.
```

```markdown
## Section 1: hero (height 1440u, red, `overflow:hidden`)

- **Nav:** 84u tall with a 1px cream (50 %) bottom rule. Three centred items, MENU, ABOUT and STUDIO: Archivo 30u, weight 900, width 84 %, uppercase.
- **Frame:** two vertical 1px cream (50 %) rules at `--side` from each edge, starting under the nav.
- **Side labels:** small rotated labels (11u, 800, uppercase, +.08em tracking) centred in each side gutter.
  - **Left**, rotated -90°: "01 / 05" at 225u, "ODA NOBUNAGA" at 560u, "UNIFICATION OF JAPAN" at 1010u, "01 / 05" at 1330u.
  - **Right**, rotated 90°: the same labels, with the two middle ones swapped.
- **Kanji:** "織田信長" in Mochiy Pop One 56u, centred, at top 158u.
- **Title:** two Anton lines in cream, each stretched to fill its box exactly. Measure Anton's cap height on a canvas, set the font size so the caps fill the box height, and use SVG `textLength` + `lengthAdjust="spacingAndGlyphs"` for the width.
  - "ODA": 392u × 258u, top 252u.
  - "NOBUNAGA": 1120u × 266u, top 526u.
- **Stage:** 1386u square, centred, top 54u, above the title. It holds the base webp and the five armour pieces, each absolutely placed by the percentages above.
- **Petals:** a 1507u square WebGL canvas over everything. Each frame it draws the petals video, with alpha keyed from redness: `a = smoothstep(.12,.75, r - g*.5)`, green clamped to blue, premultiplied. That leaves clean red petals with no green fringe.

## The suit-up (scroll-driven)

- **Progress:** `p = clamp((scrollY - 0.06·vh) / (0.62·vh))`, smoothed by 20 % per frame.
- **Camera:** the inner layer scales `1 + 0.3·easeInOutCubic(p)` and moves up `-4 %·easeInOutCubic(p)`, so it pushes in on his face.
- **Pieces:** each one grows from an anchor inside the 2048px drawing. Before its window it is invisible; inside the window it snaps to full opacity in the first ~7 %, then scales from (sx, sy) up to (1, 1).

| Piece | Anchor (x, y) | Window of p | Start scale (sx, sy) | Ease |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mask | 1024, 960 | .16–.46 | .72, .72 | easeOutCubic |
| Helmet | 1024, 600 | .22–.54 | .12, .30 | backOut 1.25 |
| Flaps | 1024, 770 | .30–.60 | .25, .65 | easeOutCubic |
| Horns | 1024, 640 | .40–.70 | .12, .10 | backOut 1.4 |
| Chest | 1024, 1185 | .34–.74 | .55, 0 | easeOutCubic |

The mask closes over his face, the helmet grows out of his forehead, the flaps open out, the horns shoot up, and the chest plate drops down from his neck. Scrolling back up takes everything off in reverse.

## Load reveal (Web Animations)

| Element | Animation | Duration | Delay |
|---|---|---|---|
| Title lines | Rise out of their masks (translateY 102 % → 0) | 1.1s | 150 / 290ms |
| Kanji | Rises 16u while fading in | — | 60ms |
| Nav and side labels | Fade in | 0.7s | 120ms + 25ms each |
| Stage | Rises 6 % | 1.3s | — |

All of them use `cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)`.

## Section 2: biodata and introduction (cream)

- **Rules:** the same two vertical side rules, in red at 55 %.
- **Biodata row:** 324u tall, with a red rule underneath. Side labels: "BIODATA" on the left, "02 / 05" on the right.

- **Introduction card:** 134u side margins, a 1px red (70 %) border, and a 30u circle on each corner with its centre on the corner point.

  - The statement is in Archivo 50u, weight 900, width 96 %, line height 1, uppercase, one line per row:

  - Under it, a 19u paragraph, 500 wide max: "Accounts describe him as tall, lean and lightly bearded. His ambition made him ruthless, yet he was a clear-eyed realist, respected for making the hard calls."
```

```markdown
## The robot (three.js, fixed full-screen transparent canvas)

### Renderer, environment and lights

- **Renderer:** antialias, alpha, pixel ratio capped at 2, ACES Filmic tone mapping with exposure 1.05, sRGB output, soft PCF shadows.
- **Environment:** PMREM from `RoomEnvironment` (blur .04) at intensity .9.
- **Camera:** perspective, 30° FOV.
- **Lights:**
  - **Hemisphere:** sky `#fff6ee`, ground `#d9d2c8`, intensity .7.
  - **Key:** directional `#fff3e6` at 1.7 from (-3, 5, 4). Casts a 1024px shadow with radius 6 and bias -.0005.
  - **Rim:** directional `#fff0e6` at 1.2 from (4, 2, -4).
  - **Fill:** warm point light `#ff9a6a` at 2.2 from (-3.2, 1.2, .6), range 6.

### Materials

| Material | Settings |
|---|---|
| Shell | MeshPhysical `#eeebe6`, roughness .38, clearcoat .45 (roughness .3) |
| Shell light | `#f8f6f2`, roughness .34, same clearcoat |
| Joints (dark) | `#1b1b1f`, roughness .55, metalness .3 |
| Deep dark | `#0f0f12` |
| Pedestal | `#2a2928`, roughness .9 |
| Ring | See below |

**Ring:** a 512px canvas conic gradient (pink #ff3d8b → coral #ff5a5f → orange #ff8a3d → amber #ffb347 → orange → coral → pink), used as both map and emissive map (emissive .22). Roughness .5, clearcoat .35.

### Build (units)

- **Head:** a group pivoting at y .78 (head centre at +.78 above the pivot).
  - Skull: rounded box 1.5 × 1.42 × 1.3, radius .2.
  - Dark back block: 1.28 × 1.14 × .9, set back. Scatter ~26 tiny dark "circuit" bars over its back and top.
  - Face ring: an extruded rounded-rect frame (outer 1.5 × 1.44, r .3; inner 1.08 × 1.02, r .2; depth .1; bevel .03) with the ring material, at z .6. Remap the UVs to the frame's bounds so the gradient wraps around it.
  - Bezel: an inner shell-light frame at z .62.
  - Screen: a rounded plate .9 × .84 at z .66. Glossy black with clearcoat 1, and the face canvas as its emissive map (intensity 1.6).
  - Ears: cylinder r .22 on both sides, with caps. On the right, a half-torus dark cable loops down.
- **Neck:** a dark cylinder.
- **Torso:** rounded box 1.22 × 1.12 × .92, r .24.
  - A shell-light chest-top slab.
  - Three small emissive LEDs on the chest: `#ff8a3d`, `#ff5a5f`, `#ff3d8b`.
  - Two dark vertical slots with dark half-torus lips above them.
  - A dark pelvis.
- **Arms:** at each shoulder a dark ball, a shell upper arm, a dark elbow ball, then a forearm group holding a shell-light hand block and a thumb. Shoulders splay out by ±.16 rad; forearms bend by -.35.
- **Legs:** a dark hip ball, a shell leg block, a dark ankle, and a shell-light foot.
- **Pedestal:** a 1.7 × 1.6 × 1.7 box under the feet (y -2.22) that receives shadows.

### Face canvas (512px)

- Black fill. White shapes with a white glow (shadowBlur 18).
- **Eyes:** two ellipses at (196, 262) and (316, 252), radius 30 × 38.
- **Blink:** every 2.5–5.5s the eyes squash vertically to 10 % and back over .18s.
- **Quote mode:** a single 560px "Arial Black" “ centred at (256, 400). When the mode changes, the new face fades in at +.05 alpha per frame.

## Motion

- **Scroll:** p = scrollY / innerHeight, clamped 0–2, smoothed by 8 % per frame. It blends three camera states with ease-in-out cubic:

| State | Camera z | Camera y | Look-at y | Body yaw | Head yaw / pitch / roll |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Intro | 11.6 | 1.1 | .55 | -.42 | -.6 / .16 / .22 (tilted, looking left) |
| Product | 6.9 | 1.95 | 1.72 | -.2 | -.06 / .04 / 0 (close-up on the head) |
| Reviews | Same as Product | | | | |

- The face switches to quote mode once smoothed p passes 1.55.
- On screens under 900px, camera z is multiplied by 1.25.
- **Pointer:** the normalised cursor, smoothed by 6 % per frame:
  - moves the camera ±.25 x and ∓.1 y,
  - adds .12 to body yaw,
  - adds .45 to head yaw and .18 to head pitch.
- **Idle:**
  - the body bobs ±.02 (sin 1.4t),
  - the head sways slightly (pitch sin .9t × .02, roll sin .7t × .02),
  - the arms swing gently (shoulder sin(1.4t + side) × .05, forearm × .06).

## Mobile (≤ 900px)

- **Hidden:** the outer guides, the menu, the pad cell, the rail, the feature list and the ghost.
- **Layout:**
  - The nav becomes logo + button.
  - The prompt box spans the width at top 18 %.
  - The headline and scroll link sit 16px from the edges.
- **Readability:** the robot fills the screen, so the headline boxes, the "UNLEASH" line, the sub line, the "Gateway" lines, the quote and "Try for yourself" get a paper backing at `rgba(239,236,230,.88)`.

## Notes

- The brand, product names, token ($NOVA) and every person and company in the reviews are fictional. Don't use real brand names or logos.
```

```markdown
# Prompt: Wild pill hero

Build a single-file, one-screen **travel hero for a fictional rental brand, Wild**. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS with no framework and no build step.

The page opens on white with the word **WILD** and a hairline between the I and the L. That line opens into a slit, then a circle, then a wide stadium-shaped pill that pushes "WI" and "LD" apart. The pill shows a looping video of a floating island with a waterfall over sunset clouds. As the pill opens, a soft paper background with flowing white lines fades in, the nav drops in from the top and the footer bar rises from the bottom.

## Media

- **Scene video:** https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/175fbbcd-e50a-480c-bab2-ca16d4678322.mp4
  - 1280×720, 60 fps, 4.25 s, muted.
  - It loops seamlessly with a hard loop: no crossfade, no reverse.
  - The island sits centred with sky above and clouds below. The waterfall pours, clouds drift, birds glide and the small islands bob.
- **Poster (first frame):** https://d2ol7oe51mr4n9.cloudfront.net/user_38xzZboKViGWJOttwIXH07lWA1P/726b168c-da47-4682-a255-cc3e02f89bae.jpg
- **Display:** the video sits inside the pill at full pill height, centred horizontally, at least 4.2 em wide, so it cover-crops at every pill width. The focal point is the top of the scene: `object-fit: cover; object-position: center top` (the poster too). It is always fully opaque; only the pill's own width and clip reveal it.

## Type and colour

- **Font:** Inter (variable, 400–800), self-hosted.
- **Word:** "WILD" in weight 800, tracking −0.045 em, line-height 0.8.
- **Colours:**
  - page `#ffffff` at the start, then paper `#f2f2f1`
  - ink `#1d1d1d`, secondary text `#3a3a3a`
  - rule `#a9a9a6`
  - button `#1b1b1b` with white text

## Scale

- **Unit:** one type unit, `--fs = min(19.6vh, 13.2vw)` on desktop, which is the font size of the word. Everything in the hero is sized from it.
- **Phone (≤ 720 px):** the word stacks, with "WI" over the pill over "LD". See *Phone* below.

## Layout

- **Hero:** centred 43 % from the top. The row is `WI · pill · LD` in a flex row, with the gap animating between the parts.
- **Pill:**
  - height 1.81 em, fully rounded, overflow hidden, placeholder fill `#d8d3cf`
  - final width 3.62 em on desktop, about a 2:1 stadium
  - a tiny white line icon near each end, at about 85 % opacity: a breeze icon on the left, a speaker icon on the right that toggles its sound waves
- **Background:** a paper layer with about 15 long white strokes sweeping up and to the right as soft S-curves (stroke 1.2–3.9 px, opacity 0.55–0.85), drawn in an SVG stretched to the viewport.
- **Nav (top):**
  - left links "Home · Features · Templates · Contact Us", right links "Instagram · Facebook" as plain text (no logos)
  - size max(12 px, 0.072 em), weight 450
  - padding 0.14 em top, 0.27 em sides
- **Footer (bottom):** a row aligned to the bottom.
  - Left: a paragraph 1.42 em wide, size 0.066 em, line-height 1.45, with a drop-cap "E" (2.35× size, weight 650): "Embark on a wild ride around the world with our travel rental service. Discover breathtaking landscapes and hidden gems on your unforgettable journey."
  - Middle: a 1 px rule filling the space.
  - Right: a black pill button "Let's Get Wild".

## Motion: the reveal

One Web Animations timeline, 2.1 s, starting once fonts are ready.

- **Pill width** (fs = word size):
  - 0.012 fs (a hairline) at 0 %, held to 14 %
  - 0.16 fs (a slit) at 30 %
  - 1.81 fs (a circle) at 58 %
  - the final width at 100 %
  - easings: `(.5,0,.3,1)`, `(.45,0,.3,1)`, `(.4,0,.2,1)`
- **Pill clip:** grows vertically from `inset(50% 0)` to `inset(0)` over 0–14 %, so the hairline draws from the middle out.
- **Hairline:** a grey overlay (`#b9b9b9`) on the pill shows the line as grey, then fades out between 14 % and 30 % as the image appears. This fade is on the overlay, never on the video.
- **Word gap:** 0.026 em until 14 %, 0.05 em at 58 %, then 0.085 em. "WI" and "LD" are pushed outward by the opening pill.
- **Background:** the paper and lines fade in between 45 % and 78 %.
- **Nav:** slides down from −140 % between 50 % and 86 %, with easing `(.2,.8,.2,1)`.
- **Footer:** rises from +160 % between 52 % and 90 %.
- **Rule:** draws from the centre (scaleX 0 → 1) between 40 % and 95 %.
- **Icons:** fade in after 80 %.

## Interaction

- **"Let's Get Wild":** replays the reveal. It plays the same timeline in reverse, collapsing the pill back to the hairline with everything leaving, then opens it again.
- **Resize:** finishes any running animation and resets the pill width.
- **Speaker icon:** toggles its waves. The clip is silent.
- **Reduced motion:** shows the final state with the video paused on the poster.

## Recording mode (`?rec=1`)

- The reveal plays at 0 s and the reverse collapse starts at 4.9 s, matching the reference loop.
- `window.__recVideo(t)` returns `(t mod duration) + 1/120`, so a frame-by-frame recorder seeks the clip to a fresh frame every step.

## Phone (≤ 720 px)
```

```markdown
# Sun Timeline — Life of the Sun Scrub Hero (exact recreation prompt)

Build a single-file, full-viewport interactive page called **The Life of the Sun**. It is extremely minimal: a pure black page, one glowing ball in the upper-middle, a soft pool of light under it, a two-line caption, and a thin timeline of fine ticks. Scrubbing moves through ten stages of the Sun's life, from solar nebula to white dwarf. Each scrub physically throws the ball: it whips round, its surface smears into horizontal bands, and the new surface lands within about a quarter of a second while the caption blurs across.

Everything is drawn live in a raw WebGL fragment shader. There are no images, no video, and no libraries. Plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JS in one file; the only external resource is the font. Reproduce every value, string and timing below exactly.

Three rules define the look:
1. The ball **never changes size**. All ten stages are surfaces on the same ball.
2. The page stays **pure black**. The halo must reach exactly zero a short way off the ball; no wide glows or background gradients anywhere.
3. It must be **instantly responsive**. Every wheel tick, drag pixel or hover move changes state on that frame.

---

## 5. WebGL

Get a `webgl` context with `{antialias:false, alpha:false}`. Draw one full-screen triangle (`[-1,-1, 3,-1, -1,3]`). Canvas backing size is `innerWidth/innerHeight × min(dpr,1.5)`.

Fixed uniforms: `rad = .17`, `cy = .13`, `sc = min(1, innerWidth/innerHeight*1.5)` (shrinks the ball on portrait screens; update on resize).

Vertex shader: `attribute vec2 a;void main(){gl_Position=vec4(a,0.,1.);}`

Fragment shader (use verbatim):

~~~glsl
precision highp float;
  uniform vec2 res;
  uniform float sc, rad, cy, fade, t, evo, rot, blur, starX, freq, warp, cells, gas, shell, gI, flick;
  uniform vec3 c0, c1, c2, glow;
  float h(vec3 p){ p = fract(p*.3183099 + .1); p *= 17.; return fract(p.x*p.y*p.z*(p.x+p.y+p.z)); }
  float n3(vec3 x){ vec3 i = floor(x), f = fract(x); f = f*f*(3.-2.*f);
    return mix(mix(mix(h(i),h(i+vec3(1,0,0)),f.x), mix(h(i+vec3(0,1,0)),h(i+vec3(1,1,0)),f.x), f.y),
               mix(mix(h(i+vec3(0,0,1)),h(i+vec3(1,0,1)),f.x), mix(h(i+vec3(0,1,1)),h(i+vec3(1,1,1)),f.x), f.y), f.z); }
  float fbm(vec3 p){ float a=.5, s=0.; for(int i=0;i<5;i++){ s+=a*n3(p); p=p*2.03+vec3(1.7,9.2,3.1); a*=.5; } return s; }
  vec3 stars(vec2 uv){
    vec2 q = (uv + vec2(starX, 0.))*34., id = floor(q), f = fract(q)-.5;
    float r = fract(sin(dot(id,vec2(127.1,311.7)))*43758.5453);
    vec2 o = vec2(fract(r*17.3),fract(r*91.7))-.5;
    float tw = .55+.45*sin(t*(.7+r*1.8)+r*40.);
    vec2 g = f-o*.7; g.x *= 1./(1.+blur*7.);
    return vec3(smoothstep(.975,1.,r)*smoothstep(.06,.0,length(g))*tw*.55);
  }
  void main(){
    vec2 uv = (gl_FragCoord.xy - .5*res)/res.y, p = (uv - vec2(0., cy))/sc;
    float d = length(p), e = max(d-rad, 0.);
    vec3 col = stars(uv);

    // tight halo that ends completely a short way off the ball, the page stays pure black
    vec2 dir = p/max(d,1e-4);
    float rays = .72 + .56*fbm(vec3(dir*2.4, evo*.5));
    float hal = exp(-e/(rad*.11))*smoothstep(rad*.6, rad*.12, e);
    col += glow*gI*.7*hal*rays*flick;

    // soft pool of light under the ball, standing in for the reference's contact shadow
    float py = (p.y + rad + .065)/.0135, px = p.x/(rad*1.02);
    float pool = max(0., 1.-px*px) * exp(-py*py);
    col += glow*min(gI,1.)*.1*pool*pool;

    if(d < rad + .02){
      float k = min(d/rad, 1.);
      vec3 nrm = vec3(p/rad, sqrt(max(1.-k*k, 0.)));
      float cr = cos(rot), sr = sin(rot);
      vec3 n = vec3(nrm.x*cr + nrm.z*sr, nrm.y, -nrm.x*sr + nrm.z*cr);
      // spinning fast smears the surface along its axis of rotation
      float sq = 1./(1.+blur*3.2);
      vec3 q = vec3(n.x*sq, n.y, n.z*sq);
      float w1 = fbm(q*freq + vec3(0.,0.,evo*.28)), w2 = fbm(q*freq*.9 + 7. - vec3(evo*.22,0.,0.));
      float v = fbm(q*freq*1.7 + warp*2.2*vec3(w1, w2, w1-w2));
      float vein = 1.-abs(2.*fbm(q*freq*1.5 + warp*1.3*vec3(w2, w1, 0.))-1.);
      vein = pow(vein, 9.);
      float s = smoothstep(.24,.76,v);
      s = mix(s, clamp(vein*1.25 + s*.14,0.,1.), cells);
      vec3 c = mix(c0, c1, smoothstep(.0,.55,s));
      c = mix(c, c2, smoothstep(.5,1.,s));
      float mu = nrm.z;
      if(shell > .001){
        // planetary nebula: a hot point, a teal cavity and a filament shell seen through the ball
        vec3 sh = c0 + c1*smoothstep(.95,.3,k)*(.25+v*1.2);
        float fil = smoothstep(.5,.82,k)*smoothstep(1.,.8,k)*pow(v+.32,3.)*3.2;
        sh += c2*fil + vec3(3.5,4.,5.)*exp(-k*k/.012);
        c = mix(c, sh, shell);
      } else {
        c *= mix(mix(.34, .8, gas), 1., pow(mu,.5));
      }
      c += glow*pow(1.-mu,2.6)*.42*min(gI,1.)*(1.-gas);
      float edge = smoothstep(1., .985, k);
      float soft = smoothstep(1., .58, k + (fbm(q*3.4 + evo*.1)-.5)*.62) * smoothstep(1., .9, k);
      float a = mix(edge, soft, gas);
      col = mix(col, c, a);
    }
    col = 1. - exp(-col*1.15);
    gl_FragColor = vec4(pow(col, vec3(.4545))*fade, 1.);
  }
~~~

## 6. State

~~~js
let x = START/LAST;          // timeline position 0..1
let stage = START, omega = 14;   // spin speed in rad/s, the page opens on a whip
let rot = 0, evo = 0, starX = 0, lastInput = -1e9, hover = -1, dragX = null;
const cur = deep copy of LOOK[START];   // the live, eased look
~~~

**Input** all funnels through:
~~~js
function moveTo(nx, now) {
  nx = clamp(nx, 0, 1);
  omega += (nx - x) * 150;   // every bit of input throws the ball
  x = nx; lastInput = now;
}
~~~
- `wheel` on window, non-passive, `preventDefault`. Use the larger of deltaX/deltaY: `moveTo(x + d*(deltaMode===1 ? .012 : .00075), now)`.
- `#track` `pointermove`: `hover = clamp(px(e))` where `px(e) = (clientX-rect.left)/rect.width`. For mouse when not dragging, `moveTo(hover)`. `pointerleave` sets `hover=-1`.
- Window `pointerdown`: `dragX=clientX`; on the track also `moveTo(px(e))`.
- Window `pointermove` while dragging: on the track `moveTo(px(e))`, elsewhere `moveTo(x + dx/min(innerWidth,900))`.
- `pointerup`/`pointercancel`: `dragX=null`.
- Arrow keys step one stage: Right/Down forward, Left/Up back.

**Each frame** (`dt` capped at .05, `f(r)=1-exp(-dt*r)`, `time=(now-t0)/1000`):

1. Idle autoplay: if not reduced motion, `now-lastInput>5000` and `now>nextAuto` (initially `t0+5000`): `x=((i+1)%(LAST+1))/LAST` where `i=round(x*LAST)`, `omega+=9`, `nextAuto=now+2600`.
2. `i=round(x*LAST)`. If `i!==stage`: `omega += omega>=0?7:-7; stage=i; setCaption(i)`.
3. Ease every numeric and colour field of `cur` toward `LOOK[stage]` by `f(13)` (`f(60)` when reduced motion).
4. `omega *= exp(-dt*3.6)`.
5. `spin = reduced ? 0 : .22 + omega`; `blur = min(1.4, |omega|*.1)`.
6. `rot += spin*dt`; `evo += dt*cur.boil*(1+|omega|*.1)`; `starX += omega*dt*.012`.
7. Set uniforms: `freq warp cells gas shell gI c0 c1 c2 glow t evo rot blur starX`, plus `flick = 1 + .1 sin(time*2.1) + .06 sin(time*5.3)` and `fade = min(1,(now-t0)/500)`.
8. Draw.
9. Update ticks (section 8).

## 7. Caption

`setCaption(i)` appends a new `.line.off` with `<h1>{t}</h1><p><b>{b}</b>{c}</p>`, forces layout, removes `.off`. The previous line gets `.off` and is removed after 240ms. So the old line blurs out while the new one blurs in. Also update `aria-valuenow` and `aria-valuetext`, and toggle `.on` on `#e0` (stage 0) and `#e1` (last stage).

## 8. Ticks

37 ticks (`LAST*PER+1`, `PER=4`), so a stage sits on every 4th tick. Each frame, for tick `j`:
~~~js
active = x*(N-1); bellAt = (hover>=0 ? hover : x)*(N-1);
q = j-bellAt; bell = exp(-q*q/5.5); on = exp(-(j-active)²/.22);
goal = max((j%PER ? .17 : .28) + bell*.55, on);
tickH[j] += (goal-tickH[j])*f(22);
transform = scaleY(tickH[j]); opacity = .3 + bell*.35 + on*.6;
~~~
A narrow bell follows the pointer, and the active tick stands tallest and brightest.

## 9. Feel

Quiet and precise, then physical the moment you touch it. Nothing on the page moves without reason, but the ball feels heavy and alive: boiling at rest, thrown hard by the slightest scroll, landing crisply on the next chapter of the Sun's life.
```

```markdown
## What it is

Build a full-viewport **comparison hero** for a fictional AI-readability product called Distill. Use plain HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript in one file, with no framework and no libraries.
```
